2be0e184.title: Oracle Cloud HCM Functional - Compensation
2be0e184.description:
**Position: Oracle Cloud HCM Functional \- Compensation**

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Experience: 6\+ Years**

 **Key Responsibilities**

* The HCM Cloud Functional consultant is responsible for requirement gathering, configuration, CRPs and functional consulting activities in implementation and support
  

 projects.
* Overall, more than 6 years of Oracle HCM experience in functional roles that may include on\-premise and Cloud
* Should have at least 4\-5 years of experience in Oracle HCM Cloud implementation as a Functional Consultant.
* Must have experience working on all phases of a project – Demos/workshops, Requirement Gathering, analysis/design, configuration, CRP, validation, transition, realization, production support, etc.
* Must have a strong track record of delivering Oracle HCM Cloud solutions, including extensive experience in the areas of business process analysis, requirement definition, and solution design.
* Experience in at least 3 end\-to\-end implementations in Compensation
* Working knowledge of Core HR (Global Human Resources) and Talent Management is required as secondary skills – see the skills detail below. Additional exposure to ORC, Benefits, Payroll / Payroll Interface, Absence Management, HR Helpdesk or Worklife Solutions is preferred.
* Should know most of the Oracle HCM Cloud modules and awareness of the latest release functionality
* Must be flexible to travel

 **Primary Skills – Oracle Cloud Compensation:**

* Workforce Compensation: plan setup and configuration, compensation cycles, budget pools and budget distribution, worksheet design and column properties, eligibility
   

profiles, approvals, compensation change statements, and modelling / what\-if analysis.
* Individual Compensation Plans (ICP): one\-time and recurring awards, element and payroll linkage, plan access and eligibility.
* Salary administration: salary bases, salary components, grades, grade rates, grade ladders and steps, and grade step progression.
* Total Compensation Statements: statement definition, categories, sources and generation.
* Fast Formula for compensation: eligibility, default and validation formulas, proration, rounding and currency conversion rules.
* Data loading and reporting: HCM Data Loader / Spreadsheet Data Loader for salary, grades and grade rates; HCM Extracts, OTBI subject areas and BI Publisher reporting for compensation.
* Market data and benchmarking, Compensation History, and integration of compensation results into Payroll and downstream systems.

 **Secondary Skills – Oracle Cloud Core HR (Global Human Resources):**

* Enterprise and workforce structures: legal entities, legal employers, legislative data groups, business units, divisions, departments, locations, jobs, positions and position
   

hierarchies – including position synchronisation, which drives compensation eligibility.
* Person and employment model: person records, work relationships, assignments, employment terms, and the actions / action reasons framework.
* Workforce record maintenance: hire, promotion, transfer and termination flows, and their downstream impact on salary and compensation eligibility.
* Approvals and workflow: BPM approval rules, approval hierarchies and the Transaction Console.
* HCM security: roles, data roles, security profiles and Areas of Responsibility, specifically as they govern access to compensation plans, worksheets and salary data.
* Configuration tooling: descriptive and extensible flexfields, lookups, value sets, Checklists and Document Records.
* HCM Data Loader / Spreadsheet Data Loader, HCM Extracts, and Redwood / HCM Experience Design Studio transaction design.

 **Secondary Skills – Oracle Cloud Talent Management:**

* Performance Management: performance templates and documents, rating models, review periods, eligibility profiles and the end\-to\-end performance process flow.
* Use of performance ratings as a compensation driver, including feeding performance documents and ratings into Workforce Compensation worksheets.
* Goal Management: goal plans, goal libraries, mass assignment and alignment to performance documents.
* Profile Management: talent profiles, content types, content items, model profiles and profile comparison.
* Talent Review and Succession Planning: talent review meetings, 9\-box analytics, succession plans and talent pools.
* Career Development: development goals, career interests and role readiness.
* Calibration and talent ratings, plus awareness of Oracle Recruiting (ORC) offer compensation as an upstream touchpoint.

 **Desired Skills/Good to have:**

* Ability to conduct training and knowledge sharing sessions in Fusion applications
* Exhibit effective analytical skills \& organizational skills
* Good command over spoken \& written English
* Effectively manages scope and customer expectations on individual assignments
* Follows through on all assignments and takes ownership of customer issues

de68e9a5.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud
de68e9a5.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions, leveraging your strong communication and leadership skills to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Utilize your experience with AWS to map existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, ensuring seamless integration and optimal system performance.
* Develop Cloud Solutions: Apply your proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Spring Boot, or Netflix OSS to develop cloud solutions that meet client needs and adhere to cloud native development principles.
* Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients, leveraging your knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, containers, and serverless computing to help them make informed decisions about their cloud architecture.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices\-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

81221718.description:
Reference 260002AH
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Department / Project Overview** 
 – GTS/PAS/DRE Team provides 24 \* 7 production database support to all the MKT/GDI \& Retail Banking customers across SG group. Project includes incidents, requests \& changes management on all the Retail applications hosted on multiple technologies including Oracle, MSSQL, Informix, DB2, Teradata \& Open Source RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MongoDB \& MYSQL). The project is responsible for the complete life cycle management of databases including Migrations, Upgrades etc. Additionally the project supports all the maintenance operations, performance analysis \& troubleshooting, patching \& DRP exercises.
   

  

 Skills required \- Oracle database cloud expert , devops \-
   

  

* python development (venv configuration, python packages, best practice, PEP style guide, object oriented development)
* CI/CD concepts and tools (Jenkins, Git ...)
* Test Driven Development (mocking a python code, pytest, tests coverage ...)
* Code quality tools (flake, sonar …)


 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Oracle Database Expert \& Cloud Developer to design, implement, optimize, and manage enterprise\-grade database solutions both on‑premises and in the cloud. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Oracle Database technologies, strong hands\-on skills in PL/SQL development, and proven experience in cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure, or AWS.
   

  

 This role requires strong analytical abilities, performance tuning expertise, and the ability to architect scalable, secure database and cloud solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Oracle Database Engineering
   

  

 Design, deploy, and maintain Oracle databases (11g, 12c, 19c, or later).
   

  

 Perform advanced performance tuning, query optimization, and troubleshooting.
   

  

 Implement backup \& recovery strategies using RMAN, Data Guard, and GoldenGate.
   

  

 Manage database security, user access, auditing, and data masking.
   

  

 Conduct database upgrades, migrations, and patching with minimal downtime.
   

  

 Optimize database storage, indexing, partitioning, and memory management.
   

  

 Cloud Architecture \& Development
   

  

 Design and build cloud\-native solutions on OCI, Azure, or AWS.
   

  

 Migrate on\-prem Oracle databases to cloud platforms.
   

  

 Implement automated provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
   

  

 Work with cloud services including:
   

  

 OCI Autonomous DB, Exadata Cloud Service
   

  

 Azure/AWS RDS for Oracle
   

  

 Cloud networking, security, WAF, IAM
   

  

 DevOps \& Automation
   

  

 Automate database tasks using Python, Shell scripting, Ansible, Terraform, etc.
   

  

 Set up monitoring and alerting using OEM, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or OCI Monitoring.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Leadership
   

  

 Work closely with architects, developers, analysts, and security teams.
   

  

 Provide technical guidance, documentation, and best practices.
   

  

 Support production systems with on\-call availability as required.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Technical Skills
   

  

 15\+ years of hands\-on Oracle DBA and development experience.
   

  

 Strong expertise in:
   

  

 Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate
   

  

 PL/SQL programming
   

  

 Performance tuning (AWR, ASH, SQL Tuning Advisor)
   

  

 Backup \& recovery (RMAN)
   

  

 Experience with OCI, AWS, or Azure cloud environments.
   

  

 Knowledge of microservices, containers (Docker/Kubernetes) is a plus.
   

  

 Understanding of networking, security, and identity management in cloud.
   

  

 Strong scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell).
   

  

 Soft Skills
   

  

 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication and documentation ability.
   

  

 Ability to work in agile, fast\-paced environments.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or Oracle Cloud certifications.
   

  

 Experience with Exadata or Autonomous Database.
   

  

 Exposure to big data platforms (Hadoop, Spark) is an advantage.
   

  

 Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools: Git, Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform.
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field.
   

  

**Required**
**Profile required**

 years and above
   

  

**Qualification / Certification –** 
 Engineering graduate / MCA / Computer Science Graduate or PG. Any relevant RDBMS certification is an added advantage.

**ABOUT LEGION**
 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.

db7a57ad.title: Principal Program Manager
db7a57ad.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Job Description: Project Manager (T4\)**

**Position:** Principal Program Manager— Level T4  

**Function:** Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development**. You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multi\-team coordination:** Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* **Customer project ownership:** Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* **High\-stakes project leadership:** Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* **Structured planning:** Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* **Innovation facilitation:** Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including **AI\-assisted project management** (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* **Status reporting:** Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* **Team collaboration:** Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.

**Required Profile**

* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* **Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus** — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
* **PMP certification (Project Management Professional) is a strong plus** — it demonstrates mastery of globally recognized PM standards and a commitment to the discipline.

**What We Value**


You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

bef37080.title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
bef37080.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
**Strategic Mandate**
 As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership
   

  

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**
* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking


**Qualifications**
**Expertise \& Technology Stack**
* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking


**Additional Information**
**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

 We are seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead large\-scale, complex IT services programs spanning cloud, data, platform, and enterprise application landscapes. This role carries end\-to\-end ownership of program outcomes — balancing hands\-on delivery execution with strategic portfolio alignment across multiple concurrent engagements for internal stakeholders and external clients. The ideal candidate brings both program governance rigor and a
 **product engineering mindset** 
 — understanding the technical architecture underneath delivery, not just the schedule on top of it.
   

  

 Program Manager
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Delivery**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery across scope, schedule, cost, and quality — consistently meeting client satisfaction and business outcome targets.
* Establish and govern Agile/hybrid program frameworks, metrics, and tooling (Jira, executive dashboards, status reporting) across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Provide oversight across multi\-vendor, cross\-geography teams, ensuring consistent delivery standards and accountability.


**Product \& Technical Ownership**
* Apply a product development mindset to program delivery — thinking in terms of releases, technical debt, platform scalability, and long\-term maintainability rather than just milestone dates.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to understand system design trade\-offs (cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, integration architecture) well enough to make informed scope, sequencing, and risk calls.
* Own technical roadmap alignment — ensuring program plans reflect realistic engineering constraints (CI/CD maturity, environment readiness, tech debt, dependency mapping across microservices/platforms).
* Drive quality engineering practices across programs — test automation coverage, release readiness gates, defect leakage, and production stability metrics.
* Guide build\-vs\-buy and platform modernization decisions (e.g., cloud migration, data platform re\-architecture) in collaboration with technical leadership.
* Champion DevOps and SDLC maturity — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation), observability, and automated deployment practices across program teams.
* Maintain working fluency in the technology stacks in play (cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, data platforms like Snowflake/Databricks, integration/API layers) sufficient to challenge estimates, de\-risk technical dependencies, and speak credibly with client engineering teams.


**Strategic \& Portfolio Management**
* Drive strategic planning and portfolio prioritization, aligning programs with organizational goals and client transformation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and clients, translating business objectives into executable, outcome\-driven program roadmaps.
* Shape enterprise\-scale program governance structures, risk management frameworks, and escalation mechanisms.


**Financial \& Commercial Governance**
* Own financial governance across program budgeting, forecasting, revenue assurance, and margin optimization.
* Oversee contract execution, including SOW compliance, change management, commercial negotiations, and cross\-vendor dependencies.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Own client communication at executive and steering committee levels — proactively managing expectations, risks, and escalations.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with client and internal leadership, serving as the primary point of accountability for program health.


**Generative AI \& Innovation**
* Define and drive enterprise adoption of Generative AI for program governance, predictive risk analysis, intelligent status reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making across delivery portfolios.
* Evaluate and pilot AI\-assisted engineering tools (code generation, automated testing, agentic workflows) to improve delivery velocity and quality across programs.
* Establish responsible AI usage standards within program management practices and mentor delivery teams on effective, scaled adoption.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and develop cross\-functional and matrixed delivery teams, fostering a high\-performance, accountable delivery culture.
* Build organizational capability by coaching program and project managers on governance best practices, technical literacy, and stakeholder management.

Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
   

  

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
   

  

**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**

516e2037.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
516e2037.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise\-level customers.
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2\)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

e91f52d1.title: Community & Brand Engagement Manager
e91f52d1.description:
**Community \& Brand Engagement Manager** 




 Noida · Full\-Time · On\-Site
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh (on\-site, across UniLiv residences)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time. Evening and weekend availability when programs run.
 



**Function:** 
 Community Engagement \& Brand Marketing
 



  





**About UniLiv** 




 UniLiv is a leading provider of secure, fully furnished student housing and co\-living accommodation across India, built on tech\-enabled property management. Residents get an all\-inclusive, single\-fee rental model with minimal security deposits, plus premium amenities: modern rooms, 24/7 power backup, high\-speed internet, and regular housekeeping and laundry. Beyond the room, UniLiv builds vibrant, inclusive communities through curated social events, wellness activities and brand partnerships that help residents connect, grow and feel at home.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is an end\-to\-end engagement role with a strong marketing edge, running at scale. You will own the complete engagement cycle for large resident cohorts across UniLiv residences in Noida: setting the engagement strategy and calendar, designing and budgeting programs, bringing in the right partners, promoting to residents, running events on the ground, measuring what worked, and feeding that into the next cycle. Some of these are intimate floor\-level programs; others are full\-property festivals and flagship events with hundreds of residents in the room.
 



 Every program you run is also a marketing asset. You will turn community life into content, stories, reels and reviews that travel beyond the property: strengthening the UniLiv brand in Noida, feeding the central marketing team a steady stream of real material, and driving the referrals and word\-of\-mouth that bring the next residents in.
 



  





**What End\-to\-End Engagement Means at UniLiv** 



* **Plan:** 
 Own a quarterly engagement calendar mapped to the resident calendar (move\-in season, exams, festivals, breaks) and to the different cohorts living with us: new joiners, long\-stayers, students, working professionals.
* **Design and budget:** 
 Concept each program with a clear objective, whether that is participation, partner value or brand visibility, and manage spend responsibly.
* **Partner:** 
 Bring in brands, local businesses and service providers to co\-create, sponsor or activate programs.
* **Market:** 
 Build the promo plan for every program (resident groups, the app, notice boards, posters, social) and make sure it looks and sounds like UniLiv.
* **Execute:** 
 Run logistics, vendors, crowd flow and safety; host the event, direct the on\-ground team, and capture content while it happens.
* **Amplify:** 
 Publish the story afterwards, push it to marketing, and convert it into reviews, referrals and resident\-generated content.
* **Review:** 
 Track participation, reach, engagement and event feedback; run post\-event reviews, report to leadership, and carry the learnings into the next cycle.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the resident engagement calendar end to end: plan, budget, partner, promote, execute, amplify, review and improve community events, festivals and wellness programs.
* Run structured community programs for defined resident cohorts (new\-joiner batches, exam\-season groups, interest clubs, long\-stay residents) with clear objectives, a repeatable format and measurable participation.
* Deliver large\-scale flagship events end to end: venue and crowd planning, vendor and artist coordination, permissions, safety, run\-of\-show, on\-day command and post\-event settlement.
* Own the content engine for Noida residences: shoot and collect photos, reels, resident stories and testimonials from every program, and build a usable content bank for the marketing team.
* Run resident\-facing social and communication channels (property groups, community pages and local content), keeping tone, visuals and messaging consistent with UniLiv brand guidelines.
* Build and nurture long\-term brand relationships with partners, local businesses and service providers, managing collaborations, co\-branded activations and renewals.
* Drive reviews, referrals and resident advocacy: run referral pushes, prompt Google and platform reviews after strong moments, and build a resident ambassador network that helps programs and content scale.
* Support local brand visibility and demand generation: campus activations, local tie\-ups and community\-led campaigns that put UniLiv in front of prospective residents in Noida.
* Work hand in hand with the central marketing team on campaigns, brand launches, seasonal pushes and collateral, adapting national campaigns for local audiences.
* Maintain trackers, manage engagement and partnership budgets, and report program performance, content output, reach and partner ROI to leadership.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **Experience handling cohorts and running community programs.** 
 You have owned recurring programs for defined groups of people (student batches, member cohorts, clubs, chapters, campus communities), not one\-off events. You know how to build a format, keep a group engaged over weeks and months, and hold participation up after the novelty wears off.
* **Proven public and event management at scale.** 
 You have planned and run large events end to end (fests, concerts, conferences, festival nights, campus activations), handling vendors, permissions, crowd control, safety, budgets, run\-of\-show and live on\-day command with hundreds of people present.
* **Proven, hands\-on ownership of engagement calendars** 
 from strategy through partner sourcing, execution, promotion and review. You have built the calendar, not just delivered events on it. Experience in co\-living, student housing, hospitality or campus life preferred.
* **Real marketing instinct:** 
 you can spot the story in an evening, shoot and cut a decent reel on a phone, write copy that sounds human, and understand what makes content perform with a student and young\-professional audience.
* Comfortable running social channels day to day, with working knowledge of Instagram and WhatsApp community formats and basic tools such as Canva or CapCut.
* Track record of building and managing brand or partner relationships, including negotiating collaborations and running co\-branded activations.
* Strong stage presence and group facilitation: comfortable hosting, anchoring and holding a room, with clear written and verbal communication in English and Hindi.
* Solid organizational and budgeting skills; comfortable juggling multiple initiatives and tracking program and content performance.
* Comfort working on\-site in a dynamic residential environment, including evenings and weekends when programs run.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, Management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior community\-focused or content\-led experience (community manager, resident engagement, campus ambassador, event manager, social media executive) is highly desirable.



  





**Why This Role** 




**Build the community layer of a fast\-growing brand.** 
 You own the engagement calendar, the partner relationships and the content that comes out of them, with a real budget behind you and direct exposure to leadership. This is the chance to shape how thousands of residents experience one of India's fastest\-growing co\-living operators.
 



*UniLiv is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, and hire on capability and attitude alone.*

abd7548b.description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Integral role in supporting AIM’s data analysis, system control, and database needs. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership. Has/can apply solid financial industry data systems knowledge to support decision and strategy problems in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**


Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business\-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end\-to\-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3\) Cross\-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data \& Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision\-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4\) Technical \& Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit\-for\-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 8–10\+ years in AI, data/analytics, digital, or large\-scale transformation (preferably experience in strategy consulting)
* Demonstrated success in operating with an enterprise mindset and delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives
* Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and influence across technical and business stakeholders to drive alignment and decisions
* Ability to build strong relationships and lead effectively in a matrixed environment without direct authority. Experience aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade\-offs, and timelines
* Experience driving execution across multiple stakeholder groups
* Ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans and delivered outcomes
* Experience driving adoption and change, ensuring solutions are embedded and delivering business value
* Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, make timely decisions, and navigate ambiguity confidently
* Experience leading large\-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and optimize execution

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Data Science or related field)

30f46db3.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
30f46db3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 The Mastercard Core Payments \- Network \& Digital Payment Services (part of Product and Engineering) team is looking for a Lead Technical Program Manager to drive delivery to move our eCommerce product and platform strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. You will manage the implementation of multiple projects/programs ensuring product/engineering strategy goals and requirements are delivered with quality.
   

  

 As Lead TPM, you will interact with product managers, software development managers, developers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the Product and Engineering organization to deliver complex projects and programs. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop program execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and balance business needs versus technical constraints.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.
   

  

* Responsible for planning, execution, and delivery, from inception to completion, for an existing technology product or program.
* Proactively manages the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering work though the engineering team and all dependent organizations.
* Reports on progress, ensuring dependencies are covered.
* Operates between teams and architectures overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery


* Plan and manage a group of related technology projects or activities in a coordinated way from inception through successful delivery
* Deep understanding of the design approaches and technologies utilized in your area
* Focus on the customer experience, the build and delivery processes and the problems to be solved
* Work across multiple scrum teams (may be cross\-cutting across products, scrum teams, and/or technologies or work may be vertically focused on a single product or feature set)
* Align dependent organizations and remove/mitigate all blocking issues
* Work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers and customers
* Work with limited guidance, seeking guidance as needed because the product and delivery strategy is defined. The design is not.
* Deep understanding of the business and technical requirements for the solutions being built
* Understand the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who must build, maintain, and operate the system for the life of the system
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs
* Help customers and the engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all of the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.
* Identify, assess, track and mitigate issues and risks at multiple levels
* Write documentation as required
* Partner with industry vendors that provide technology or user experience design components that support our architecture and work with vendors on our implementation plans and roadmaps identifying partnership opportunities to increase our development velocity and our learnings
* Communicate role up of project issues and status in a concise, accurate, and professional manner for senior leadership consumption, escalating blocking issues when appropriate
* Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels
* Work across teams to optimize processes
* Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives


**Skills/Abilities**
* Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
* Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms’ capabilities and underlying technologies.
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
* Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale
* Technical capability to effectively solve software engineering challenges, communicate with engineers, scope technical programs, and identify technical risks.
* Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platform’s capabilities and underlying technologies.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs.
* Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams.
* Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
* Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
* 12\+years technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software


**Education:**
* Bachelors in engineering, computer science or related discipline.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

672c84f4.title: Senior Sage Intacct Consultant / Solution Architect
672c84f4.description:
**About AroundHI Solutions**

AroundHI Solutions is a growing consulting firm supporting businesses across the US and Canada with finance, IT, and operational talent. We partner with organizations to build high\-performing teams and deliver reliable business solutions.

**Job Overview**

We are currently seeking an experienced Consulting Manager / Principal Consultant to lead complex Sage Intacct implementation, optimization, and advisory engagements.

This role is ideal for someone who can act as a senior functional consultant, solution architect, and trusted advisor while also mentoring consultants, supporting pre\-sales activity, and helping improve consulting delivery standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead medium to large Sage Intacct implementation and optimization engagements from discovery through post\-go\-live stabilization
* Serve as the primary functional consultant and trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle
* Facilitate executive discovery sessions, solution workshops, and design reviews
* Build strong relationships with executive sponsors and key stakeholders
* Design scalable Sage Intacct solutions aligned with business requirements
* Lead solution design across reporting, workflows, automation, integrations, and data migration
* Guide testing, cutover, and go\-live readiness
* Manage project scope, schedule, risks, budgets, utilization, and profitability
* Identify scope changes and support change\-order discussions
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget
* Coach and mentor consultants while promoting consistent implementation standards
* Review project deliverables and support consultant onboarding
* Support pre\-sales activity including discovery, demonstrations, implementation scoping, effort estimation, and proposal development
* Review Statements of Work for delivery accuracy and feasibility
* Partner with Customer Success to identify optimization, adoption, renewal, and expansion opportunities
* Help improve implementation methodologies, SOPs, templates, and delivery playbooks
* Collaborate across Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, Solution Consulting, Support, Sage, and marketplace partners

**Requirements**

* Strong hands\-on experience with Sage Intacct
* Proven experience leading Sage Intacct implementations and optimization engagements
* Strong functional consulting and solution design experience
* Experience with reporting, workflows, automation, integrations, and data migration
* Strong project delivery experience across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and resource management
* Experience working directly with executive stakeholders and business leaders
* Strong client\-facing communication and advisory skills
* Experience mentoring consultants or leading delivery teams
* Ability to identify project risks, manage expectations, and drive successful outcomes
* Strong understanding of implementation methodology and delivery best practices
* Experience supporting pre\-sales, scoping, estimation, proposals, or Statements of Work
* Ability to work cross\-functionally across consulting, sales, customer success, and technical teams

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means consistently delivering high\-quality projects, building trusted client relationships, developing stronger consultants, and helping improve the overall consulting organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep Sage Intacct product expertise with strong business judgment, identifies risks early, manages expectations proactively, and keeps teams focused on customer outcomes.

If you are an experienced Sage Intacct consultant who enjoys leading complex implementations, advising clients, and mentoring delivery teams, we would be interested in speaking with you.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

514f0976.description:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers Insurance operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high\-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.


We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.


Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

**What to expect on your journey with us:**

* A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
* A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
* Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
* Continuous learning and development


This position collaborates with business stakeholders, solution engineers, architects and Agile teams to deliver Guidewire configuration and integration solutions that support complex insurance initiatives. The role serves as a subject matter resource for the Guidewire platform, providing system level perspectives and implementing technical solutions aligned with business and architectural objectives.


Key Responsibilities

* Optimizing Guidewire configuration, building reliable integrations using APIs and messaging frameworks
* Improving development and deployment processes through CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Ensures successful technology delivery across lines of business and the enterprise
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.
* Actively participates in Agile and SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand ups, system demos, and retrospectives, delivering committed sprint and PI objectives. No certification required

  

**Requirements**  

* Over 9 years of experience required in a similar role
* Data Architecture \& Governance Experience (PLUS)
* Full English Fluency
* 2Hrs Overlap with US Time zone (Pacific Time) Flexibility


Technical Skills

* Guidewire policy center 9\.0\.5 and 10 development and GOSU language Experience (MUST);
* Policy center Specialization certificate PLUS
* Cloud Policy Center (PLUS)
* PolicyCenter Data model; Guidewire Rating Engine; PolicyCenter Product Model and PolicyCenter integration in GOSU and PCF
* Web Service; Batch and Plugin; \- Advanced (7\+ Years)
* Java (MUST); J2EE; Hibernate; Spring; Spring JPA; SpringBoot; DB2; SQL Server; Oracle; \- Advanced (7\+ Years)
* Production experience, E2E, document gathering, process,

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate and influence
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and resolve complex technical issues
* Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities.
* In\-depth knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns

  

**Benefits**  

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development

**Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures**


By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

* **Personal Data Processing:** The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies.
* **Legal Authorization to Work:** Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated.
* **Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest:** Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.


Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.
