43cd1e57.title: Sr. Principal Engineer – Azure Cloud, Integrations & Platforms
43cd1e57.description:
GSK is a place where outstanding people do amazing things. As a science\-led global healthcare company, we exist to help people do more, feel better, live longer. Our goal is to be one of the most innovative, best performing, and trusted healthcare companies.

  

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Principal Engineer specializing in Azure Cloud Integrations services to drive technical excellence, application ownership, and seamless integration across our enterprise ecosystem. This role demands deep technical expertise in Integration platforms, Cloud architecture, Azure infrastructure services for integrations, Event driven architecture, API Management, along with the ability to partner with Product Management, technical leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and high\-impact solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**1\. Application Ownership \& Technical Leadership**

* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of Azure cloud Integration platform solutions including configurations and customization, ensuring performance, scalability, and security.
* Serve as a design authority, providing architectural guidance for integrations.
Implement and enforce ITMS (IT Management System) controls, ensuring compliance and operational excellence.  
* 

  

**2\. Delivery Oversight \& Vendor Management**

* Oversee end\-to\-end project delivery, working with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely, high\-quality implementations.
* Manage vendor\-led scrum teams, providing technical oversight and governance to align with business objectives.
Define and enforce best practices, coding standards, and security policies across development efforts.  
* 

  

**3\. Azure Cloud Integrations Expertise**

* Architect and develop scalable Azure integrations with enterprise systems using Azure services – API management, Service Bus, Event grid, Functions, Logic Apps, Log Analytics, Monitors \& App insights.
Optimize integrations services across enterprise applications and third\-party applications to ensure seamless data flow and enhance operational efficiency.  
* 

  

**4\. Strategic Partnerships \& Business Alignment**

* Work closely with Product Management and key business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive alignment between engineering teams and enterprise architecture within a federated architecture model.
Influence roadmap decisions by providing technical insights and feasibility assessments.  
* 

  

**5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and Salesforce advancements to drive innovation.
* Implement automation, DevOps best practices, and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate development cycles.
Foster a culture of continuous learning and mentorship within the engineering team.  
* 

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in developing APIs and integration services.
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud based microservices architectures and Azure services (Service Bus, Azure Functions with C\# AND/OR Java, Logic Apps, Azure Monitor \& Event Grid).
* Experience developing scalable, high performant API services \& working with API Management platforms – Kong or Azure/AWS/GCP API gateways.
* Proven ability to design and implement integration services between cloud saas applications, enterprise apps and EDI Integrations.
* Experience managing ITMS controls, security, and compliance in a regulated environment.
* Strong leadership, vendor management, and delivery oversight experience.
* Ability to partner effectively with Product Management and cross\-functional stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business leaders.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Preferable to have Azure certifications (Azure solutions architect expert, Azure developer associate).
* Experience in Pharma, Healthcare, or Life Sciences industries.
Knowledge of AI/GenAI\-powered CRM enhancements and automation tools.  
* 

  

**Skills**

Application Integrations, Application Programming Interface (API) Security, CI/CD, Cloud Engineering, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Data Engineering, Data Integration, Front\-End Development, Internet of Things (IoT), Mobile Development, RESTful API Design, Security System Design, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Version Control, Web Development  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.


People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.


**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.


Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.


**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.


It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.


**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

4a6078ed.title: Senior Manager - SnowFlake Architect
4a6078ed.description:
**Date Posted:**


2026\-09\-24**Country:**


India
**Location:**


IN\-KA\-BENGALURU\-NORTHGATE \~ Sy No 2/2 Venkatala Village \~ SY NO 2/2 VENKATALA VILLAGE, Yelahanka Hobli
**Position Role Type:**


Hybrid
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


What You Will Do \*


Define and implement Snowflake architecture, data models, standards, and best practices aligned with enterprise technology strategy.  

Lead data migration and modernization from legacy/on\-premises platforms to Snowflake and cloud environments.  

Design scalable data ingestion, integration, transformation, and data\-sharing solutions using Snowflake and ETL/ELT technologies.  

Establish data security, access controls, encryption, governance, and compliance standards.  

Optimize Snowflake environments for performance, scalability, availability, and cost efficiency.  

Design and implement data warehouses, data lakes, and modern data platform architectures.  

Provide technical leadership for integrations with systems such as Workday, HR/Payroll platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, and cloud services.  

Develop architecture patterns for batch and real\-time data processing.  

Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, security teams, and enterprise architects to deliver enterprise data solutions.  

Establish standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, monitoring, and lifecycle management.  

Evaluate new Snowflake capabilities and cloud technologies and recommend solutions that improve business value and operational efficiency.  

Provide technical guidance, code/design reviews, mentoring, and architectural oversight to development and data engineering teams.

  

Qualifications You Must Have \*


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.  

12 \-15\+ years of experience in data warehousing, data engineering, and cloud data platforms.  

6 \- 8\+ years of hands\-on experience designing Snowflake solutions.  

Strong expertise in data modeling, and dimensional modeling.  

Experience with ELT/ETL tools such as Matillion with strong knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS, Azure.  

Experience with Python, PL/SQL for data engineering and automation with knowledge of CI/CD, Github, DevOps.  

Experience implementing enterprise security and governance frameworks using Immuta.  

Skilled in data mapping, conversion, transformation, and integration activities to meet third\-party vendor requirements, with experience integrating Snowflake with Workday, Globalview and ADP products.  

Proven track record of contributing to large\-scale project implementations, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.  

Experience with API\-based and cloud\-native integrations.  

Qualifications We Prefer


Snowflake certification such as SnowPro Advanced Architect or equivalent.


Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:


Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.


Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.


Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.


Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.


Requires expert or mastery level knowledge of work area, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience.


May have deep knowledge of project management. Advanced knowledge of related disciplines within work area and ability to identify links and potential impact on projects, programs or systems.


Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years experience


Engineering/Other Technical Positions: Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations.

*RTX adheres to the principles of equal employment. All qualified applications will be given careful consideration without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

4899d22d.description:
**Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest\-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
   

  

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!

If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.

**Job Description:**


RTX Corporation is an Aerospace and Defense company that provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide. It comprises three industry\-leading businesses – Collins Aerospace Systems, Pratt \& Whitney, and Raytheon. Its 185,000 employees enable the company to operate at the edge of known science as they imagine and deliver solutions that push the boundaries in quantum physics, electric propulsion, directed energy, hypersonics, avionics and cybersecurity. The company, formed in 2020 through the combination of Raytheon Company and the United Technologies Corporation aerospace businesses, is headquartered in Arlington, VA.


The following position is to join our RTX Enterprise Services (ES) Strategy and Transformation Team:


This role is responsible for integrating all aspects of the digital sourcing functions into Enterprise Services (ES) Strategy and Transformation initiatives through collaborating and partnering with suppliers, ES leaders, and functional service owners. A key component of the role is to develop supplier capabilities, partnerships and category strategies for enterprise collaboration tools and services.


The ideal candidate will draw from past experience with various software, hardware and labor suppliers and can assist with translating this knowledge via contract negotiations and project management skills to lead the coordination, communication and integration of suppliers to support the achievement of technical, financial and performance objectives. This individual will have an understanding of supplier products/services and develop various strategies to drive year on year cost savings to help RTX meet its bottom line.


An understanding of the end\-to\-end procurement process, from contract negotiations to requisition and PO placement is needed for this role. The successful candidate will have excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to develop effective presentations and present to leadership and peers.

**What You Will Do:**


Specific responsibilities will include but not limited to:  

Drives contract requirements and negotiations, primarily for hardware and labor suppliers related to end user environment, with a concentration on DXC and Dell.  

Assess and onboard new suppliers as needed  

Aligns with Digital IT stakeholders on vendor consolidation activities to drive contract savings  

Develops, manages, and partners with stakeholders on an integrated master schedule of engagements, renewals, RFXs, etc.  

Facilitate supplier performance reviews, benchmarks \& reporting  

Reviews Statements of Work (SOW) documents and ensures sourcing best practices are followed  

Analyze pricing and negotiating complex technology agreements  

Build strong partnerships across various stakeholders (legal, finance, etc.)  

Develop strong supplier relationships to drive effectiveness and value  

Supports the investigation, negotiation and favorable resolution of disputes with suppliers  

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment  

Ability to proactively identify and resolve problems efficiently and effectively  

Develop executive level analysis \& presentations  

Work with Stakeholders on benchmarking industry trends and changes, as requested.  

Partner with key stakeholders on strategic vendor meetings and strategies.

 **Qualifications You Must Have:**


Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience.
  

Candidates for this role should possess a Bachelor’s Degree with an MBA preferred.  

Experience with sourcing roles and functions, including creating sourcing roadmaps, developing category strategies, licensing/asset management, risk management, and requirement change management  

Expert understanding of all major Dell products, including all end user \& server hardware products and product roadmaps.  

Expertise in drafting, negotiating and interpreting sophisticated commercial agreements; Excellent negotiations and sourcing skills with understanding of different contract types  

Build a supplier strategy for software contracts with the ability to manage licensing, maintenance, and support requirements  

Collaboration with stakeholders in peer organizations and other operational areas to balance supplier requirements, customer experience and affordability  

Demonstrated ability to understand financial information, budgets and program performance and develop strategies and business cases to improve performance in these areas  

Business acumen to connect technical requirements and concerns to contract performance  

Hands\-on experience with Ariba (or similar product) to manage sourcing and contract activities (P2P)

 **Qualifications We Prefer:**


Minimum of 10 years Consulting, Sourcing and Procurement Management with at least 3 years in Digital IT preferred  

Strong project management skills and ability to convert requirements into executable strategies, and ability to develop and manage an integrated master schedule (PMP® a plus)  

Ability to effectively work with and communicate with all levels of management and individual contributors  

Ability to develop effective presentations and documents used for leadership reviews.


Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:


Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.


Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.


Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.


Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

 Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. * Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long\-term business objectives.
* Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.

* Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
* Tracks leading\-edge and emerging technologies.
* Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.

a3046184.title: Salesforce Data Cloud (Genie) Consultant
a3046184.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 5\+ years
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Salesforce Data Cloud (Genie) Consultant  

  

  

Job Details
  

* **Employment Type:** Contract
* **Work Mode:** Remote
* **Location:** Offshore
* **Total Experience Required:** 5 to 8 years
* **Relevant Experience Required:** 2\+ years of hands\-on implementation experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (Genie/CDP)
* **Mandatory Certification:** Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant

  

Job Summary
  

We are seeking a **Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant** to design and unify multi\-source architecture into a single, cohesive customer profile. The ideal candidate will orchestrate complex ingestion pipelines, manage identity resolution rules, and power downstream personalization, analytics, and real\-time AI initiatives.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Design and configure data ingestion streams** to bring data into Salesforce Data Cloud from disparate sources, including core Salesforce orgs, Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, MuleSoft, and web/mobile SDKs.
* **Architect Data Model Objects (DMOs)** and execute complex data mapping from Data Source Objects (DSOs) to standard and custom Customer 360 data models.
* **Establish Identity Resolution rules** to deduplicate, reconcile, and consolidate fragmented customer touchpoints into a unified customer profile.
* **Create calculated insights and streaming insights** using SQL\-based definitions to calculate real\-time and batch operational metrics.
* **Build and activate segmented audiences** across various marketing, service, and external channels via native activation targets and enterprise APIs.
* **Collaborate with enterprise data teams** to ensure data governance, privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and appropriate data retention policies.
* **Monitor ingestion health**, performance bottlenecks, identity resolution match rates, and activation run statuses to ensure maximum reliability.

  

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **5 to 8 years** of enterprise data engineering, data warehousing, or CRM consulting experience, with **2\+ dedicated years** deploying Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly Genie / Salesforce CDP).
* **Strong proficiency** in advanced SQL for data querying and analysis, along with a deep familiarity with the Salesforce core platform framework.
* **Deep understanding** of big data concepts, ETL/ELT pipelines, relational database design, semantic data modeling, and identity management strategies.
* **Mandatory certification:** Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant.

  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* **Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Consultant** or **Salesforce Certified Administrator** certification.
* **Prior experience** implementing data platform solutions alongside external data warehouses like Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.

9d92e6aa.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
9d92e6aa.description:
Your main job is to Understand our systems, make sound technical decisions, and improve business outcomes through hands\-on work with
 **our platforms and customers.** 



**Why we are looking for this role?** 

 We are growing fast, and so are our technical challenges.
 



 We need someone who can simplify systems, make smart technology decisions, and keep our software, infrastructure, and hardware scalable and maintainable. 
 



 This role extends beyond our internal platforms. You'll also work directly with customers through nobleconsul.com, helping organizations evaluate technologies, understand trade\-offs, and develop practical technology strategies that solve real business problems.
 



**We expect you to understand the business impact of every technical decision, not just whether a tool works. You should compare alternatives, evaluate trade\-offs in cost, speed, risk, scalability, and maintainability, and remain open to better options whenever they create more value for the business.** 




**We move fast. Many changes happen daily.** 



**Responsibilities** 
* **Always list options, compare trade\-offs, and recommend the best solution.**
* Review existing systems and identify what should be kept, improved, simplified, or removed.
* Prioritize technical work based on business value, impact, cost, and speed.
* **Work directly with customers** 
 to understand their requirements and business goals.
* **Help customers determine what they actually need,** 
 not just what they ask.
* Participate in architecture, infrastructure, and technology decisions.
* Occasionally get involved in implementation, troubleshooting, and technical delivery.
* Continuously improve internal systems, processes, and automation.
* Keep solutions simple, practical, and effective.


 Requirements
 * **Excellent communication skills in English.**
* **Requires hands\-on experience reviewing the full infrastructure and assessing whether it makes sense.**
* **Hands\-on engineering experience (especially in Linux, LLM, and AI Agent).**
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Able to evaluate multiple options and explain trade\-offs clearly.
* Experience designing software systems, infrastructure, or cloud solutions.
* Comfortable speaking with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership mentality.
* Practical mindset focused on results rather than unnecessary processes.


 Current Technologies
 1. AI Agent orchestrations
2. GPUs (AMD, NVIDIA, Huawei, Biren, Intel...)
3. LLMs models (vllm, ollama...)
4. Linux


 Compensation
 * Base salary.
* Additional commission for customer consultation and successful project engagements.

ed455671.title: Private Cloud AI Solutions Architect
ed455671.description:
Private Cloud AI Solutions Architect  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**Global Sales** at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

 ***Job Family Definition:***


Responsible for architecting solutions that will achieve customer business outcomes either within a specific technical domain, or across the broader company portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third\-party components (e.g. software and integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.

***Management Level Definition:***


Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.

 **What you’ll do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Demonstrates in\-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
* Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
* Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long\-term business objectives.
* Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
* Translates outcome\-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.
* Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
* Tracks leading\-edge and emerging technologies.
* Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
* Participates in deep\-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Produces in\-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.
* Develops, configures, and right sizes an optimal workload solution, balancing cost, scope, scale, boundaries, and benefits to deliver superior value and increase the win rate.
* Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.
* Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up\-selling, and cross\-selling opportunities) within the account.
* Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience:***

* First\-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.
* 8–12 years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling
* Knowledge\-based as well as 1\+ experienced\-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs\-of\-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.
* Advanced ability to translate aaS and complete ecosystem, differentiated value, solutions, and workloads and ability to prioritize aaS offerings and consumption models that will achieve the customer’s outcomes and greatest return.
* Advanced understanding of aaS business model variations.
* Advanced ability to collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as needed to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates advanced discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point\-of\-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Advanced business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage— with an understanding of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles, including typical KPIs important to, CxOs and line\-of\-business (LOB) executives; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.
* Advanced company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.
* Advanced resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
* Hands on experience with one or more products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
* Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
* Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Advanced project and time management knowledge or experience with excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.
* Advanced knowledge of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization, understanding of the company's go\-to\-market strategy.
* Advanced understanding of Geo application of company’s go\-to\-market strategy as it relates to partners; has broad knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals.
* Advanced strategic planning and account planning skills, as well as being an expert at using business and technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems.

**Accessibility**

  

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

  

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

003fd915.title: Cloud Architect
003fd915.description:
Absolutely. For Indeed, I would make it **clear, keyword\-rich, and candidate\-friendly**, while keeping the detailed technical requirements from the Singlife JD.

Cloud Architect – AWS

**Location:** Remote  
**Experience:** 7\+ Years  
**Industry:** Insurance / Financial Services / Technology

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced **Cloud Architect** to join the **Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE)** team for a leading financial services organization in Singapore.

This is a **hands\-on Cloud Architecture and Engineering role**. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing enterprise\-scale cloud solutions while also translating architecture into working implementations using automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD and modern cloud engineering practices.

The role will involve working closely with **Application Teams, CloudOps, SRE, DBA, Security, Enterprise Architecture and Business Stakeholders** to drive cloud transformation, modernization, security, governance and cost optimization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cloud Architecture \& Design**

* Design and implement cloud\-native architectures for enterprise and digital workloads.
* Define and maintain cloud reference architectures, reusable patterns and engineering standards.
* Review solution architectures covering scalability, reliability, high availability, performance, security and cost optimization.
* Drive adoption of AWS cloud best practices across projects and platforms.
* Partner with enterprise architects, business stakeholders and engineering teams to align technology solutions with business objectives.
* Support cloud transformation and modernization initiatives.

**Hands\-on Cloud Engineering**

* Design and implement **GitLab CI/CD pipelines** and automation frameworks.
* Build, configure and manage AWS infrastructure and services including:
* EC2
* ECS / EKS
* Lambda
* ELB
* RDS
* EFS / FSx
* S3
* KMS
* Secrets Manager
* EventBridge
* CloudWatch
* IAM
* Develop Infrastructure\-as\-Code using **Terraform and CloudFormation**.
* Develop automation and scripts using **Python, Ansible, Bash and/or PowerShell**.
* Implement and support container\-based deployments and Kubernetes platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex application and infrastructure issues across production and non\-production environments.
* Perform root cause analysis and recommend preventive actions.

**Cloud Security \& Governance**

* Design secure AWS cloud architectures following security best practices.
* Implement least\-privilege access, encryption, secrets management and identity/access controls.
* Implement and support cloud security controls including:
* IAM
* KMS
* CloudTrail
* GuardDuty
* Security monitoring
* Network security controls
* Ensure cloud solutions comply with security and governance standards.
* Work with Security and Risk teams to address audit findings and compliance requirements.
* Support cloud governance, policy implementation and cloud guardrails.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **7\+ years of experience** in Cloud Architecture and/or Cloud Engineering roles.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with **AWS**.
* Strong experience with AWS services including **EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, ELB, RDS, EFS, FSx, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, EventBridge, CloudWatch and IAM**.
* Strong understanding of AWS networking:
* VPC
* Transit Gateway
* Direct Connect
* Routing
* Network security controls
* Strong experience with **Kubernetes and container platforms**.
* Hands\-on experience with **GitLab CI/CD**.
* Strong Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with **Terraform and CloudFormation**.
* Strong scripting/automation experience with **Python, Ansible, Bash and/or PowerShell**.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, secrets management and access controls.
* Experience designing scalable, resilient, highly available, secure and cost\-optimized architectures.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving and performance\-tuning skills.
* Experience with production environments and complex technical issue resolution.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* AWS certifications such as:
* AWS Solutions Architect
* AWS DevOps Engineer
* AWS Security Specialty
* Experience with **AWS Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, AgentCore or Generative AI services**.
* Experience with **Grafana, Prometheus and CloudWatch**.
* Exposure to **OCI / multi\-cloud environments**.
* Experience in **high\-availability or regulated environments**.
* Experience in financial services, banking or insurance environments.
* Experience with cloud transformation, modernization and governance.

**Key Skills / Keywords**

**AWS \| Cloud Architect \| Cloud Engineering \| AWS Architecture \| EC2 \| ECS \| EKS \| Lambda \| RDS \| S3 \| EFS \| FSx \| ELB \| KMS \| IAM \| CloudWatch \| CloudTrail \| GuardDuty \| Secrets Manager \| EventBridge \| VPC \| Transit Gateway \| Direct Connect \| Kubernetes \| Terraform \| CloudFormation \| GitLab CI/CD \| Python \| Ansible \| Bash \| PowerShell \| DevOps \| Infrastructure as Code \| Cloud Security \| Cloud Governance \| Cloud Migration \| Cloud Transformation \| Grafana \| Prometheus \| OCI**

**About the Role**

This opportunity is suited to a **hands\-on AWS Cloud Architect** who can operate across both **architecture and engineering** — someone who can design enterprise cloud solutions and also implement, automate, secure, troubleshoot and optimize those solutions.

Pay: ₹671,712\.14 \- ₹5,011,658\.27 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 7\+ years of professional experience in Cloud Architecture and/or Cloud Engineering?
* Cloud Architect experience in years
* Are you comfortable working remotely while supporting a Singapore\-based client/team and Singapore working hours?
* The budget given is max 50 LPA, mention your current, expected salary
* Will be able to join immediately, or in max 30 days' notice

Work Location: Remote

908bc404.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
908bc404.description:
**Salesforce Technical Architect \- Bangalore**
-----------------------------------------------


Johnson Controls is looking for a Salesforce Technical Architect in Bangalore to design scalable, secure Salesforce solutions and guide technical delivery across the platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


In this role, you will own the technical architecture for complex Salesforce initiatives, translating business needs into practical, well\-designed solutions. You will work closely with technical teams and stakeholders to shape integrations, data design, security, and deployment practices that support long\-term platform success.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the design and architecture of scalable Salesforce solutions for complex business requirements.
* Translate business needs into well\-architected technical solutions aligned to strategic goals.
* Mentor Salesforce tech leads, developers, data analysts, and integration developers.
* Conduct technical design reviews and code reviews to support quality and maintainability.
* Architect integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
* Define the system architecture landscape, identify gaps, and deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Implement platform security best practices for authentication, data sharing, and encryption.
* Collaborate with DevOps, QA, and Change Management teams for deployments and performance.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

* Own outcomes with accountability, security, and integrity, while making sound technical decisions that stand up to enterprise use.
* Stay close to the work, remove blockers early, and keep the focus on solutions that matter for the customer.
* Use candor, root\-cause thinking, and continuous improvement to strengthen the platform over time.
* Win as one team by collaborating with developers, QA, DevOps, change management, and business stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\-12 years of experience with Salesforce platform architecture and development across multiple cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of scalable, performance\-driven solutions and design patterns for large data volumes.
* Deep knowledge of data modeling, governance, and management within Salesforce.
* Experience architecting integrations with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
* Experience with authentication and authorization, including SSO.
* Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation tools.

21f4debf.title: FHIR Integration Architect
21f4debf.description:
**About the Role** 

  
 





 We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full\-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design\-and\-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.
 

  
 




  





**What You'll Own** 

  
 




**Architecture \& Solution Design** 

  
 



* **Own** 

 the end\-to\-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event\-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12\) beyond the Cerner pilot.
* **Make** 

 build\-vs\-buy and vendor decisions (self\-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Design** 

 the architecture against HIPAA\-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least\-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre\-launch retrofit.
* **Validate** 

 the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR\-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.



  





**Technical Leadership \& Delivery** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 a cross\-functional engineering pod — full\-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.
* **Translate** 

 the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi\-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.
* **Own** 

 technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.



  





**Integration, Standards \& Compliance** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.
* **Define and enforce** 

 conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production\-ready.
* **Partner with** 

 compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit\-trail requirements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* 8\+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3\+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.
* Deep, hands\-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).
* Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.
* Hands\-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi\-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.
* Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event\-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.
* Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.



  





**Strongly Preferred** 

  
 



* Direct, hands\-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.
* Experience with Keycloak or another open\-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.
* Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR\-based prior authorization workflows.
* Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.
* Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near\-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already\-mature enterprise integration group.
* Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.



  





**Tech Stack You'll Work With** 

  
 




**Layer** 

  
 




**Technologies** 

  
 




**FHIR \& integration standards** 

  
 





 FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future\-facing) 
 




**FHIR server** 

  
 





 HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi\-tenant partitioning 
 




**Identity** 

  
 





 Keycloak, custom SMART\-launch extension (SPI) 
 




**Cloud / infra** 

  
 





 AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch 
 




**IaC / delivery** 

  
 





 Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker 
 




**Target EHR (Phase 1\)** 

  
 





 Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart\-toolbar launch) 
 




**Conformance testing** 

  
 





 ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

0648357c.title: Associate Manager - Brand Solutions & Client Servicing
0648357c.description:
**About Ampverse DMI** 




  





 Ampverse, Asia’s largest ecosystem of gaming and entertainment communities and IPs, has joined forces with DMI Group in India, forming a strategic joint venture. The primary objective of this partnership is to bolster the esports and gaming ecosystem in the country and create a dedicated platform to nurture and promote college esports talents. Leveraging Ampverse’s expertise in building esports and gaming communities and DMI Finance’s financial prowess, the joint venture aspires to revolutionize the gaming ecosystem in India. They plan to achieve this by developing a series of Gaming IPs including a national collegiate Esports platform, hosting on\-ground activations, forging partnerships with influential gaming figures, and establishing mentorship programs to nurture up\-and\-coming college Esports talent. The first co\-developed IP, College Rivals \- Esports Series was launched in August 2023\. Central to their mission is the idea of fostering inclusivity, diversity, and excellence within the Indian Gaming community. They aim to provide opportunities to a wide range of talents, irrespective of backgrounds or identities, with the goal of empowering the gaming community as a whole. The decision to focus on India is backed by the rapid growth of Gaming within the country as well as the revolutionary growth of the Creator's Economy. 
 



  





**About Rivals** 




  





 Ampverse DMI Rivals is a full\-service, next \-generation marketing agency powered by Ampverse DMI, revolutionising how brands and new\-gen audiences connect in the rapidly expanding and ever\-changing gaming space across Southeast Asia, India, and MENA. Through leveraging 1st party premier gaming media assets, top influencers, and creative talent, Ampverse DMI Rivals drives growth for leading game publishers and global brands such as Garena, Tencent, EA Sports, Coca\-Cola, Nestle, Huawei, Burger King, and Red Bull. Rivals pushes the boundaries of engagement and innovation, shaping the future of brand performance and success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Brand Solutions \& Client Servicing professional who can sit at the intersection of brands, creativity, gaming and execution.
 



 The role will involve understanding client objectives, developing innovative solutions around Ampverse DMI’s gaming and esports IPs, building compelling pitches, and managing client relationships from the initial conversation through execution.
 



 You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Creative and Esports Operations teams to turn brand objectives into engaging campaigns that connect with gaming and Gen Z audiences.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Brand Solutions \& Strategy** 




  




* Develop creative and strategic solutions that align brand objectives with Ampverse DMI’s IPs, esports teams and gaming platforms.
* Understand client objectives, target audiences and brand positioning to develop relevant gaming and esports\-led activation ideas.
* Research brands, categories and market trends to identify potential partnership opportunities and develop customized solutions.
* Create detailed, client\-specific pitch decks that clearly communicate the campaign idea, proposed IP/platform, audience proposition, activation strategy and expected outcomes.
* Develop innovative engagement concepts across gaming, esports, content, creators, events and other relevant platforms.
* Stay updated on emerging trends across gaming, esports, digital media, entertainment and Gen Z culture and translate these trends into actionable opportunities for brands.



  





**Client Servicing \& Relationship Management** 




  




* Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the campaign lifecycle, from initial discussions through execution and closure.
* Understand client requirements, timelines and expectations and translate them into clear internal briefs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies and brand stakeholders.
* Lead regular client communication, campaign updates, feedback discussions and status meetings.
* Proactively identify client needs and opportunities for deeper engagement, repeat campaigns and potential upsell/cross\-sell opportunities.
* Ensure timely resolution of client queries and coordinate with internal teams to keep projects on track.
* Manage client expectations while balancing creative ambition, timelines, budgets and operational feasibility.



  





**Cross\-Functional Execution** 




  




* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Creative and Esports Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of campaigns.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders and ensure that campaign deliverables, timelines and responsibilities are clearly defined.
* Support campaign execution by ensuring the final output remains aligned with the approved client strategy and objectives.
* Track project progress, flag potential risks or delays proactively and drive teams towards timely closure.
* Participate in post\-campaign reviews and use client feedback and campaign learnings to improve future solutions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 3–6 years of experience in Brand Solutions, Client Servicing, Branded Content, Integrated Marketing, Media, Advertising, Sponsorships or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of brand marketing and client requirements, with the ability to translate business objectives into creative solutions.
* Experience in developing pitch decks, campaign proposals and brand activation concepts.
* Strong client\-facing and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
* A proactive approach with strong ownership and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively with creative, sales, marketing and operations teams.
* Strong understanding of digital media, content, gaming, esports and/or youth culture would be an advantage.



  





**Who Would Be a Great Fit?** 




  





 Someone who can move comfortably between strategy, creativity and execution — understanding what a brand wants, figuring out how gaming can help deliver it, pitching the idea convincingly, and then making sure the client has a great experience from pitch to campaign completion. If you're someone who enjoys building ideas, presenting to brands, solving client problems and bringing campaigns to life, we'd love to hear from you.

FEQ327R324
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI\-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long\-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You will help our customers achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
   

  

 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build\-vs\-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands\-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in\-house tools, and third\-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks\-inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.


**What We Look For**
* 12\+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre\-sales / consulting role.
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands\-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end\-to\-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital\-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer\-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

We want you to fit in—with an inclusive culture, focus on work\-life fit and well\-being, and a supportive, connected environment; but we also want you to stand out—with opportunities to have a strategic impact, innovate, and take the risks necessary to make your mark.
   

  

**Who you'll work with:**

Whether focused on sales excellence, delivery transformation, quality and risk management, contracts management, finance and operations, capability build, communications and change management, knowledge management, marketing and market intelligence, or other activities, these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people can effectively serve clients every day.
   

  

**Work you'll do:**
 The professional will work with India colleagues and senior leaders across Operate. The Manager leads delivery for defined solution architecture and presales workstreams—translating agreed standards into day\-to\-day delivery plans and controls, coordinating with cross\-functional partners across Sales, Pricing, Delivery, and Business Intelligence workstreams to resolve issues and implement improvements, coaching junior team members, and providing clear status reporting and escalations to leadership. The Manager is the hands\-on solution architect who owns execution quality end\-to\-end across active programmes and pursuits.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cloud \& Infrastructure Design: Designs and validates Azure IaaS/PaaS solutions for active delivery programmes; architects multi\-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and hybrid cloud environments; delivers compute, storage, and network designs to agreed standards; reports on delivery status, risks, and release readiness; applies FinOps cost controls within programme guardrails.
* Security \& Data Architecture: Applies security architecture patterns (IAM, controls, secure\-by\-design) to active delivery; designs data models using Snowflake, Databricks, and vector DBs; ensures data sovereignty and privacy compliance per Deloitte policies; maintains architecture models and reports issues and risks to leadership.
* AI Architecture \& Solution Delivery: Designs and coordinates delivery (with Dev teams) of AI/GenAI solutions (RAG, copilots, agentic workflows) within active programmes; implements LLM orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP, A2A; executes AI lifecycle — data prep, model deployment, observability; creates reusable AI artefacts and reports status, risks, and release readiness.
* AI Innovation \& Enablement: Infuses active proposals and delivery programmes with GenAI accelerators, agentic AI frameworks, and copilots; evaluates new AI technologies; builds POC\-to\-commercial AI assets; contributes reusable AI IP and patterns to the practice asset library.
* RFP, Bid \& Solution Narrative: Translates RFP requirements into scalable, credible solution architectures; owns solution narrative across EOI/RFI/RFP responses and orals for $10M\+ opportunities; builds compelling decks, narratives, and pricing models; leads discovery workshops and manages multiple simultaneous pursuits against agreed timelines.
* Commercial \& Pricing Acumen: Builds defensible pricing models (T\&M, fixed\-price, managed services, outcome\-based); defines SLA/OLA constructs and high\-level estimates tied to ROI for POC/MVP/commercial models; creates transition plans and identifies commercial risks; reports commercial status to leadership.
* Solution Design \& Reusable IP: Creates compelling solution architectures using Figma, Miro, and PowerPoint; builds and maintains reusable artefacts, reference architectures, and POVs; presents to senior stakeholders and CXOs; turns capabilities into differentiated, repeatable offerings based on real market demand.
* Stakeholder \& Client Engagement: Engages cross\-functionally with member\-firm business and client\-facing teams; navigates C\-level to engineering conversations; leads discovery workshops; provides clear status reporting and escalations; collaborates with Sales, Pricing, and delivery teams on pursuit coordination.
* Team Coaching \& Capability Build: Coaches junior solution architects and team members on day\-to\-day solutioning, delivery, and consulting skills; provides feedback and guidance within active programmes; contributes to sales enablement via reusable templates and messaging; operates effectively in virtual, multi\-timezone team environments.
* Communication \& Thought Leadership: Produces executive\-grade documents — PPT decks, Excel models, Power BI dashboards; simplifies complex architectures for non\-technical audiences; writes clear, concise, compelling proposals and status reports; contributes to POVs and reusable messaging; reports delivery progress accurately and on time.
* Operating Model \& Delivery Governance: Executes delivery against agreed plans and controls; identifies and mitigates RACDs throughout the development lifecycle; maintains architecture models per Deloitte privacy and data sovereignty policies; manages competing priorities across multiple countries and time zones; reports status and escalates issues clearly.


**Requisite Core Skills**
* Experience in $1M\+ services deals (multi\-tower or multi\-year preferred); ability to build defensible pricing models (T\&M, fixed\-price, managed services, outcome\-based).
* Hands\-on understanding of services delivery including SDLC, cloud migrations, modernisation, architecture patterns, and infra operations.
* Experience designing or positioning solutions with AI integration, agent workflows, automation, or model\-enhanced apps (Claude / Copilots, RAG systems, intelligent workflows).
* Deep end\-to\-end understanding of architecture standards and platform solution development; experience with Microsoft Teams, Dynamics 365, O365 / Azure services.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Azure IaaS and PaaS services; knowledge of Agile Development, CMMI, SDLCM, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF), and Microsoft Solutions Framework (MSF).
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, BOT Framework, RPA, and virtual agents; knowledge of Python, AI stacks, NLP, and Data preprocessing.
* Familiarity with modern data and AI stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, vector DBs, LLM orchestration frameworks); hands\-on experience with one or more major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).

* Strong core consulting skills—research, financial analysis, logical structuring and storyboarding; advanced skills with MS Suite (PowerPoint, Excel), O365, SharePoint, and MS Teams.

 As a Solution Architect specializing in Data Platforms, you design end\-to\-end Big Data Solutions across various platforms and manage large data repositories. You leverage expertise in industry standards, best practices, and leading technologies to create tailored data solutions for clients.

 Master's Degree

* HADOOP Framework and Ecosystem: Experience with HADOOP Framework, Ecosystem, MapReduce, and Data on Containers (data in OpenShift).

ba98a40c.description:
FEQ327R421
   

  

**Mission**
 The
 **Solutions Architect (Genie)** 
 team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go\-to\-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position
 *in\-depth* 
 the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.
   

  

 The Solutions Architect (Genie) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product\-line in a meaningful way.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high\-impact engagement strategies across your territory.
* As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.
* Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer\-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.
* Influence product roadmap by translating field\-derived, data\-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams
* Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier\-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission\-critical environments.


**Competencies \& Responsibilities**
* 6\+ years in a customer\-facing, pre\-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high\-level data strategy and product adoption.
* Credibility in influencing analytics, BI, and natural\-language / agentic AI products, with the market insight needed to shape and prioritize roadmap capabilities.
* Deep understanding of AI governance across different tools and models and ability to guide customers through security blockers and concerns
* Proven ability to co\-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross\-functional effort across GTM and R\&D teams.
* Experience architecting governed analytics solutions that integrate semantic models, data warehouses, and metric layers within broader Lakehouse and AI ecosystems.
* Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third\-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes.
* Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem\-solving using SQL and Python.
* Hands\-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, AI, ML, governance, semantic modeling, natural\-language analytics, and streaming.
* Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.
