fa37f0b9.description:
This role requires you to work in a shift pattern or non\-standard work hours as required.This may include weekend work.
   

  

 In most instances,this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process hours as required.This may include weekend work.
   

  

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* Experience reading or debugging code with one of the following: Java, C, C\+\+, .NET, Python, Shell, Perl, or JavaScript.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting network infrastructure devices.
* Experience using techniques such as packet capture/packet analysis, artificial packet creation, load testing, and traffic path analysis to troubleshoot network latency, packet loss, and other performance issues at the packet level.
* Experience with any of these cloud solutions: SQL database administration, Google App Engine, open source software communities, Cloud networking solutions, or distributed computing technology.
* System/network administrator level knowledge of Linux/Unix systems.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, Routing, VPNs, VLANs, Peering, Load Balancing, etc.).
* Knowledge of basic web technologies (HTTP, HTML, DNS, TCP, etc.).


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to other support teams.You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers make the switch to Google Cloud.
   

  

 In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and coding/scripting. You will make products easier to adopt by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Your team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for customers issues.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the customer’s problems through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop knowledge of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, determining the root cause for customer reported issues, and building tools for faster diagnosis.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Understand customer issues and advocate for their needs with cross\-functional teams including product and engineering teams to find ways to improve the product, and drive high\-quality production.
* Work as part of a team of Engineers/Consultants that globally ensure 24 hour customer support. This will include a need to sometimes work non\-standard work hours or shifts.

404e275e.title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
404e275e.description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
 This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
   

  

 The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.


**Skills**
* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.

386e2b48.title: Sr. Program Manager, NPS
386e2b48.description:
**About the Role**
==================


TELUS Digital is launching a company\-wide Net Promoter Score (NPS) program across our Customer Experience, Trust \& Safety, and AI Data Solutions accounts. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own this program in its entirety; defining the strategy and operating approach, leading the launch, and driving the insight and action agenda that follows.


This is a senior, high\-ownership role. You will set the direction for how TELUS Digital listens to its clients at scale: shaping the program's design, strategy and governance, aligning operations, commercial, AI, and data teams behind it, owning executive\-level reporting, and converting client feedback into strategies that drive measurable improvement. You will be the recognized owner of the program with significant executive attention, trusted to lead from the front and make the calls that keep it moving.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Own the NPS program end to end, its strategy, operating approach, and governance across CX, Trust \& Safety, and AI accounts, from design and launch through recurring quarterly cycles.
* Define and continuously evolve the program's methodology, survey approach, and roadmap, setting the standard for how TELUS Digital captures and acts on client sentiment at scale.
* Lead and influence cross\-functional teams ie operations, commercial, AI, data, and survey platform. Driving alignment and decision\-making across senior stakeholders rather than simply coordinating execution.
* Own executive engagement and reporting: shape the narrative for senior leadership, lead launch\-window updates, and set the cadence and content of recurring performance reporting.
* Direct the analysis of survey results by identifying the themes that matter, interpret trends, and translate insights into global action plans, holding teams accountable for follow\-through and measurable outcomes.
* Act as the senior point of accountability for commercial and operations primes across all in\-scope accounts, setting expectations for detractor response, response\-rate performance, and client escalation handling.
* Establish and govern the program's operating model, data integrity standards, and documentation, ensuring it is repeatable, auditable, and trusted by leadership.
* Champion automation and AI\-enabled workflows, shaping how technology is leveraged to scale the program, accelerate insight generation, and increase its strategic value over time.
* Anticipate risks and remove blockers proactively, making decisions independently to keep a complex program on track.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* 8\+ years of experience in program or project management, with a track record of driving execution across complex, multi\-team programs.
* English Level: B1 high or above
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including experience crafting and delivering executive\-level narratives, updates, and presentations.
* Proven experience leading programs or large\-scale projects end to end, ideally in customer experience, insights, operations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading and influencing cross\-functional teams to drive alignment and decision\-making in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to turn survey and feedback data into clear strategic insight and action.
* Track record of managing and earning the confidence of senior and executive stakeholders.
* Familiarity with survey and BI tooling and the broader feedback/CRM ecosystem (e.g., AskNicely, Looker, Salesforce, Google Workspace).
* Able to work core **North American business hours**.

**Core Competencies**
=====================


We are seeking a Senior Program Manager who can lead independently and manage stakeholder relationships with confidence. The following competencies are essential:

* Structures ambiguity into clear plans; analyzes data and feedback to surface the themes and actions that matter most.
* Communicates clearly and tailors messaging to the audience and anchors it to clear asks and deadlines.
* Anticipates needs, removes blockers, and takes initiative without waiting to be directed; comfortable being the single point of accountability.
* Builds trust across commercial, operations, data, and leadership teams, and coordinates stakeholders toward a shared outcome.
* Senior\-Level Thinking, usingsound judgment to lead from the front in a team with many junior members; sets direction rather than waiting for it.

* Experience delivering and supporting a major software release
* Certification in SAFe, Agile Leadership, ITIL
* Excellent balance of interpersonal, organizational, and technical skills
* Managing relationships with key partners or vendors
* Ability to evangelize and represent a technical community
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects
* Effective working and partnering with executive level staff
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and create order out of chaos
* Experience managing and tracking budgets
* Experience as a software engineering manager
* Proven experience in leading globally distributed teams


**What We Think Makes Us Special**
 Esper is a fast\-growing, well\-funded company where everyone matters and you can see your impact daily. We trust our teammates and offer intense ownership and therefore accountability. We’re inventing the future and building something special. The team really enjoys what we do and cares about your input. We don’t hire just to fill a spot, we want you to make a difference.

a0ea95b7.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
a0ea95b7.description:
We are fueled by a moral imperative to advance mankind, and it all begins with our people, our product, and our purpose. Passion isn’t something we turn on and off; it’s woven into everything we do. If you thrive in high\-challenge environments, are inspired by exceptional teammates, and are driven to grow beyond what you thought possible, MX is where you belong.
   

  

 Come build the future with us. Join an award\-winning company that isn’t just shaping the financial industry, but transforming it in ways that create meaningful, lasting impact for millions of people.
   

  

****Job Summary****
 We are looking for a strong program leader and strategic operator who can autonomously execute complex enterprise initiatives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. You will wear multiple hats (Technical Program Manager, Agile Coach, Process Designer, Storyteller, and Systems Thinker) to drive critical Financial Product initiatives at MX while partnering with engineering and product leadership to align on high\-impact outcomes and scalable architectures.
   

  

 From day one, you will influence both product strategy and technical execution to help us build and improve our platform while scaling the organization itself. You will bring expertise in best\-in\-class frameworks for work intake, prioritization, SDLC optimization, team management, and decision\-making, along with the ability to navigate technical trade\-offs, increase developer velocity, and create clarity across ambiguous problems.
   

  

 If you are a creative problem\-solver with a passion for optimizing processes, scaling businesses through analytical and general management skills, and building through sane, compassionate collaboration, this role is for you.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Program Leadership \& Delivery: Communicate goals, roles, and outcomes; drive delivery on time, within scope, and on budget. Own performance, scalability, and reliability targets for releases. Manage multiple simultaneous initiatives with time\-sensitive constraints. Demonstrate financial acumen in budget planning, resource allocation, and P\&L awareness.
* Requirements \& Strategic Planning: Translate high\-level business needs into actionable technical roadmaps and API contracts. Develop program\-level and product/technology roadmaps that align cross\-functional dependencies. Inform executive decisions with data\-backed resource and risk analysis.
* Risk, Transparency, \& Governance: Establish proactive risk detection frameworks using RAID logs and mitigation strategies. Track and publish program health dashboards, including executive summaries and detailed drill\-downs. Drive data\-informed decision reviews and OKR/KPI governance.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Influence: Build effective networks across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and InfoSec. Simplify complex challenges into pragmatic plans and tell compelling program narratives that align diverse stakeholders. Navigate matrixed\-management environments with empathy and influence.
* Process Design, Coaching, \& Technical Governance: Design enterprise\-wide processes that increase successful program delivery and adoption. Mentor teams on software delivery best practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall). Facilitate technical design reviews and partner on architectural trade\-offs between scalability and speed\-to\-market. Lead structured change rollouts and drive adoption. Develop and coach technical program managers to elevate the TPM discipline across the organization.
* Tools \& Systems Mastery: Establish Atlassian Suite governance and drive best practices in Jira Software, JPD, and JSM. Create data visualizations that translate complex information for executive and team audiences. Identify and implement AI\-assisted automation to increase team efficiency in reporting, insights generation, and documentation, while staying current on emerging workflows.


****Qualifications****
* 10\+ years of Technical Program Management experience leading large\-scale software delivery in a New Product Development environment.
* 3\+ years of experience leading or mentoring other technical program managers.
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end SDLC for complex distributed systems.
* Atlassian Suite expertise, ideally having served as a global administrator.
* Expertise in the Scrum framework, with a proven track record of scaling and tailoring agile practices to an organization's maturity level to drive engineering velocity and sprint health.
* Comfort operating in high\-ambiguity environments with rapidly evolving priorities.
* Strong bias toward action, with the ability to unblock teams autonomously and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across matrixed teams and build trust with peers at all levels.
* Proven ability to rapidly absorb and synthesize complex technical information, allowing for deep engagement in architectural discussions.


****Advanced Requirements (Optional)****
* Experience with personal financial management or wealth management tools.
* Experience managing AI/ML product development and deployment.
* Ability to navigate technical ambiguity and resolve blockers during zero\-to\-one builds.
* Systems\-thinking mindset with experience in long\-term technical strategy and tech debt reduction.
* Analytical skills to utilize engineering metrics for decision\-making and product insights.
* Bias toward building automated inspection mechanisms and technical governance processes.
* 3\+ years of direct experience in a technical role (SWE, SRE, DevOps, or Systems Architect).
* Experience leading systemic change management within an engineering organization.
* PMP and CSM certifications.


**Compensation**
 The expected earnings for this role could be comprised of a base salary and other forms of cash compensation, such as bonus or commissions as applicable.
   

  

 This pay range is just one component of MX’s total rewards package. MX takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including job and level they are hired into, location, skillset, peer compensation.
   

  

* Please note applicants applying for this position must have the legal right to work in India without the need for sponsorship. We are unable to provide work sponsorship for this role, and candidates should be able to verify their eligibility to work in the country independently. Proof of eligibility to work in India will be required as part of the hiring process.


**Work Environment**
 In this role, a significant aspect of the job involves working in the office for a standard 40\-hour workweek. We believe that the collaborative nature of our work and the face\-to\-face interactions among team members are essential for fostering a dynamic and productive work environment. Being present in the office enables seamless communication, facilitates quick decision\-making, and encourages spontaneous collaboration that contributes to the overall success of our projects. We value the synergy that comes from having our team members physically together, allowing for immediate problem\-solving, idea exchange, and team building.

c25b3826.description:

**Who We Are**
 At UST, we help the world s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we co\-create lasting change with our clients.  We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the deployment and delivery of GPU cluster infrastructure. This role will work at the intersection of AI hardware platforms, high\-performance networking, and data center infrastructure, coordinating across solution architects, engineering teams, vendors, and contractors to deliver production\-ready AI clusters.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
 GPU Cluster Deployment
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end deployment of AI GPU clusters, from infrastructure planning through production launch.
* Drive coordination across Infrastructure Solution Architects, network engineers, hardware vendors, and data center teams.
* Manage delivery timelines covering hardware deployment, network integration, cluster bring\-up, and production readiness. Infrastructure Architecture Collaboration
* Work closely with Infrastructure Solution Architects (SA) to define: ○ GPU server platform selection


 ○ Network architecture for distributed GPU clusters ○ Storage integration and cluster infrastructure design
   

  

* Support development of the cluster Bill of Materials (BOM) including compute, networking, storage, and supporting infrastructure components.

* Drive system integration for large\-scale GPU clusters,


 including: ○ Rack elevation planning
   

  

 ○ GPU server deployment and configuration
   

  

 ○ High\-speed network topology implementation
   

  

 ○ Power and cooling readiness
   

  

* Ensure deployments align with vendor reference architectures and validated cluster designs. Contractor \& Field Deployment Management

* Lead contractor onboarding, including SOW development, scope definition, and delivery milestone alignment.
* Coordinate and oversee field deployment activities such as:


 ○ Structured cabling installation
   

  

 ○ Rack installation and equipment mounting
   

  

 ○ Network and power connectivity preparation
   

  

 ○ Hardware staging and deployment logistics Cluster Validation \& Performance Testing
   

  

* Coordinate cluster bring\-up and validation activities including:


 ○ Single\-node GPU validation
   

  

 ○ Multi\-node cluster deployment
   

  

 ○ GPU interconnect validation (P2P, RDMA)
   

  

* Drive cluster benchmarking, stress testing, and performance verification before production release. Operational Readiness
* Ensure deployed GPU clusters are fully ready for production workloads by driving:


 ○ Hardware and network validation
   

  

 ○ Monitoring and telemetry integration
   

  

 ○ Operational documentation and runbooks
   

  

 ○ Handover to operations teams
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years experience in Technical Program Management, Infrastructure Program Management, or HPC infrastructure delivery
* Experience with GPU cluster deployments or high\-performance computing environments
* Familiarity with GPU server architecture and distributed computing infrastructure
* Experience working with Infrastructure Solution Architects to define system architecture and hardware BOM
* Experience managing data center hardware deployments and system integration
* Ability to coordinate multi\-vendor infrastructure projects across regions Preferred Qualifications
* Experience deploying large\-scale AI infrastructure or GPU clusters
* Familiarity with:


 ○ InfiniBand / RoCE / high\-speed Ethernet networking
   

  

 ○ GPU interconnect validation (P2P / RDMA)
   

  

 ○ rack elevation and high\-density rack deployment
   

  

* Experience with cluster validation and performance benchmarking
* Background as Systems Engineer, HPC Engineer, or Infrastructure Architect
* Experience working in AI infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, or hyperscale data centers Nice to Have
* Experience deploying liquid\-cooled GPU clusters or high\-power racks
* Experience working with NVIDIA AI infrastructure platforms
* Familiarity with AI training environments and distributed workloads


**At UST, our culture is built on our core values:**
**Humility**
 We listen, learn, and act selflessly.
   

  

**Humanity**
 We strive to improve the lives of others through our work.
   

  

**Integrity**
 We honor commitments and act responsibly.
   

  

 We celebrate diversity, inclusion, and innovation placing people at the center of everything we do.
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
   

  

**Skills**
 Project Management, Process Documentation, Data Center Operations, Network Architecture, Project Management, RDMA, Storage Systems, Performance Testing, Observability, NVIDIA GPU

73c90107.title: Senior Technical Program Manager II (PMO)
73c90107.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
**Strategic Mandate**
 As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership
   

  

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**
* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking


**Qualifications**
**Expertise \& Technology Stack**
* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking


**Additional Information**
**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

The Role
 



  





 We are seeking a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer to serve as the technical backbone of our enterprise sales efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives to drive complex, high\-value AI opportunities from qualification through to close – translating capabilities into compelling, customer\-specific solutions. This is a highly visible role that demands both deep technical expertise and the ability to communicate confidently at every level, from hands\-on IT architects to C\-suite executives.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



  




* Act as the technical lead throughout the sales cycle, partnering with Account Executives to drive enterprise opportunities from qualification to close.
* Develop and maintain a strong perspective on how AI – including large language models, agentic architectures, and RAG\-based solutions – can drive measurable business value across verticals and functions.
* Understand customer pain points in adopting and implementing AI solutions, and position as the trusted partner to address them.
* Deliver compelling technical presentations and demos showcasing GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, and LLM\-based capabilities tailored to each prospect’s context.

 What We’re Looking For
 



  




* Minimum 10 years of experience in pre\-sales, solution engineering, or technical consulting – preferably within enterprise SaaS, AI, or automation platforms.

* Strong ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, from technicians to C\-suite executives.
* Proven track record supporting enterprise sales cycles and contributing to the close of large, multi\-stakeholder deals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with confidence at all levels of a large enterprise.
* Strong problem\-solving and storytelling skills – able to connect AI capabilities to strategic business outcomes.

**About Jade Global:** 




 Jade Global is seeking a seasoned ServiceNow Presales \& Solution Lead to drive the technical scoping, architectural design, and ultimate closure of enterprise\-scale opportunities within our Enterprise Service Management (ESM) practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing leadership position designed for an expert practitioner who can seamlessly bridge complex business problems with cutting\-edge ServiceNow platform architecture.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading high\-impact technical presales engagements, architecting multi\-workflow solutions, owning rigorous effort scoping/SOW development, and cultivating critical ServiceNow alliance relationships. This leader will carry a personal bookings/pipeline conversion quota and will serve as the primary authority on aligning customer business outcomes with ServiceNow capabilities.

**Architecture, Estimation \& Deal Scoping** 



* Own the end\-to\-end technical solutioning process for complex, multi\-module ServiceNow pursuits, including architectural blueprints and integration ecosystems.
* Drive rigorous effort estimation reviews, meticulously validating delivery timelines, staffing matrices, and resource mixes to ensure commercial viability and zero delivery slippage.

* Govern the transition from sales to implementation, conducting thorough technical handoffs to Delivery and Practice teams to ensure customer expectations are perfectly executed.



  





**ServiceNow Alliance \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Cultivate deep technical and co\-sell alignment with ServiceNow field sales, solution architects, and partner enablement managers to accelerate pipeline growth.
* Represent Jade Global’s technical prowess at premier ServiceNow ecosystem events, including Knowledge, partner forums, and executive roundtables.
* Unlock referral and co\-sell opportunities by demonstrating deep domain expertise to ServiceNow account teams, positioning Jade as the go\-to delivery partner for complex workflows.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience Required** 



* 12–15\+ years of progressive experience in IT consulting, enterprise solution architecture, or technical presales, with a minimum of 6–8 years dedicated exclusively to the ServiceNow platform.
* Deep architectural mastery across the full scope of ServiceNow workflows, specifically ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM/SecOps, WSD and other modules of ServiceNow with platform features like Now Assist / Movework / Creator Workflows.
* Commanding executive presence with a proven track record of influencing enterprise technology stakeholders and C\-level decision\-makers.
* Demonstrated experience scoping seven\-figure deals, including accurate effort estimation, complex delivery sizing, and airtight contract/SOW formulation.
* Direct co\-selling experience alongside ServiceNow internal sales and specialist teams.
* Quota\-carrying success, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding personal sales support, pipeline contribution, or booking targets.



  





**Preferred Technical Attributes** 



* Active ServiceNow Certifications: Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in core modules, Certified Application Developer (CAD), or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) / Certified Master Architect (CMA).
* Vertical Expertise: Proven experience solutioning for complex regulatory or operational environments like Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Manufacturing, High Tech, or Financial Services.
* Automation Fluency: Strong comprehension of AI\-driven workflows, generative AI integrations within ServiceNow (Now Assist), and modern enterprise integration architectures (Integration Hub).



  





**Success Metrics** 



* Achieve assigned ESM pipeline contribution and closed\-won bookings quota.
* Maximize technical win\-rates on critical, highly competitive RFPs and enterprise proposals.
* Expand the Jade Global co\-sell pipeline via proactive collaboration with ServiceNow technical and account field teams.
* Maintain high estimation accuracy, ensuring scoped deals transition smoothly into profitable, on\-time delivery executions.

 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance, cloud\-native architecture, and regulated financial services environments. This role is responsible for defining and governing end\-to\-end technology solutions that support insurance products and operations across customer onboarding, policy administration, premium collection, servicing, and claims.
   

  

 The successful candidate will provide architectural leadership across multiple agile delivery teams, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards. This role combines strategic thinking, hands\-on technical architecture, stakeholder engagement, and insurance domain expertise to deliver future\-ready digital insurance platforms.
   

  

 Key focus areas include cloud\-native architecture, API\-first design, microservices, event\-driven systems, integration architecture, security\-by\-design, observability, and regulatory compliance within the insurance domain.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures for Life and Funeral Insurance initiatives, balancing business objectives, technology strategy, cost efficiency, and long\-term sustainability
* Produce High\-Level Designs (HLDs), detailed solution designs, architecture decision records, integration designs, and supporting architectural documentation
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and translate strategy into implementable technology solutions
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple agile squads and delivery teams
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, microservices, and event\-driven architectural approaches
* Ensure solutions meet key non\-functional requirements including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, availability, and security
* Lead architecture reviews, governance processes, technology assessments, and design assurance activities
* Design and govern integrations across policy administration platforms, CRM systems, payment solutions, identity services, and customer engagement channels
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, risk, compliance, and business teams as a trusted technology advisor
* Apply FinOps principles to optimise cloud investments and support platform modernisation initiatives
* Ensure architecture aligns with compliance obligations such as AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, PEP screening, FICA, POPIA, fraud prevention, audit requirements, and privacy\-by\-design principles
* Support agile and SAFe delivery practices by providing architectural direction and delivery readiness across releases and programmes
* Leverage AI\-assisted architecture tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, design exploration, and documentation activities


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 5–10\+ years of experience across software engineering and solution architecture
* 5\+ years of experience designing enterprise\-scale cloud\-native solutions
* Demonstrated experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry
* Strong expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance products, policy administration, customer journeys, premium collection, servicing, claims, and domain integrations
* Proven ability to engage with both executive stakeholders and technical delivery teams
* Experience designing cloud architectures, preferably on AWS
* Strong knowledge of:
+ Microservices architecture
+ Event\-driven architecture
+ REST APIs and API management
+ Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies
+ Oracle, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases
+ OAuth2, OpenID Connect, IAM, and security architecture
+ Observability platforms including CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, and Dynatrace
+ CI/CD practices and architecture governance
+ Agile and ideally SAFe frameworks

* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, mentoring, and decision\-making skills
* Preferred certifications:
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
+ TOGAF
+ SAFe for Architects or equivalent certification


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to shape the future of digital Life and Funeral Insurance platforms serving large customer populations
* Exposure to business\-critical architecture decisions within a highly regulated financial services environment
* Collaborative and supportive culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful customer impact
* Opportunity to work alongside engineering, security, risk, compliance, and business leaders
* Involvement in cloud transformation and platform modernisation programmes
* Hybrid working model with regular collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
* Opportunity to influence architecture strategy, governance, and technology adoption at scale


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced cloud\-native architecture and modernisation strategies
* Enterprise\-scale insurance platform architecture and integration design
* Financial services regulatory architecture and compliance\-by\-design practices
* FinOps methodologies and cloud cost optimisation techniques
* Advanced event\-driven and API\-first architecture patterns
* Enterprise observability and resilience engineering approaches
* Architecture governance and decision\-making frameworks
* AI\-assisted architecture and design acceleration techniques
* Stakeholder influencing and strategic technology leadership skills


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
 **Solution Architecture Senior Engineer.**

 **:**
* Design, implement, and maintain SAP SD solutions aligned with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Act as the global SAP SD expert and trusted advisor for business stakeholders across commercial, customer service, logistics, and supply chain functions.
* Lead solution design activities, translating business requirements into scalable and sustainable SAP solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to optimize end\-to\-end Order\-to\-Cash processes. Ensure seamless integration between SAP SD and related modules, including MM, PP, WM/EWM, FI/CO, and external applications.
* Support SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives, including process harmonization, fit\-gap assessments, solution design, testing, and deployment activities.
* Manage and coordinate complex changes, enhancements, incidents, and projects within the SAP SD landscape.
* Collaborate with business process owners to define and promote best practices while ensuring compliance with internal standards and governance requirements.
* Support EDI and customer integration processes, ensuring reliable and efficient communication with customers, suppliers, and external partners.
* Create and maintain solution documentation, business process flows, functional specifications, and operational procedures.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams, key users, and support organizations.
* Stay up to date with SAP innovations and industry trends, recommending new technologies and improvements that create business value.


**If You Have/are**
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 7 years of hands\-on SAP SD experience with multiple end\-to\-end implementations and support projects.
* Strong expertise in SAP Sales \& Distribution processes including Order Management, Pricing, Shipping, Billing, Returns, Customer Master Data, Intercompany Processing, and Credit Management. Experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC environments.
* Strong understanding of Order\-to\-Cash business processes and their integration with Logistics, Manufacturing, and Finance processes.
* Experience in EDI integrations and customer connectivity solutions.
* Automotive industry experience is highly desirable, especially in environments involving OEMs, Tier\-1 suppliers, Just\-In\-Time (JIT), Just\-In\-Sequence (JIS), scheduling agreements, and EDI\-driven customer processes.
* SAP certification in SD or S/4HANA Sales is considered an advantage.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a strong customer\-focused mindset.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to work effectively in a global and multicultural environment.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and able to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
* Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.


**We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.**
 In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
   

  

**More lives saved – more life lived!**

3bb1511c.title: Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)
3bb1511c.description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). 6b48e513.description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 An OpenText Content Server Cloud Support Specialist is responsible for the technical delivery of the CS (Content Server) Platform based solutions. This role has administration emphasis, combined with the consultative skills required to promote the impression of quality and excellence actively fostered within the Customer Success Services.
   

  

 Engagements may vary from managing multiple short and relatively fast paced engagements, to larger projects depending upon levels of experience. The nature of work may include supporting full application lifecycle activities right from development, deployment/provisioning, testing, migration, decommissioning and ongoing run \& maintain (upgrades, patching etc.) support of the cloud deployments.
   

  

 The role is customer facing and requires excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate to a wide range of stake holders (internally and externally), both verbally and in writing.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
 Work within an OpenText technical delivery/consulting team in order to:
   

  

* Participate and contribute to Project execution phases
* Participate in the day to day administration of the systems, including Incident \& Problem Management
* Participate in execution of new implementations, upgrades and patching activities.
* Participate in the advanced configuration of CS software components, in line with project and customer time scales.
* To co\-ordinate project delivery through multiple teams that may include 3rd party suppliers, partners and client resources.
* Actively contribute in identifying opportunities for automating day to day activities where possible to achieve operational efficiencies.
* Actively seek new opportunities by working with the customer and the change control provisions provided by the contract, to extend the scope of profitable business.
* Actively use and contribute to the project management standards and quality checks used within OpenText Cloud Services.
* Understand requirements, conduct detailed design, determine level of effort, plan work breakdown structures and implementation approach
* Prepare, maintain and submit activity/progress reports and time recording/management reports in accordance with published procedures. Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements
* Manage expectations and responsibilities for all client and internal stakeholders.
* Utilize exceptional written and verbal communication skills while supporting customers via web, telephone, or email, while demonstrating a high level of customer focus and empathy.
* Respond to and solve customer technical requests, show an understanding of the customer's managed hosted environment and applications within the Open Text cloud enabling resolution of complex technical issues. Document or Implement proposed solutions.
* Respond to and troubleshoot alerts from monitoring of applications, servers and devices sufficient to meet service level agreements
* Collaborating on cross\-team and cross\-product technical issues with a variety of resources including Product support, IT, and Professional Services.


**What You Will Need To Succeed**
 Well versed with deployment, administration and troubleshooting of the OpenText Content Suit Platform and surrounding components (Content Server, Archive Server, xECM, Brava, OTDS, Search \& Indexing). Experience with Cloud deployment of the Content Suit Platform will be advantage.
   

  

**Good Experience/knowledge On Following**
* Knowledge on Windows, UNIX, and Application administration skills in a TCP/IP network environment.
* Experience working with relational DBMS (PostgreSQL/Postgres, Oracle, MS SQL Server, mySQL)
* Programming/scripting is helpful, (ie. SQL, .sh/.bat, Java, JavaScript)
* Familiarity with configuration and management of web/application servers (IIS, Apache, Tomcat, JBoss, etc.).
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming, Web Services, LDAP configuration, and RDBMS concepts

 Public Cloud Certifications / Kubernets are an advantage

GEMBA CONCEPTS
   

  

* TECHNOLOGY DIVISION
* JOB DESCRIPTION


 Technical Delivery Manager – Services LOCATION Bengaluru (Hybrid) ABOUT GEMBA CONCEPTS EXPERIENCE 5–8 years REPORTS TO Chief Technology Officer TYPE Full\-time Gemba Concepts helps manufacturers and enterprises improve how their operations run. Our technology division builds and runs Gemba Connect, a suite of enterprise SaaS products spanning warehouse management, logistics, ERP, and applied AI/ML, deployed across 30\+ active client accounts in manufacturing, pharma, FMCG and retail.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a technical leader to own Gemba's services business end to end: delivery, people, commercials and reporting. You'll run every client implementation and custom development engagement, build and manage the team that delivers them, and be the single point of accountability to clients and leadership for how services perform. You've written production Java code, can read a Spring Boot service and a SQL execution plan, and have since hired, reviewed and led delivery teams. The product roadmap stays with product leadership; everything we deliver to clients runs through you.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN Services Business Ownership**
* Own the health of the services portfolio: delivery, client satisfaction, billing milestones and account growth.
* Run post\-sale SOW execution. Ensure milestones are hit and billed on time, and follow up with finance and clients on receivables.
* Grow accounts by converting change requests and enhancements into scoped, priced, billable work.
* Track effort, utilisation and margin by account; act when an engagement turns unprofitable. Delivery
* Run multiple concurrent client implementations, owning scope, timeline, cost and quality.
* Plan and run sprints with Tech Leads: grooming, estimation, capacity planning, reviews and retros.
* Own go\-lives (UAT, cutover, data migration, hypercare) and post\-go\-live support SLAs.
* Maintain RAID logs and delivery dashboards; flag risk early, with a proposed fix. Requirements and change control
* Be the single intake point between consulting teams, clients and engineering; convert requirements into user stories with testable acceptance criteria.
* Baseline scope and run a formal change\-request process. Every change is priced in effort, cost and date before it's accepted.
* Make sure what's agreed is documented before it's built. People and hiring
* Plan services headcount against the delivery pipeline and run hiring end to end (role definition, interviews, closing) at a high bar.
* Run goal\-setting, regular 1:1s and performance reviews for the services team; give input on promotions, compensation and performance plans.
* Grow Tech Leads and senior engineers into people who can own accounts independently.
* Own team retention and morale. Know who's at risk before they resign. Gemba Concepts
* Technology Division Page 1GEMBA CONCEPTS
* TECHNICAL DELIVERY MANAGER – SERVICES Reporting
* Publish monthly services MIS to leadership: revenue billed, collections, on\-time delivery, SLA adherence, utilisation, hiring and attrition.
* Contribute the services section to quarterly board reporting.
* Run monthly or quarterly business reviews with key client stakeholders. Technical oversight
* Work with Tech Leads on design reviews, integrations (ERP, WMS, third\-party systems) and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead incident triage and root\-cause reviews on client escalations; track corrective actions to closure.
* Coordinate with DevOps on environments, CI/CD and release windows.
* Uphold security and compliance controls (e.g., SOC 2\) across delivery. Improving how we deliver
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development and testing tools, and measure whether they actually raise throughput per engineer.
* Tighten estimation accuracy, definition of done and release discipline across the services team. MUST\-HAVES
* 5–8 years in software, including 2\+ years as a hands\-on Java developer and 2\+ years in delivery or project management.
* 1\+ year leading a team of 5\+ directly, including hiring and performance reviews.
* Strong working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot. You can review a PR, understand how a service is structured, and challenge an estimate.
* Solid SQL: schema design, writing and debugging queries, and understanding of indexing, transactions and production issues such as slow queries and connection pool exhaustion (SQL Server/Azure SQL, PostgreSQL or MySQL).
* Hands\-on exposure to cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable).
* Working experience with the commercial side of client engagements: SOWs, milestone billing and change orders. Margin tracking is a plus.
* Track record of delivering enterprise B2B software to external clients across multiple parallel engagements.
* Proficiency with Jira or Azure DevOps, Confluence and Git\-based workflows.
* Clear communication. You can present to a client CXO, write a board\-ready MIS, and give an engineer hard feedback. GOOD TO HAVE
* Domain experience in manufacturing, supply chain, warehousing, logistics or ERP.
* Background in an IT services firm or the services arm of a product company.
* Familiarity with microservices, REST API design and message queues.
* Experience delivering AI/ML features.
* Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.
* Certifications (PMP, CSM, PMI\-ACP) are welcome but won't substitute for a delivery and team\-building track record. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS
* 85%\+ of implementations go live on the committed date.
* Billing milestones are invoiced on time, and receivables ageing is visibly down.
* Every active account has baselined scope, a live RAID log and a change log.
* Services hiring is on plan, with near\-zero regretted attrition.
* Leadership gets a monthly services MIS without having to chase it. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH The services delivery team (engineers, Tech Leads, BAs, QA), product squads, DevOps, consulting teams, finance and client stakeholders.


**WHY JOIN Own** 
 a real business line with direct access to leadership. Build the team and operating model your way. Work on enterprise products in active growth, including applied AI.
   

  

 Skills:\- Project Management, Delivery Management, Java, Spring Boot, Windows Azure, Client Management, Team Management, Agile/Scrum, Requirements management, CI/CD, Stakeholder management, confluence, RESTful APIs and Product Management

You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside engineers, data scientists, and designers, operating with high autonomy to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions.
   

  

 Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.

As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

3fd868ca.description:
**Role Overview**
=================


CUBE84 is looking for an experienced and highly skilled Senior Salesforce Technical Architect to lead the technical architecture, solution design, and implementation of enterprise\-scale Salesforce solutions. This role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, and high\-performing technical architectures while providing technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have deep expertise across the Salesforce platform, strong integration experience, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a proven track record of leading development teams within a consulting environment. They will work closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and clients to deliver robust, future\-ready Salesforce solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**Technical Architecture \& Solution Design**
---------------------------------------------


* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce technical architectures.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions aligned with Salesforce best practices.
* Define solution architecture for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom Salesforce applications.
* Lead architecture discussions and technical discovery workshops with clients.
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs and recommend optimal solutions.

**Salesforce Development Leadership**
-------------------------------------


* Provide technical leadership to Salesforce development teams across multiple projects.
* Review technical designs, code quality, and solution implementations.
* Establish development standards, governance, and best practices.
* Mentor Senior Developers and Lead Developers.
* Drive adoption of reusable components and scalable development patterns.

**Integration \& Enterprise Architecture**
------------------------------------------


* Design integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications.
* Architect API\-based integrations using REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Middleware, and ETL tools.
* Guide data migration, synchronization, and master data management strategies.
* Ensure security, authentication, and performance considerations are incorporated into integrations.

**Platform Governance**
-----------------------


* Define application architecture standards and coding guidelines.
* Ensure solutions comply with Salesforce governor limits and platform best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical risk assessments.
* Drive technical debt reduction and continuous platform optimization.

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
------------------------------------


* Serve as the primary technical advisor during client engagements.
* Present solution approaches and architecture recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities, solution estimation, technical proposals, and RFP responses.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Delivery Managers, and Product teams throughout project execution.

**Delivery Support**
--------------------


* Guide technical teams throughout project implementation.
* Resolve complex technical challenges and production issues.
* Support release planning, deployment strategies, and DevOps practices.
* Ensure technical deliverables meet quality, security, and performance expectations.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of overall software development experience.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience.
* 3\+ years of experience serving as a Salesforce Technical Architect or Lead Technical Architect.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise Salesforce implementations in consulting or IT services organizations.
* Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) are highly desirable.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
===================================


**Salesforce Expertise**
------------------------


* Apex
* Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Aura Components
* Visualforce
* Flows
* Platform Events
* Custom Metadata
* Salesforce Security Model
* Sharing \& Visibility
* Governor Limits
* Asynchronous Processing
* SOQL/SOSL
* Batch Apex
* Queueable Apex
* Future Methods

**Salesforce Products**
-----------------------


* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Field Service (preferred)
* CPQ (preferred)
* Data Cloud (good to have)

**Integration Technologies**
----------------------------


* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* OAuth
* Named Credentials
* Platform Events
* MuleSoft (preferred)
* Boomi or other middleware platforms
* ETL and Data Migration

**DevOps \& Release Management**
--------------------------------


* Git
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub
* Bitbucket
* Salesforce DX (SFDX)
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Copado or Gearset (preferred)

**Leadership Skills**
---------------------


* Technical leadership
* Solution architecture
* Client consulting
* Team mentoring
* Technical decision\-making
* Stakeholder management
* Estimation and planning
* Risk assessment

**Preferred Certifications**
============================


* Salesforce Application Architect
* Salesforce System Architect
* Salesforce Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Integration Architect
* Salesforce Data Architect
* Salesforce Sharing \& Visibility Architect
* Salesforce Development Lifecycle \& Deployment Architect
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) – Highly Desirable

**Success Measures**
====================


* Delivery of scalable and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* High technical quality and adherence to architecture standards.
* Successful client implementations with minimal technical debt.
* Strong developer mentorship and technical team growth.
* Reduced production defects and improved platform performance.
* Effective stakeholder engagement and technical leadership.
* Contribution to delivery excellence, innovation, and pre\-sales initiatives.

You will work with the Sales Executive as a strategic partner, influencing how deals are positioned, how risks are managed, and how CUBE84 differentiates in competitive situations.
