0b5315d4.description:
**Overview**
 GitHub is seeking a passionate, driven, and collaborative Senior TPM to drive the GitHub Enterprise Servier (GHES) release process. This includes OS and container builds across the platform, infrastructure, and application layers; package generation and certification; integration test environments; and distribution of release artifacts through Azure and other clouds. In this role, you will define operational priorities for the team, coordinate execution across a complex release surface, and partner across engineering organizations to ensure GHES ships as a high\-quality, secure, and dependable appliance for enterprise customers.
   

  

 You will partner with stakeholders to deliver solutions that strengthen our security posture and elevate service resiliency and quality. Additionally, you will coordinate with engineers across the organization to monitor progress, resolve blockers, and provide status updates to the leadership team.
   

  

 Our team is small, efficient, and engineering\-focused, thriving in a fast\-paced environment. We are looking for a Senior TPM who embraces new challenges and adapts quickly to evolving programs. To support multiple initiatives simultaneously, you will leverage AI to boost productivity and continuously seek opportunities to enhance engineering efficiency through agentic AI\-based solutions.
   

  

 To be successful in the role, the ideal candidate will require strong interpersonal skills, influencing without authority, drive for results, and collaboration in addition to a proven track record in technical program management and operational excellence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Technical Program Manager Role encompasses a broad scope including:
   

  

* Drive execution across build, package generation, validation, certification, and customer delivery workflows for GHES releases.
* Establish and drive standards for release reliability, observability, compliance, and operational excellence across build, release, and certification workflows.
* Set investment priorities for the GHES Release team, balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term improvements in reliability, efficiency, and engineering velocity.
* Ensure strong operational ownership of release infrastructure, including clear accountability, effective incident response, and continuous improvement following critical issues.
* Drive and deliver security and compliance requirements.
* Negotiate requirements with the central teams (SMEs).
* Understand best practices and available tooling to improve service resiliency and quality.
* Influence and drive adoption of quality best practices and standards.
* Drive onboarding to central infra services and, tooling.
* Track various metrics across broad set of services.
* Drive tooling and infra feature design and implementation.
* Identify new opportunities and work with the central teams to supplement existing quality standards.
* Deliver technical and high\-level presentations in various forums.
* Drive multiple projects at any given time.

* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager or in a technical role with systems experience.
* 3\+ years of experience working in the Cloud domain.
* 3\+ year of experience in management of complex cross\-group, cross\-business, cross\-disciplinary projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**

b7c394b6.title: Technical Program Manager, GSRS, Physical Security
b7c394b6.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.
* 5 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.
* 5 years of experience with coding in one or more general purpose languages.
* 1 year of experience leading teams in a technical capacity or leading technical risk analysis in an enterprise environment.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with physical access control, intrusion detection, case management, video management, Physical Security Information Management (PSIM), IT networking, construction/architecture, and no\-code development platforms.
* Experience in technology delivery, design and execution within Physical/Cyber Security industries with PSP, CPP, CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA Network\+ or Cisco CCNA certification.
* Experience aligning teams across various disciplines, including operational, engineering, product, and UX.
* Ability to successfully navigate through competing priorities, present complex ideas with clarity, and build strong partnerships with stakeholders.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring, through informal authority.


**About The Job**
 Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.
   

  

 Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.
   

  

 In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness. You will be responsible for completing initiatives that improve Google’s ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act on security risks globally. You will drive delivery of physical security technology solutions in scope of the Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) organization. You will partner internally to prototype and develop solutions on accelerated timelines against stakeholder requirements, owning the full end to end delivery and support of those solutions throughout their lifecycle. Your delivery will enable GSRS operations to keep Google and Google employees safe and secure across the global office locations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze operational processes and business requirements to ensure alignment with the overall goal and delivery of the technology roadmap, new or existing products, with a focus on accessibility, scalable growth, automation, and business outcomes that mitigate key risks.

80896beb.title: Lead Solution Consultant-DX
80896beb.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for a driven and detail\-oriented Digital Solutioning Analyst to support and execute


key activities within Codilar's presales and solutioning function. This role is well suited for someone


who is building expertise in digital commerce, has a strong analytical mindset, and is eager to grow


into a full\-spectrum solutioning professional.

  

  

You will work closely with senior solutioning and sales team members, assisting in requirement


analysis, solution documentation, research, and deal support activities. Over time, you will take on


increasing ownership of solutioning deliverables and client\-facing engagements as your domain


knowledge and confidence develop.

  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

  

**1\. Requirement Analysis \& Clarification**


* Support structured requirement\-gathering sessions with clients, capturing and documenting


business goals, functional needs, and technical constraints.


* Assist in preparing solution briefs, scoping notes, BRDs, FRDs, and pricing summaries in


collaboration with senior team members.


* Help ensure that documented requirements are accurate, complete, and clearly understood


before solution design begins.

  

  

**2\. Solution Architecture Support**


* Assist in designing and documenting solution architectures, including platform


recommendations, integration maps, and technology stack outlines.


* Support senior solutioning experts in conducting platform audits and evaluating technical fit


for client requirements.


* Research and document third\-party integrations, ecosystem tools, and ancillary solutions


relevant to client needs.


* Contribute to delivering solution design outputs within defined turnaround timelines.

  

  

**3\. Solutioning Library Maintenance**


* Maintain and update the internal solutioning library with new solution components, templates,


case studies, and reference architectures.


* Organize and tag library content to ensure easy retrieval and reuse across the growth and


presales teams.


* Proactively identify gaps in existing documentation and flag opportunities to strengthen the


knowledge base.

  

  

**4\. Client Pitch Support**


* Assist in the preparation of client pitch decks, solution presentations, and supporting


materials.


* Support the solutioning lead in structuring the technical narrative and ensuring accuracy of


solution content within pitches.


* Coordinate internally to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and ensure pitch materials are


delivered on time and to a high standard.


* Collaborate closely across internal teams, proactively reaching out to relevant stakeholders to


gather the information and data needed to build strong, well\-informed pitches.

  

  

**5\. End\-to\-End Deal Documentation**


* Own the preparation and accuracy of all deal documentation including Estimations, Final


Pitches, MSAs, SOWs, Addendums, Work Breakdown Structures, and Team Matrices.


* Ensure documentation is commercially sound and fully aligned with agreed scope prior to


deal closure.


* Track Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) as a key outcome metric for assessing deal quality


and solution fit.

  

  

**6\. Research \& Market Intelligence**


* Conduct research on prospective client profiles including their business model, competitive


landscape, target market, and technology usage.


* Track and document emerging commerce technologies, platform updates, and ecosystem


partner developments relevant to Codilar's offerings.


* Summarize research findings in a structured format to support solutioning and pitch


preparation activities.

  

  

**7\. GTM Engineering**


* Develop and maintain a structured Target Client List, conducting acquisition audits to assess


fit and prioritize outreach.


* Support go\-to\-market efforts by engineering targeted solutioning approaches for specific


verticals, geographies, or client segments.


* Deliver a minimum of four GTM engineering outputs per month in collaboration with the sales


team.

  

  

**8\. Competition Mapping**


* Research and document the competitive landscape including digital commerce agencies,


platform vendors, and solution providers.


* Assist in developing Right\-to\-Win narratives and competitive differentiation points to


strengthen Codilar's positioning.


* Support the preparation of regular competition mapping outputs to keep the sales and


solutioning teams well\-informed.

  

  

**9\. Reporting \& MIS**


* Maintain up\-to\-date CRM records and MIS logs reflecting solutioning activities, interactions,


and pipeline status.


* Assist in preparing monthly reports covering KPI tracking, activity summaries, challenges, and


observations.


* Support the solutioning lead in identifying patterns, improvements, and recommended actions


based on reporting data.

  

  

**REQUIREMENTS**


* 7\-9 years of experience in presales, solution consulting, business analysis, or a related


client\-facing role in a technology or digital commerce environment.


* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms such as Adobe Commerce (Magento),


Shopify, Shopify Plus, Pimcore, or Fluent Commerce.


* Ability to understand and document business and technical requirements, and translate them


into structured solution briefs or proposals.


* Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal


teams and engage with clients professionally.


* Strong research and analytical skills with an eye for detail and a structured approach to


documentation.


* Familiarity with deal documentation formats such as SOWs, MSAs, and WBS is an


advantage.


* Working knowledge of CRM tools, MIS reporting, and the Microsoft Office Suite.


* Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and grow within a fast\-paced, solution\-driven environment.

  

  

**OTHER DETAILS**


Location: India


Experience Required: 7\-9years


Industry: Digital Commerce / IT Services


Function: Presales \& Digital Solutioning

**About GlobalFoundries**
 GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
   

  

**Introduction**
 The Senior Systems \& Solutions Engineer will be a hands\-on customer\-facing technical leader for the Custom Digital MCU/MPU business. The role will work with customer engineering teams to understand product architectures, identify system requirements, position GF/MIPS processor and mixed\-signal capabilities, and translate customer needs into clear product and technology roadmap inputs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines embedded processor systems depth with customer credibility. They should be comfortable discussing real\-time control, embedded software, system partitioning, connectivity, safety/security, mixed\-signal integration, and application\-specific tradeoffs with both customer engineers and internal product/architecture teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Engage customer engineering teams to understand product systems, architecture choices, workloads, software stacks, constraints, and roadmap needs.
* Translate customer needs into clear requirements for MCU/MPU products, processor subsystems, mixed\-signal IP, software, safety/security, connectivity, and platform derivatives.
* Support design\-win pursuits with architecture discussions, technical differentiation, competitive comparisons, and customer\-specific solution positioning.
* Develop system\-level collateral including block diagrams, requirements matrices, reference architectures, customer use\-case notes, and competitive positioning material.
* Work with product management, silicon architecture, software, and design teams to validate feasibility and prioritize customer\-driven roadmap inputs.
* Own selected vertical coverage such as automotive zonal/SDV, motor drive/robotics, industrial automation, Edge AI, networking/infrastructure, or e\-mobility.
* Provide customer feedback loops to internal teams and help convert market insights into product decisions.
* Participate in customer workshops, technical reviews, architecture deep\-dives, and executive design\-win discussions as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of embedded systems, applications engineering, product systems, processor architecture support, customer solutions, or related semiconductor experience.
* Strong understanding of MCU/MPU product architectures, embedded software, hardware/software partitioning, and customer product requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more of: automotive electronics, industrial automation, robotics/motor control, networking/infrastructure, e\-mobility, or Edge AI systems.

7e1c83a9.title: Staff Data Architect
7e1c83a9.description:
**Job Details:**

The Staff Enterprise Data Architect develops standards, tools, and governance for capturing, modeling, storing, and delivering data for the enterprise, including:


Identifying data\-related business requirements and service standards (e.g., transaction processing speed, data mining and reporting capabilities, data security, scalability, etc.).


Developing a high\-level enterprise data model and conceptual views of related data sub\-architectures (e.g., database, data integration, data warehouse/business intelligence, reporting, metadata, and content management architectures).


Optimizing overall data/information flow by reducing redundancy and enabling accessibility within security boundaries. Staff Architects in Enterprise Data Architecture oversee one or more Data Engineering Disciplines.

  

  

* Interpret enterprise data architecture, governance standards, and platform direction (BigQuery, Palantir Foundry, Workday/SAP ecosystem) and translate them into a concrete data strategy and roadmap for HR \& Payroll.
* Design and guide data models, pipelines, and integration patterns connecting HCM/Payroll systems to the enterprise data lake/warehouse.
* Stay hands\-on with SQL, data modeling, and pipeline/ETL work\- able to dig into complex data problems alongside the team, not just review their output.
* Serve as the domain's data quality and governance owner: data lineage, validation, metadata/cataloging (e.g., Collibra), and compliance with data privacy requirements for HR data.
* Manage, coach, and grow a data team based in India: day\-to\-day leadership, performance management, career development, and acting as the trusted on\-the\-ground manager for a remote\-from\-HQ team.
* Partner with HR/Payroll business stakeholders to turn ambiguous business questions into data requirements and analytics\-ready solutions.
* Act as a bridge between enterprise architecture/IT leadership and the HR/Payroll domain\- representing domain needs upward, and enterprise standards downward.
  

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  

  

Technical Standards and Governance:


Establishing and maintaining enterprise\-wide technical standards, guidelines, and best practices for software development, quality, and infrastructure.


Ensuring compliance with these standards across all programs and projects.


Perform other assigned job\-related duties that align with our organization's vision, mission, and values and fall within your scope of practice.


Architecture Design and Review:


Designing scalable, reliable, and secure architecture solutions that align with business goals and technical requirements.


Conducting architecture reviews and providing guidance to ensure alignment with enterprise standards.


Cross\-Disciplinary Expertise:


Leveraging expertise in software development, quality engineering, and infrastructure engineering to provide holistic architectural solutions.


Ensuring seamless integration of development, quality, and infrastructure components.


Technology Evaluation and Selection:


Evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies, tools, and platforms aligned with enterprise standards and business needs.


Conducting proof\-of\-concept (PoC) projects to validate technology choices. Collaboration and Communication:


Collaborating with development, quality, and infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.


Facilitating communication and knowledge sharing across teams and departments.


Continuous Improvement:


Promoting a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance technical standards and practices.


Staying up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure the enterprise remains competitive.


Security and Compliance:


Ensuring that security best practices are integrated into all aspects of the enterprise architecture.


Maintaining compliance with industry standards, regulations, and internal policies.


Performance and Scalability:


Designing solutions that ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability.


Conducting performance assessments and optimizations to meet enterprise requirements.


Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity:


Ensuring that all architectural solutions include robust backup and recovery mechanisms.


Quality Assurance and Testing:


Ensuring that automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices are consistently applied.


Documentation and Knowledge Management:


Creating and maintaining comprehensive architectural documentation, including diagrams, standards, and guidelines.


Ensuring that documentation is accessible and up to date for all stakeholders. Vendor and Tool Management:


Manage relationships with technology vendors and ensure that tools and services meet enterprise standards.


Evaluating and integrating third\-party solutions as needed.


Incident Management and Troubleshooting:


Providing high\-level support for incident management and troubleshooting complex technical issues.


Conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures. Capacity Planning and Resource Management:


Conducting capacity planning ensures enterprise architecture can handle current and future workloads.


Managing resources effectively to support enterprise\-wide initiatives.


Training and Mentorship:


Providing training and mentorship to technical teams to ensure adherence to enterprise standards.


Supporting professional development and knowledge sharing within the organization.

  

  

Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree or relevant experience. Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Quantitative or Engineering Field preferred.


Preferred Certification(s): TOGAF, Cloud (AWS or GCP), Security, SAP, SAFe. Experience: 7\+ years of relevant and practical experience. Special Skills Required:


Deep technical expertise in one or more areas of focus, e.g., Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Platforms.


The ability to explain highly technical conc

  

  

epts to non\-technical team members and leaders.


Self\-driven ability to vet new technical patterns, influence decision\-makers, and establish those patterns as new technical standards.


**Relocation Assistance Eligible:**

No
**Work Shift:**

  

The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

  

  

Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

eaf797cd.title: Senior Salesforce CPQ Solution Architect
eaf797cd.description:
Hello Visionary!  

There has never been a more urgent need to create resilient and sustainable infrastructure. With smart infrastructure, we are shaping an ecosystem that connects the real world with the digital world. Making decisions based on data and analytics empowers our customers to make their energy systems and processes in buildings and industries more efficient and sustainable. Together with our customers, we transform every day. For a better tomorrow.  

To support this from an IT point of view, we need smart thinkers who bring skills, creativity and dedication to the table. People like you! Experienced researchers who boldly broaden horizons, true specialists, and clever minds who like to get to the bottom of things. In short, help us tackle the most exciting challenges and put into practice what really matters.  

We are looking for Senior Salesforce CPQ Solution Architect.  

You’ll make a difference by:* Performing research and proof\-of\-concept work with the goal of designing the best solution for complex business requirements
* Evolving and maintaining the functional and technical solution architecture based on business process and functional needs
* Breaking down large\-scale project requirements to manageable features and user stories
* Creating and explaining solution designs (incl. related AI technology) and documenting them in a way that Stakeholders, Architects, PO, PM and developers can understand and/or execute them.
* Being able to build trust with key business stakeholders
* Working with the SI information security team to meet Siemens IT security standards
* Collaborate with Corporate Technology, Corporate Transformation Projects to incorporate new technologies/ideas to improve business processes.

  

Job requirements/ skills:* 10\+ years of experience in IT, with at least 5 years dedicated to Salesforce CPQ architecture in Salesforce ARM / RCA.
* Experience architecting and managing a large\-scale full\-life cycle of a CPQ implementations (preferably Salesforce ARM/RCA or CPQ\+)
* Design and develop integrations between applications and other systems as may be required by 5\+ years of full\-stack software development and maintenance experience
* In depth experience with full\-stack development with state\-of\-the\-art technologies
* Design and development of integrations between applications as required in the project
* Experience presenting to PO’s or other decision makers in selling ideas to various audiences (technical and non\-technical)
* Experience with API lifecycle management
* Strong understanding of SDLC methodologies (including Agile – SCRUM and DevOps).
* A pragmatic mindset with output orientation and a strong team player


Certifications:* Salesforce Certified Application Architect and/or System Architect \[Required].
* Salesforce Certified B2C Solution Architect (Preferred).
* Platform Developer II (Preferred).

  

Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!  

This role is in Bangalore / Chennai / Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the craft of things to come.  

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.  

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us craft tomorrow.  

At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds (http://www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds)

2a14ba00.title: DomainTechnical Architect
2a14ba00.description:
Domain\\Technical Architect
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


Senior AI Architect – Agentic AI


Enterprise AI strategy \& architecture leader \| Multi\-cloud Generative AI / Agentic AI


**Job Type** Full\-Time


**Experience** 12–16 years overall; at least 5 years in Generative AI / Agentic AI with significant enterprise architecture and production delivery experience


**Locations** Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bangalore, Pune


**Primary Focus** Enterprise AI strategy, solution architecture, architecture governance, technology standards and strategic technical leadership


Role Overview
=============

We are looking for a Senior AI Architect to define the enterprise architecture and technology strategy for Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across strategic customer programs and organizational platforms. The Senior AI Architect is the senior technical authority who establishes target architectures, makes cross\-platform technology decisions, leads architecture governance, shapes reusable reference patterns, and drives complex AI programs from strategy through production at scale.


* Senior enterprise AI architect and technical authority
* Owns target\-state architecture and strategic technology decisions
* Leads architecture governance and influences platform roadmap
* Provides technical leadership across architects, FDEs, engineering and customer teams

Typical time allocation
=======================

* \~55% architecture, strategy and technology decisions
* \~25% customer and executive stakeholder leadership
* \~20% architecture governance, mentoring and technical oversight
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the overall AI architecture strategy for strategic enterprise programs from business vision and discovery through production, scale\-out, and operational maturity.
* Lead executive and senior\-technical stakeholder discussions to establish the AI vision, target architecture, investment priorities, technical roadmap, and transformation approach.
* Define enterprise reference architectures and standards for Generative AI, Agentic AI, multi\-agent systems, RAG, model integration, AI platforms, and enterprise AI applications.
* Lead architecture decisions across GCP, Azure, AWS, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude, selecting platforms and patterns based on business value, technical fit, security, residency, performance, operational model, and cost.
* Define strategic architecture for agent platforms including agent orchestration, Planner/Critic/Supervisor/Orchestrator patterns, domain agents, Skills, tools, MCP, memory/state, workflow management, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Define enterprise AI data and knowledge architecture spanning structured/unstructured data, ingestion, processing, search, vector stores, knowledge graphs where required, retrieval, reranking, access controls, and evaluation.
* Establish architecture principles for model strategy including model selection, routing, fallback, fine\-tuned/specialized models, SLM/LLM usage, context management, caching, and AI FinOps.
* Define enterprise security, Responsible AI, and governance architecture including identity, authorization, data protection, privacy, guardrails, auditability, model risk, policy enforcement, and human approvals.
* Define enterprise AgentOps and AI operations architecture covering observability, evaluation, quality management, tracing, logging, cost monitoring, incident management, model/prompt/version management, and continuous improvement.
* Define target\-state architecture and phased roadmaps covering MVP, production, scale\-out, platform standardization, and BAU operating model.
* Establish architecture review, design assurance, technology standards, reference patterns, and decision governance for AI programs.
* Review and approve high\-level architecture, integration architecture, security architecture, deployment architecture, and major technical design decisions produced by AI Architects, FDEs, developers, and partner teams.
* Lead architectural assessment of complex customer requirements and determine where capabilities should be standardized, productized, bought, or built.
* Drive reusable architecture patterns and platform capabilities across customer programs and work with Product and Platform Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities.
* Lead complex architecture escalations and provide direction for major production incidents, systemic reliability issues, and cross\-platform technical challenges.
* Support proposals, RFPs, solution estimations, technical due diligence, POCs, business cases, and strategic customer engagements.
* Mentor AI Architects, Senior FDEs, FDEs, and engineering leads; establish architecture excellence and reusable engineering practices across the organization.
* Represent the AI architecture function in customer governance forums, architecture review boards, technology councils, and strategic planning sessions.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


Must Have Skills
================

* Deep software engineering and enterprise solution architecture experience with the ability to guide and challenge production implementations.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, multi\-agent architectures, tool use, evaluation, and enterprise AI application design.
* Strong experience with multiple AI/cloud platforms or demonstrated ability to design platform\-neutral architectures across hyperscaler and model\-provider ecosystems.
* Deep understanding of enterprise architecture across application, data, integration, cloud, security, networking, and operations.
* Strong experience designing enterprise AI platforms, reusable agent frameworks, integration patterns, and production operating models.
* Strong understanding of AI security, Responsible AI, governance, privacy, compliance, model risk, and enterprise controls.
* Strong experience with AI observability, evaluation, AgentOps, production reliability, and operational governance.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architecture, Kubernetes/serverless platforms, CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and enterprise landing zones.
* Strong customer\-facing leadership skills and ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to make architecture decisions under ambiguity and communicate complex trade\-offs clearly.
  

Preferred Skills
================

* Deep experience across two or more of GCP, Azure, AWS, OpenAI, or Anthropic Claude.
* Experience establishing enterprise AI reference architectures, platform standards, architecture review boards, and technology governance.
* Experience with MCP, A2A, enterprise agent interoperability, and multi\-agent platform strategy.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry and AI observability/evaluation platforms such as Cloud Observability, Azure Monitor/Application Insights, CloudWatch, LangSmith, Arize, or equivalent.
* Experience with enterprise security architecture, Zero Trust, private connectivity, data residency, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with AI FinOps, model strategy, platform consolidation, vendor evaluation, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership analysis.
* Experience leading large\-scale POCs, pilots, MVPs, production rollouts, RFPs, transformation programs, and strategic enterprise accounts.
  
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


Qualifications
==============

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 12–16 years of overall software engineering, cloud engineering, enterprise architecture, or equivalent technical experience.
* At least 5 years of practical Generative AI / Agentic AI experience, including enterprise production delivery.
* Demonstrated track record of owning architecture for multiple complex enterprise technology or AI programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading senior customer engagements, architecture governance, and cross\-functional technical teams.

Key Attributes
==============

* Strong enterprise architecture and strategic thinking combined with practical engineering judgment.
* Able to define a long\-term architecture while maintaining a pragmatic path from MVP to production scale.
* Strong executive presence and ability to build trust with customers and internal leadership.
* Highly effective at resolving cross\-team architectural conflicts and driving decisions to closure.
* Strong mentoring, influence, and architecture leadership capability.
* Continuously evaluates emerging AI technologies and translates relevant advances into practical enterprise architecture patterns.

Job Title: Mainframe Architect
  

Position: Architect  

Experience: 10\-12 Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: General
  

Main location: Hyderabad  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 10 years of relevant experience.  

Position Description  

We are looking for a Mainframe Solution Architect to design end\-to\-end technical solutions for complex business requirements across Mainframe and modern technology platforms. The role will provide technical and architectural leadership across the solution lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.  

The Solution Architect will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, architects, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to understand business objectives and translate them into scalable and sustainable technical solutions. The role will focus on Mainframe application architecture, modernization, integration, APIs, distributed systems, cloud and hybrid technologies, automation, and DevOps practices.  

The role will also involve evaluating existing Mainframe applications and recommending appropriate modernization, re\-engineering, migration, or integration approaches while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, performance, scalability, reliability, and development standards.  

\#LI\-AS26

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance Mainframe applications while providing appropriate architectural and technical guidance.
* Perform impact analysis and guide code modifications across Mainframe applications and dependent systems.
* Design and execute, or provide guidance for, unit and integration testing.
* Analyze production incidents and provide technical direction for resolution.
* Support batch and online processing systems from an architectural and technical perspective.
* Collaborate with distributed teams, architects, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders.
* Design end\-to\-end technical solutions for complex business requirements across Mainframe and modern technology platforms.
* Lead solution architecture and technical design activities, including application architecture, integration patterns, interfaces, data flows, and technology decisions.
* Work closely with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Evaluate existing Mainframe applications and recommend modernization, re\-engineering, migration, or integration approaches based on business and technical requirements.
* Define integration strategies between Mainframe applications, APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.
* Assess technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, constraints, and effort associated with proposed solutions and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
* Lead architecture and solution review sessions and communicate technical options, trade\-offs, and recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, performance, scalability, reliability, and development standards.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the solution lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Owners and delivery teams to break down complex requirements into technical components, identify dependencies, and support delivery planning.
* Guide development teams on solution implementation and resolve complex technical issues and design challenges.
* Review and provide technical approval for solution designs, application changes, integration designs, and complex code implementations.
* Drive technical decisions across multiple applications or modules and ensure consistency of design across dependent systems.
* Lead Mainframe modernization and transformation initiatives, including the adoption of APIs, cloud/hybrid technologies, automation, and DevOps practices.
* Identify opportunities to simplify application architecture, reduce technical debt, improve performance, and increase maintainability.
* Mentor senior developers and technical leads and provide guidance on architecture, design patterns, Mainframe technologies, and engineering practices.
* Create and maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, integration specifications, technical diagrams, and key architectural decisions.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, data, cloud, integration, and other technology teams to ensure successful implementation of end\-to\-end solutions.
* Participate in modernization initiatives and assist with migration and integration with modern technologies.
* Implement automation and DevOps practices where applicable.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Must\-Have Skills  

* Strong experience with COBOL, JCL, DB2, VSAM, and CICS.
* Strong working knowledge of REXX.
* Experience with Endevor/Changeman and File\-Aid.
* Strong knowledge of IBM Mainframe utilities.
* Strong understanding of Mainframe batch and online processing systems.
* Experience in Mainframe application architecture and technical solution design.
* Experience designing end\-to\-end technical solutions for complex business requirements.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration patterns, interfaces, and data flows.
* Experience performing impact analysis, technical feasibility assessment, dependency analysis, and risk assessment.
* Experience defining integration strategies across Mainframe applications, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise applications.
* Experience providing technical leadership throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Experience working with distributed teams, architects, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience in solution design, architecture reviews, technical documentation, and technical decision\-making.

Good\-to\-Have Skills  

* Experience with Mainframe modernization and transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to APIs and hybrid architecture.
* Experience integrating Mainframe applications with distributed or modern applications.
* Exposure to cloud and hybrid technologies.
* Exposure to DevOps, automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with migration and integration with modern technologies.
* Experience identifying opportunities to simplify application architecture, reduce technical debt, improve performance, and increase maintainability.
* Experience mentoring senior developers and technical leads on architecture, design patterns, Mainframe technologies, and engineering practices.


CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

d52afa1c.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.
* 5 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.
* 5 years of experience with coding in one or more general purpose languages.
* 1 year of experience leading teams in a technical capacity or leading technical risk analysis in an enterprise environment.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with physical access control, intrusion detection, case management, video management, Physical Security Information Management (PSIM), IT networking, construction/architecture, and no\-code development platforms.
* Experience in technology delivery, design and execution within Physical/Cyber Security industries with PSP, CPP, CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA Network\+ or Cisco CCNA certification.
* Experience aligning teams across various disciplines, including operational, engineering, product, and UX.
* Ability to successfully navigate through competing priorities, present complex ideas with clarity, and build strong partnerships with stakeholders.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring, through informal authority.

**About the job**
-----------------


Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.



Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.
  

  

In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness. You will be responsible for completing initiatives that improve Google’s ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act on security risks globally. You will drive delivery of physical security technology solutions in scope of the Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) organization. You will partner internally to prototype and develop solutions on accelerated timelines against stakeholder requirements, owning the full end to end delivery and support of those solutions throughout their lifecycle. Your delivery will enable GSRS operations to keep Google and Google employees safe and secure across the global office locations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Analyze operational processes and business requirements to ensure alignment with the overall goal and delivery of the technology roadmap, new or existing products, with a focus on accessibility, scalable growth, automation, and business outcomes that mitigate key risks.
* Deliver technology solutions against strategic plans through tactical activities such as gathering requirements, developing user stories, lab testing and creating project, rollout and communications plans. Support evaluation, integration, and implementation of third party solutions.
* Provide mentoring and guidance for junior colleagues, peers and stakeholders as a subject matter expert in physical security towards shared business goals and objectives.
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of deployed solutions, gathering feedback and iterating to improve user experience and outcomes.
* Manage highly confidential information and safeguard company intellectual property.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform is well\-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work\-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.


**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced **Pre\-Sales Manager** to lead our pre\-sales function in crafting compelling, technically grounded proposals and solutions that translate Simform's engineering capabilities into measurable client value. This role sits at the intersection of sales, solution architecture, and client engagement. The ideal candidate will deeply understand Simform's co\-engineering model and service portfolio, and articulate that value with precision and confidence to enterprise and high\-growth technology clients.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead the end\-to\-end development of pre\-sales collateral including Proposals, RFPs, RFIs, Statements of Work (SoW), Solution Decks, and Capability Presentations aligned to Simform's offerings.
* Translate complex client requirements into clearly scoped engineering solutions spanning custom software development, cloud\-native architecture, AI/ML, data platforms, DevOps, and mobile applications.
* Maintain a repository of reusable proposal components, case studies, and solution templates mapped to Simform's service lines and industry verticals.
* Partner with the sales team during client discovery, solution scoping, and commercial negotiations to ensure pre\-sales outputs align with client needs.
* Lead client\-facing meetings, presentations, and solution workshops — including engagements with C\-suite and technical decision\-makers — translating technical concepts into executive\-ready business value narratives.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a dedicated pre\-sales team of 5\+ professionals (exclusively pre\-sales, not post\-sales), setting standards for proposal quality, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Collaborate with solution architects and engineering leads to ensure all proposed solutions are technically sound and deliverable.
* Stay updated on current capabilities across **Microsoft Azure**, cloud\-native/MACH architectures, Agentic AI, data engineering, DevOps, and mobile and custom software development.
* Ensure pre\-sales engagements incorporate relevant compliance, security, and governance considerations across key verticals: Fintech, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Retail \& E\-Commerce, Supply Chain \& Logistics, and High\-Tech.
* Track pre\-sales metrics (win rates, proposal quality, deal velocity) and surface insights to sales leadership.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* **8\+ years of experience in pre\-sales**, ideally within a digital engineering, product engineering, or IT services company.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent field.
* Demonstrated experience **leading a pre\-sales team of 5\+ members** in a high\-growth environment.
* Strong working knowledge of:
* **Cloud platforms**: Microsoft Azure
* **Engineering services**: Custom software development, cloud\-native applications, microservices, API development, mobile applications (iOS/Android)
* **Data \& AI**: Data engineering, AI/ML, Agentic AI, LLMs, analytics platforms
* **DevOps**: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud operations
* Excellent proposal writing, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent deals across different industries and solution domains.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Microsoft Azure certifications (particularly in Digital \& App Innovation or Data \& AI) strongly preferred; other cloud or technology certifications a plus.
* Familiarity with Simform's co\-engineering model and agile delivery practices.
* Experience with MACH architecture principles (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, Headless).
* Prior exposure to ISV or enterprise software product development contexts.
* Industry domain expertise in one or more of: Fintech, Healthcare, Retail \& E\-Commerce, or Supply Chain.

**Why Join Us:**


* Young Team, Thriving Culture Flat\-hierarchical, friendly, engineering\-oriented, and growth\-focused culture. Well\-balanced learning and growth opportunities Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in\-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options

 USEReady helps enterprises apply AI and agentic intelligence to improve decisions, automate operations, and build smarter, more autonomous business systems.

 We work closely with technology leaders such as AWS, Elementum, Snowflake, Tableau, Databricks, and others to help organizations modernize analytics, strengthen governance, and deploy agentic automation with confidence.

 Our deep expertise, player\-coach delivery model, and focus on fast, measurable results make us a trusted partner for building an AI\-ready enterprise.

 Expert knowledge of wet stock management, fuel reconciliation, tank gauging, and inventory control using platforms such as OPW, Implico, or Leighton.
   

  

 Deep understanding of forecourt operations, site compliance, HSE requirements, and regulatory frameworks across multiple geographies.

 Strong working knowledge of fuels retail ERP landscapes, system integration patterns, and data flows across the retail value chain.

****Job Description****
 HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build
 **HPE Networking** 
 , with the ambition of creating the
 **best networking business on the planet** 
 . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of
 **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program** 
 , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a
 **single platform** 
 , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
   

  

 As part of a fast\-moving,
 **multi\-year transformation** 
 , the team will stabilize near\-term operations,
 **migrate core** 
**platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally** 
 , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with
 **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** 
 on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
   

  

 For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help
 **build a new business unit from its earliest days** 
 , rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain
 **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership** 
 , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
   

  

**HPE Global IT is a dynamic organization enabling the enterprise to innovate and lead the industry with our consumption\-based IT transformation and our consulting, financial, educational, and operational support services. Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.**
****What You’ll Do:****
**Workstream\-Specific Details**
****Responsibilities****
* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for services and software subscription offers across the combined HPE and Juniper portfolios, spanning quote, order, fulfillment, entitlement, and renewal.
* Translate subscription and SaaS commercial constructs — term, usage\-based, committed\-consumption, co\-term, and mid\-term change — into platform\-level design on the target L2C stack.
* Design and document subscription data models, product/offer structures, and integration patterns between CPQ, order management, entitlement, billing, and asset management systems.
* Partner with business, product, and pricing leaders to pressure\-test offer designs for feasibility, then define the architecture runway required to deliver them.
* Lead design reviews and architecture decision records; resolve cross\-workstream dependencies and drive alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Guide migration of subscription and support contracts from fragmented legacy systems onto the unified platform, including data mapping, reconciliation, and cutover design.
* Support build and test teams as the design authority — clarifying intent, reviewing configuration, and triaging defects that trace to architectural decisions.
* Identify and escalate architectural risks, technical debt, and scalability constraints with recommended mitigations to program leadership.


****Education And Experience Required****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution or application architecture, with at least 5 years focused on Lead\-to\-Cash, CPQ, order management, or subscription billing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience architecting services and software subscription offers (SaaS, term license, consumption\-based, and support/services contracts) at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on delivery experience with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CPQ, Oracle, Zuora, or comparable subscription and order management systems.
* Track record on large\-scale transformation, ERP/CRM migration, or post\-merger integration programs, including legacy data migration and cutover.
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed environment with onshore/offshore delivery teams.
* Relevant architecture or platform certifications (e.g., TOGAF, SAP, Salesforce) an asset.


****What You Need To Bring:****
**Knowledge And Skills**
* Deep knowledge of subscription commercial models — term, usage, committed consumption, co\-term, ramp, renewal, and mid\-term change — and how they are represented in system design.
* Strong command of quote\-to\-cash process design across CPQ, contracting, order orchestration, entitlement, provisioning, billing, and revenue recognition.
* Solid grasp of integration architecture: APIs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and master data management across product, customer, and install\-base domains.
* Ability to produce clear architecture artifacts — solution designs, data models, interface specifications, and decision records — that development teams can build from.
* Analytical and structured problem solver, comfortable making design decisions with incomplete information and revisiting them as the program matures.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to explain technical trade\-offs to executives and business stakeholders in plain language.
* Collaborative working style with the credibility to act as design authority across multiple workstreams and vendors.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the pace of a multi\-year integration program.

 Expert

**Function**

**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data.


If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.


**Job description**
===================

**Meet our Team**  

The Revenue Performance Organization in Controllership is a dynamic, stakeholder and customer\-oriented team in Finance that is focusing on revenue recognition. We value business\-focus while ensuring that we meet compliance and revenue standards under IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards). We collaborate with logistics, FP\&A, broader controllership, change management, shared services, and audit associates.
  

  

**What you’ll be doing** :
  

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting multi\-country, project\-based engagements across several countries and functions globally. Your responsibilities will include preparing invoice requests for global clients, performing balance sheet reconciliations, maintaining cost files, completing various calculations, and ensuring the accurate recording of project\-related transactions across multiple countries. You will also initiate and monitor a wide range of financial transactions.
  

As a Managed Services Accountant, you will collaborate closely with GL Accountants, Revenue Accounting teams, Deal Support, GFSS teams, and other stakeholders across Hitachi Vantara, including Finance Managers, Client Directors, Service Delivery Managers, Services Controllers, Program and Project Managers, and Financial Accountants. You will have opportunities to work with Global Revenue Performance colleagues to drive consistency in best practices and professional judgment. The role also involves interaction with external customers and internal and external auditors, as well as supporting ad hoc finance activities as required.
  

  

**What you bring to the team** :
  

* 1\+ years’ experience in finance and accounting
* Experience of the Order to Cash process and industry leading best practice
* Working knowledge of IFRS and SOX
* Experience of working directly with multiple countries and cultures in a finance capacity
* Knowledge of Oracle
* Knowledge of Excel
* Fluent English

648998dd.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
648998dd.description:
**Description**
 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

eef90a4a.title: IDM - Technical Architect (Saviynt).
eef90a4a.description:
Location: Remote (India or Eastern Europe)
 



 Timezone: CET to IST Timezone
 



 Experience: Minimum 10 years
 



 Employment Type: Contract (12 months)
 



 Start Date: Immediate Start
 



  





 Role Purpose
 



 For our Global client (strong presence in Europe), we are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to support the transition of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to Saviynt. The role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, business application knowledge, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills to ensure a successful migration and adoption across the enterprise.
 



  





 The successful candidate will work closely with application owners, business stakeholders, security teams, and external vendors to design, implement, and support identity governance and access management solutions during the transformation program.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Support the migration of Identity and Access Management capabilities from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to Saviynt.
* Collaborate with business application owners to understand access management requirements and integration needs.
* Design, configure, test, and implement IAM solutions and access governance processes within Saviynt.
* Lead application onboarding activities for enterprise systems including SAP, Veeva, Employee Central (SuccessFactors), and other business\-critical applications.
* Analyze existing roles, entitlements, provisioning workflows, and access control models to support migration and optimization.
* Partner with Cyber Security, Infrastructure, HR, Compliance, and Business teams to ensure alignment with security and regulatory requirements.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), defect resolution, and production deployment activities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, process flows, integration specifications, and operational procedures.
* Provide technical guidance and best practices related to Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).
* Support post\-migration stabilization activities and continuous improvement initiatives.



  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Minimum 7 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), or related security domains.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) and/or Saviynt implementations and migrations.
* Strong understanding of user lifecycle management, provisioning, deprovisioning, role management, access certifications, and segregation of duties concepts.
* Experience integrating and supporting enterprise business applications such as: SAP, Veeva, Employee Central (SuccessFactors), Other HR, ERP, CRM, or regulated business applications
* Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders and application owners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and vice versa.
* Experience working in global and cross\-functional environments.



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience with pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries.
* Knowledge of identity governance frameworks and security best practices.
* Experience with Active Directory, Azure AD / Entra ID, LDAP, SSO, and access management technologies.
* Familiarity with compliance requirements such as SOX, GDPR, and audit controls.
* Relevant certifications in IAM, Cyber Security, Saviynt, or related technologies.



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Technical Leadership
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Engagement
* Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking
* Communication and Presentation Skills
* Collaboration and Influencing Skills
* Delivery Focus and Accountability
* Change and Transformation Management

**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. **About the Role:**


The Sr Manager of Connectivity, Cloud and Automation serves as the enterprise leader for security‑focused cloud networking, global connectivity platforms, and automation engineering. This role defines and drives the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of next‑generation network security, cloud connectivity, DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms, automation frameworks, and reliability engineering practices.

**Strategic Leadership \& Architecture**


* Define and own the enterprise strategy for network security, cloud networking, connectivity platforms, and automation.
* Establish target‑state architectures across firewalls, cloud networking, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, observability, automation, and connectivity services.

**Connectivity Platform \& Automation**


* DNS/DHCP/IPAM (Infoblox), Public DNS \& Domains, Akamai GTM/Geo, certificate management, automation (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git), observability, reliability engineering, SRE practices, ITSM/ITIL stewardship.
* Own DNS, DHCP, IPAM, domain services, global traffic management.
* Lead automation strategy using Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Git.
* Implement observability and SRE frameworks.
* Manage digital certificate lifecycle.

  

**Vendor \& Platform Management**


* Lead strategic vendor partnerships and contract optimization.
* Ensure global platform resiliency and service delivery.

  

**Operational Excellence**


* Ensure network availability, performance, and scalability.
* Drive automation, AIOps, and reliability improvements.
* Lead governance representing Connectivity, Security, Automation services.

  

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders on Network technology strategy and design.
* Collaborate with global teams across Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure \& Operations.
* Represent Network in global governance forums and architecture boards.
* Mentor engineers, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and accountability

  



**What You'll Bring:**


* 12\+ years in network security, cloud networking, or connectivity architecture, with 5\+ years leading teams
* Expertise in firewalls, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud networking (AWS), DNS/DHCP/IPAM, load balancing, NAC, and automation
* Experience leading global platform engineering and modernization
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with budget management and business case development / investment justification
* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Engineering or Computer Science required
* Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) preferred
* People management, coaching, and development experience required
* Strategic and analytical thinker with the ability to balance vision with execution
* Collaborative and inclusive leader who fosters global teamwork and shared accountability
* Continuous learner with curiosity about emerging technologies and their business impact
* Strong communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and simplify complex technical narratives
* Ownership mindset – accountable for technology / architecture integrity and driving measurable business outcomes

  

**Licenses and Certifications:**


* CCNA \- Cisco Certified Network Technician/Cisco Certified Network Architect Required
* AWS Certified Solution Architect/AWS Advanced Networking Required
* CCNP \- Cisco Certified Network Professional/Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Preferred
* CCDP \- Cisco Certified Design Professional Preferred
* CISSP Certified Information Systems Security Professional Preferred
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Preferred

  

**Physical Demands Category:** Corporate Office

**Travel**

* International: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.
