69b2cfca.title: Architect
69b2cfca.description:
**Position:** Architect – Design \& Project Coordination  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Real Estate Development  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Qualification:** B.Arch / M.Arch  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a **Architect – Design \& Project Coordination** to support the planning, design development and execution of residential and real estate development projects.

The role will involve working closely with senior management, design consultants, structural and MEP consultants, project teams, contractors and other stakeholders to translate project requirements into functional, commercially viable and execution\-ready architectural solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong architectural fundamentals, hands\-on experience in design and documentation, good understanding of construction and real estate development, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Architectural Design \& Planning**

* Develop and support conceptual, schematic and detailed architectural designs for residential and real estate projects.
* Prepare and review plans, elevations, sections, layouts, area statements and architectural details.
* Support master planning, space planning, unit planning, amenity planning and overall project design development.
* Evaluate design options based on functionality, aesthetics, constructability and project requirements.
* Translate project briefs and business requirements into practical architectural solutions.

**2\. Design Development \& Documentation**

* Prepare detailed working drawings, construction drawings and GFC documentation.
* Develop architectural details, schedules, specifications and drawing packages.
* Review drawings for accuracy, consistency, constructability and design intent before issue.
* Maintain drawing registers, revisions and project documentation.
* Ensure timely delivery of drawings and design\-related deliverables as per project schedules.

**3\. Consultant \& Design Coordination**

* Coordinate with structural, MEP, landscape, interior, façade and other specialist consultants.
* Review and integrate consultant drawings with architectural requirements.
* Identify design conflicts and coordination issues and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Participate in design coordination and project review meetings.
* Track design changes, approvals and outstanding technical requirements.

**4\. Site \& Execution Coordination**

* Conduct regular site visits to monitor architectural execution against approved drawings and specifications.
* Review site conditions and provide design clarifications wherever required.
* Coordinate with project managers, contractors and site teams on architectural matters.
* Review shop drawings, material samples and technical submissions where required.
* Identify design\-to\-execution gaps and support timely resolution of site issues.
* Ensure design intent, quality and architectural standards are maintained during execution.

**5\. Statutory \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Support compliance with applicable building regulations, development control norms and statutory requirements.
* Assist with area calculations, FSI/FAR, setbacks, parking and other planning parameters.
* Coordinate with approval consultants and relevant stakeholders for statutory submissions and approvals.
* Maintain awareness of applicable local regulations and development norms, particularly for Hyderabad projects.

**6\. Project \& Design Reviews**

* Participate in design review meetings with senior management, consultants and project teams.
* Prepare presentations, design proposals and project updates for internal reviews.
* Evaluate design changes with respect to functionality, cost, timelines and project objectives.
* Support value engineering and design optimisation initiatives without compromising project quality.

**7\. Real Estate Development Support**

* Provide architectural inputs during feasibility and early\-stage project planning.
* Support evaluation of development potential through planning studies, area analysis and design options.
* Work with the Strategy, Projects, Sales, Marketing and other teams to ensure the product is aligned with market and project requirements.
* Contribute to design decisions that improve customer experience, project positioning and overall development value.

Candidate Profile

* **3–5 years of professional experience** in architecture, preferably with a real estate developer, architectural consultancy, PMC or construction organisation.
* **B.Arch / M.Arch** from a recognised institution.
* Experience in **residential, high\-rise, premium/luxury residential, commercial or large\-scale real estate projects** will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of architectural design, construction documentation and project execution.
* Ability to independently handle design development and architectural coordination for assigned project components.
* Good understanding of building planning, construction materials, architectural detailing and site execution.
* Working knowledge of applicable building bye\-laws and statutory approval processes.
* Knowledge of **Hyderabad real estate development regulations / GHMC / HMDA / DTCP processes** will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, coordination, problem\-solving and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables and work within project timelines.

Technical Skills

**Must Have:**

* AutoCAD
* MS Office – particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Architectural working drawings and documentation
* Construction detailing
* Consultant coordination

**Preferred:**

* Revit / BIM
* SketchUp
* Lumion / Enscape / V\-Ray or similar rendering software
* Photoshop / Adobe Creative Suite
* Knowledge of BIM\-based coordination workflows

Preferred Experience

Candidates with exposure to the following will be preferred:

* Residential / high\-rise developments
* Premium or luxury real estate projects
* Master planning and large\-scale developments
* GFC and construction documentation
* Site execution and architectural coordination
* Consultant management
* Statutory approvals and development regulations
* FSI/FAR and area calculations
* Design optimisation and value engineering
* End\-to\-end project lifecycle from design through execution

Key Competencies

**Architectural Design \| Design Development \| Working Drawings \| GFC Documentation \| Real Estate Development \| Consultant Coordination \| Site Coordination \| Building Regulations \| Project Planning \| Construction Detailing \| Design Review \| Problem Solving \| Stakeholder Management**

Pay: Up to ₹65,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

cd0b18a8.title: ERP Solution Consultant - Clinical Supply
cd0b18a8.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
The SAP ERP Solution Consultant is a part of SAP experts supporting Roche Clinical Supply operations (PTDS). You will lead independently complex SAP solution delivery (ECC and S4\) in the area of Production Planning and Process (PP\-PI), proactively solve product issues, and contribute to architecture. In this role, you will drive SAP solutions, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product\-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report to the Team Lead of ERP Clinical Supplies and Advanced Therapies
  
Description of the area
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Works independently to deliver ERP solutions in the area of PP\-PI and proactively identifies and addresses challenges. Seeks senior colleague support for complex product scenarios while ensuring adherence to processes for timely and high\-quality results. Contributes to specific chapter\-related outcomes,fosters effective teamwork, and actively solicits ideas from others within the project team.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Deals with uncertainty and makes decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.
* Stakeholder Management: Primarily interacts within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable.Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.
* Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to a specific workgroup or project.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates the ability to prioritize and report status at the product level.
* Business / Technical ability: Applies a basic understanding of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis. Demonstrates good knowledge of ERP IT Business Analysis and Consultancy concepts and practices.


Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Experience in regulatedpharmaenvironments, including CSV and data privacy concepts, change management, documentation and testing.
* Demonstrated 5\+ years experience working and leading independently to deliver complex solution designs and products within the SAP ERP area \-SAP PP\-PI.
* Strong background ininterfaces, integration through idocs and APIs.
* Proficiency in Logistics Execution (LE) and Sales\& Distribution (SD) is preferred.
* Proven track record of driving the successful completion of major implementations or changes in SAP ECC/S4 area, frequently functioning in a leadership or tech lead role.
* Strong preference for candidates with SAP life cycle solutions experience (e.g. ICSM, CGT/TMP).
* Ability to organize your work, proactively seek knowledge and work independently.


Technical Skills
  
  

* Expert knowledge of ERP IT Business Analysis / Consultancy concepts and practices in the area of PP\-PI.
* Strong knowledge of external integrations with with ECC and S/4
* Good knowledge of LE/SD/WM is an advantage.
* Basic understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Basic to intermediate level of pharmaceutical process knowledge.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong collaborative mindset with a track record of actively soliciting ideas from project team members.
* Solid stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of interacting on small to medium engagements and articulating the business impact of their work.


**Shift:** CET Timezone
  
\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

1a5929c2.title: Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect
1a5929c2.description:
At **Epiq** , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, **relentless service** sets the bar, and we **thrive on big challenges** together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** and see your impact at scale.


**Job Description:**

**Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect \- AI Solutions** with strong expertise in Full Stack Software Development, Solution Design, Data Engineering, and AI/ML implementation.

  

  

This is a hands\-on engineering role for an experienced software developer who combines strong technical design skills with recent experience building and deploying AI\-powered applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable solutions, contributing to software development, and implementing modern AI capabilities that align with our product and solution offerings.

  

  

As a Staff Software Engineer/ Solution Architect, you will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, leadership teams, clients, data scientists, consultants, DevOps engineers, and software engineers to design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications and AI\-driven solutions. You will play a key role in translating complex business problems into scalable technical solutions while ensuring engineering excellence, maintainability, and long\-term product success.

  

  

**Job Responsibilities**

* Partner with business and product stakeholders to understand requirements, design end\-to\-end solutions, and help Product Owners break down initiatives into actionable user stories and technical deliverables.
* Design and develop scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions that can be integrated into existing products and strategic solution offerings.
* Actively contribute to software development, code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture reviews.
* Drive solution design decisions while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, performance, and operational requirements.
* Leverage strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to understand complex business challenges and develop innovative AI\-powered solutions.
* Champion engineering best practices, coding standards, testing strategies, and quality metrics across development teams.
* Integrate and optimize data from various internal and external systems, understanding the challenges associated with enterprise data integration across SaaS applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain APIs, services, and integrations that support enterprise applications and AI solutions.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability of applications and AI systems.
* Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure data quality, availability, and successful deployment of AI and machine learning capabilities.
* Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines, processing frameworks, and supporting infrastructure required for AI and machine learning workloads.
* Build and deploy AI\-powered applications utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks, and modern AI orchestration patterns.
* Apply prompt engineering techniques and AI best practices to improve the quality, relevance, and reliability of generative AI solutions.
* Communicate technical solutions, risks, and recommendations effectively to leadership, business stakeholders, and clients.
* Stay current with advancements in software engineering, AI, machine learning, and cloud technologies, recommending practical innovations for our products and operations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, resolve complex technical challenges, and foster a collaborative engineering culture.
  

  

**Requirements / Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development, Solution Design, Data Engineering, and AI/ML implementation.
* Strong hands\-on software engineering background with proven experience designing and developing enterprise\-scale applications.
* Demonstrated experience designing technical solutions and participating in architecture reviews, system design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and Java with strong experience building APIs, services, and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience implementing and deploying Generative AI solutions in production environments.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering, MCP, A2A, and modern AI application development patterns.
* Experience working with NLP frameworks and machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms and services including Azure and/or AWS.
* Experience with DevOps tools and practices including CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, AKS, EKS, GitHub Actions, and containerized deployments.
* Experience building modern user interfaces using React, Bootstrap, and related frameworks.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience working with Snowflake, Databricks, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of Data Integration, ETL, Data Quality, Data Discovery, and enterprise data management concepts.
* Experience integrating third\-party and enterprise APIs.
* Familiarity with metadata management tools and data governance concepts.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively engage clients, business stakeholders, leadership teams, and engineering organizations.

Your specific salary will be determined based on several factors:


* **Location\-based market rate** for the role
* **Your abilities** in relation to the job specification
* **Performance** during screening and interview
* **Pay parity** with the wider team in the considered location

Further details about the package will be provided during the initial screening call with the Talent Acquisition Team.

  


**Epiq Leadership Compass**

**Fosters Relationships \& Collaboration**

Builds trust and alignment through open communication, shared goals, and strong partnerships to drive collective success.


* Build trust\-based partnerships
* Nurture long\-term relationships
* Remove collaboration barriers
* Celebrate cross\-team success

**Engages \& Influences**

Inspires action and alignment through clear communication, purposeful influence, and a compelling vision.


* Use storytelling to build buy\-in
* Align communication with organizational goals
* Guild alignment through strong engagement

**Maximizes Performance**

Sets and reinforces performance standards that drive results, ensure accountability, and align with Epiq’s goals.


* Use data to identify improvement opportunities
* Make informed decisions
* Align team goals with boarder strategy
* Empower teams to manage their own goals
* Translate vision into clear priorities
* Prepare for disruptions with strong change management

**Achieves Operational Success**

Drives continuous improvement and operational excellence through smart processes, data insights, and quality execution.


* Improve workflows for team efficiency
* Use clear documentation and expectations
* Resolve issues quickly using data and feedback

**It is Epiq’s policy to comply with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws by making all employment decisions without unlawful regard or consideration of any individual’s race, religion, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, transgender status, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, marital status, age, national origin, genetic information, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, veteran or family status or any other basis protected by applicable national, federal, state, provincial or local law. Epiq’s policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on any of these impermissible bases, as well as any bases or grounds protected by applicable law in each jurisdiction. In addition Epiq will take affirmative action for minorities, women, covered veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. Epiq is pleased to provide such assistance and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request. Pursuant to relevant law, where applicable, Epiq will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.**

3c54ca87.title: Solution Engineer _ BA ( Immediate Joiner, 2+Yrs, WFO)
3c54ca87.description:
**Company Description** 
 eShipz is a fast\-growing logistics automation platform that helps brands streamline shipping operations and deliver seamless post\-purchase experiences. The platform offers modules for multi\-carrier shipping, real\-time tracking, NDR management, returns, freight audit, and more, enabling businesses to manage logistics efficiently at scale. With features such as automated shipping labels, real\-time alerts, analytics and reporting, and reliable customer support, eShipz supports both eCommerce and enterprise clients. Over 350 businesses trust eShipz to simplify and optimize their logistics workflows across carriers and channels.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Solution Engineer – BA role at eShipz is a full\-time, on\-site position based in the Greater Bengaluru Area. In this role, the professional will work closely with clients to understand business requirements, translate them into functional and technical specifications, and configure eShipz solutions to meet those needs. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collaborating with product and development teams, supporting integrations with customer systems and carriers, performing solution demos, and assisting with presales and implementation activities. The role also involves troubleshooting issues, optimizing workflows, documenting processes, and ensuring a smooth transition from onboarding to ongoing support for immediate and new customers.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong software development and system integration understanding, with the ability to work with APIs, data mapping, and technical workflows.
* Candidates should possess consulting and business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process documentation, and solution design aligned to logistics operations.
* Candidates should possess sales and presales capabilities, such as conducting demos, supporting proposals, and collaborating with sales teams to address customer needs.
* Candidates should possess integration\-focused skills, including coordinating with technical teams and external partners to ensure successful end\-to\-end solution deployment.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field, and 2\+ years of experience in solution engineering, business analysis, or a similar role.
* Additional beneficial skills include knowledge of logistics or eCommerce domains, strong communication and stakeholder management, analytical problem\-solving, and readiness to join immediately.

5872c1c2.title: Implementation Architect
5872c1c2.description:
**Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore**
**About AppViewX:**
 AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole’s 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
   

  

* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** 
 We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** 
 We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** 
 We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.


 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
   

  

**What will you be responsible for?**
 Customer Success Implementation Architects play a key role in driving Customer onboarding, Solutioning and ongoing adoption and usage of AppViewX product. You will lead the implementation of AppViewX solutions for automating customer IT Network infrastructure and Public Key Infrastructure. You will combine your deep technical knowledge with an understanding of customer business objectives /challenges help customers maximize the value of AppViewX products. You will work in the Customer Success team looking at opportunities to automate service offerings around different AppViewX products, tools and processes.
   

  

**Onboarding**
* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Address customer objectives/success criteria with in\-depth technical attention to help customer Go\-live quickly.


**Adoption and Value Quantification**
* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement additional AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Act as a trusted technical advisor by assisting customers navigate technical challenges throughout the implementation process.
* Identify new use cases as part of account growth/renewal strategy


**Customer Experience/Engagement**
* Use your experiences working with customers to provide feedback to the rest of the AppViewX organization on how we can improve the customer experience, speed time\-to\-value, and create greater benefits for our customers
* Use your experience to look at opportunities to automate, develop tools that aid your team to reduce man hours.
* Contribute to Customer Business Reviews highlighting potential areas of improvements.


**Roadmap Planning**
* Partner closely with other cross\-functional team members (e.g., sales, product management, support, services, delivery) to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions
* Work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize product enhancements and long term roadmap based on customer/industry priorities.


**What do we require?**
* Minimum 5 years’ experience working in a technical implementation role
* Open to work in US Shift
* Minimum 3 years’ experience working in customer\-facing technical roles (such as Customer Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Subject Matter Expert), preferably in a post\-sales capacity, for a SaaS company with enterprise software products
* Love of programming, solid coding skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Java.
* Experience with web service development and using RESTful APIs
* Understanding of configuration management tools such as Chef/Puppet/Vagrant/Ansible/Salt preferred
* Experience with building Jenkins/automated test frameworks preferred
* Domain knowledge on PKI, DNS, Active Directory,cloud, ADCS, CRL, OCSP, and associated cryptographic standards
+ Experience with Certificate Life Cycle management/operations
+ Experience with PKI implementation processes
+ Experience with PKI integrations, MS Intune, SCEP, other enrollment practices

* Hands on experience with:
+ Kubernetes
+ Linux / Windows server management
+ Apache, IIS \- application expertise

* CISSP / CISM / CISA is preferred
* Excellent organization, troubleshooting, problem solving, deployment and multitasking skills with ability to learn new technology at a fast pace
* Worked and interacted with F500 organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills


**Why AppViewX?**
 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.
   

  

 AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX’s policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

b0e95efa.title: SFDC Senior Developer, IT Solutions
b0e95efa.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.

  

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Support design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Serve as the technical developer for Salesforce projects and enhancements, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security standards, and best practices.
* Follow establish development standards to improve code quality, maintainability, and platform performance.
* Collaborate with Business Systems Analysts, Product Owners, Architects, QA teams, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Support solution design discussions and provide technical guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using APIs, middleware platforms, and event\-driven architectures.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, and compliance with established governance standards.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices, DevOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide leadership during critical incident resolution.
* Identify opportunities to optimize existing applications and processes through Salesforce platform capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Provide coaching, training, and knowledge transfer to team members while supporting career development and technical growth.
  

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Salesforce development and solution delivery.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II.
* Strong expertise in:
	+ Apex
	+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
	+ Salesforce Flows
	+ SOQL/SOSL
	+ Salesforce APIs and Integration Patterns
	+ Sales Cloud
	+ Service Cloud
* Experience with Git\-based source control and CI/CD deployment methodologies.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and governance.
* Proven ability to collaborate with cross\-functional global teams and communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience performing code reviews, solution reviews, release planning, and technical estimations.
  

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect.
* Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Experience with Copado, Gearset, GitHub, JIRA, BitBucket.
* Proven experience integrating Salesforce with ERP platforms, SAS\-based applications, and external customer\-facing systems using APIs, middleware, and integration best practices.
* Experience supporting global implementations across multiple business units and geographies.
* Experience in highly regulated industries such as Medical Devices, Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, or Life Sciences.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence technical direction and drive adoption of best practices.
* Experience with AI capabilities within Salesforce ecosystem, including Agentforce, Einstein AI, and predictive automation.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira.
  

  

Recruiting scam alert: Read our notice about potential recruiting scams.

b3749615.title: Azure Data Architect
b3749615.description:
Azure Data Architect
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Azure Data Solutions Architect leads the design and implementation of enterprise\-scale data solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Azure Synapse Analytics. This role provides architectural leadership, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business strategy and industry best practices. The architect drives innovation, enforces governance, and mentors teams to deliver high\-quality, future\-ready data platforms that support organizational transformation.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Design and implement scalable data architectures using Azure services


Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Apache Spark


Architect data lake and data warehouse solutions using Azure Data Lake and Azure Synapse Analytics


Define data modeling strategies (batch \& real\-time processing)


Ensure data security, governance, and compliance standards


Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions


Optimize performance and cost efficiency of data workloads


Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows


Mentor and guide data engineers and development teams


Integrate advanced analytics, AI, and ML solutions when required


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


Strong experience with Azure Databricks and Spark (PySpark/Scala)


Hands\-on experience with Azure services (ADF, ADLS, Synapse, Event Hub)


Expertise in big data architecture and distributed systems


Strong knowledge of SQL, Python, and data engineering concepts


Experience with data modeling techniques (star schema, dimensional modeling)


Understanding of real\-time streaming (Kafka/Event Hub)


Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices

  

Strong Development Area:


Data Engineering Foundations
  

Batch vs streaming; lakehouse concepts; medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold); file formats (Parquet/Delta/CSV/JSON/Avro); partitioning \& clustering; schema evolution; data governance basics; DevOps/CI\-CD for data.


SQL
  

Joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, set operations; aggregation \& rollups; MERGE/UPSERT; analytic functions; performance (indexes, partition pruning, statistics); data validation scenarios (dedupe, top\-N, SCD keys).


Apache Spark (Core)
  

Spark architecture (driver/executors), DAG, stages/tasks; RDD vs DataFrame/Dataset; wide vs narrow transformations; shuffle mechanics; caching/persistence; partitioning; broadcast joins; skew handling; checkpointing; job tuning.


PySpark
  

DataFrame API, Spark SQL; UDF vs pandas UDF; windowing; incremental loads; structured streaming (triggers, watermarks); handling semi\-structured data; optimizing with predicates, pushdown, join strategies; error handling; unit testing (pytest \+ chispa).


Databricks Platform
  

Workspace basics; clusters (Single Node/All\-Purpose/Jobs), cluster policies; DBR/LTS; notebooks \& Repos; Jobs \& Workflows; Delta Lake \& Delta Live Tables; Unity Catalog (catalog/schema/table, permissions, lineage); MLflow basics; secret scopes; DBFS; REST APIs; Databricks Connect.


Delta Lake / Lakehouse Patterns
  

ACID transactions; schema enforcement/evolution; time travel; OPTIMIZE/ZORDER; VACUUM; CDC patterns (MERGE INTO, change data feed); streaming vs batch Delta; expectations/constraints; table maintenance strategies.


Orchestration \& Scheduling
  

Databricks Workflows; Azure Data Factory/Synapse pipelines; triggers; parameter passing; fail/retry; alerts; integration with AutoSys/Control\-M/Jenkins/GitHub Actions; event\-driven patterns.


Python (Core for Data)
  

Core syntax; typing \& data structures; file I/O; logging; virtual environments; packaging; testing (pytest); common data libs (pandas, pyarrow); error handling; performance considerations (vectorization, generators).


Data Quality \& Testing
  

Great Expectations/dbx expectations or custom checks; unit/integration tests; reconciliation (row/amount); anomaly detection; contract testing for schemas; data observability (metrics, SLAs, freshness).


Security \& Governance
  

Unity Catalog permissions, row/column\-level security; secrets management (Key Vault/Secret scopes); PII handling; audit logs; token management; compliance basics.


Cost \& Performance Optimization
  

Cluster sizing, autoscaling; DBU awareness; spot/preemptible instances; storage formats; caching; efficient joins; job scheduling; monitoring with metrics \& Ganglia/Spark UI; cost tagging and chargeback.


Analytical Skills \& Problem Solving
  

Break down data problems; root\-cause incidents; propose alternatives; estimate complexity; communicate clearly with stakeholders.


Stake Holder Management
  

Interaction with Client Stakeholders, Communication.

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (Recommended)
  

2\. Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (Optional But Valuable

1dcd7556.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
1dcd7556.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

 communication, strategic thinking, and adaptability to steer the relevant optimal solution implementations as well as safeguard the sanctity of the design.
   

  

 This role involves continuous learning and evolution to keep up with the ever\-changing technology landscape and business needs.
   

  

 Your responsibilities are:

Leverages deep expertise in the respective Functional/Technology area to develop, steer optimal solutions that are holistic and scalable, that simplify the technology landscape and enable agility in enabling/unlocking business value and potentially pivot the business case positively.

 Works with Functional teams to analyze requirements, cross functional, cross solution and cross domain impact. Ensures conceptual designs/blueprints are holistic and effectively documented.

 Provide technical leadership and guidance throughout the project lifecycle. Collaborates with development and project/program teams to design and implement enhancements, and interfaces, ensuring compliance with best practices and standards.

You will continuously evaluate and incorporate new methodologies, tools, and frameworks to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the technology/platform. 171b1a56.title: Client Delivery Manager
171b1a56.description:
**Objective:** 




  





 As a Client Delivery Manager, you support the company's objectives by ensuring corporate interests are safeguarded before the customer contract is signed (feasibility and implementation options) as well as organizing the implementation after the contractual agreement with the customer has been concluded. The implementation specifically relates to the contractually owed services, typically for qualified customer solutions that cannot be fulfilled through a standardized delivery process but require project coordination over various delivery units for planning (pre\-sales phase) and during the actual delivery. Client Delivery Management is responsible for the planning, execution, acceptance, and follow\-up of qualified, non\-standardized delivery projects.
 



  





**Main Tasks:** 




  




* Coordination of contractual requirements and the services and deliveries to be provided with customer management and the departments
* Planning and implementation of customer projects involving all necessary stakeholders and coordination of interfaces
* Monitoring deadlines, milestones, dependencies, and risks\- General project reporting and timely escalation to management
* Tracking of risks and development of measures for risk mitigation
* Planning and conducting cross\-disciplinary coordination, quality gates workshops, and supporting project participants to achieve project goals\- Assistance in project planning (definition and coordination of project goals, resource/time/effort budgeting, planning of work packages)
* Definition of project workflow and project process organizations, planning and conducting the project kickoff with the involved departments
* Operational support in (sub\-)projects by performing PM tasks (e.g. moderation of workshops)
* Continuous development of project methodology within the team and optimization of processes and tools for comprehensive project management.



  





**Professional Skills required:** 




  




* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in business administration, engineering, computer science, or comparable professional experience
* Demonstrated experience in successful delivery of managed services to clients, meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards, with contractual agreements and compliance requirements as well as monitoring contract performance
* Knowledge of power supply and cooling of data centers, Cx ing, Fit\-Out, Security, Connectivity infrastructure, as well as product knowledge (racks, networking, data center and IT\-related services, etc.)
* Experience and certification in common project management methods such as Prince2, Scrum are desirable

* Strong analytical skills

5679c55d.title: ServiceNow Solution Architect (FSM, ITSM & CMDB)
5679c55d.description:
**Role Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect with deep expertise in Field Service Management (FSM), IT Service Management (ITSM), CMDB, and enterprise integrations. In this role, you will be responsible for designing scalable and future\-ready ServiceNow solutions, leading customer workshops, translating business requirements into technical architecture, and driving platform modernization initiatives. You will work closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and customers to ensure successful implementation of enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
 



  





**What will your role look like?** 



* Design and architect scalable ServiceNow solutions across FSM, ITSM, and CMDB modules.
* Lead discovery sessions and customer workshops to gather business requirements and translate them into technical solution designs.
* Develop solution blueprints, architecture documents, and implementation roadmaps.
* Create intuitive user experiences using ServiceNow UI Builder and Service Portal, including wireframes and mockups.
* Design and oversee integrations with enterprise applications using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration platforms.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring adherence to ServiceNow best practices and architectural standards.
* Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, instance health assessments, performance optimization, and modernization initiatives.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Mentor development teams and provide guidance on solution design, governance, and implementation best practices.



  





**Why will you love this role?** 



* Work on enterprise\-scale digital transformation initiatives using the ServiceNow platform.
* Design innovative and scalable solutions for global customers across multiple industries.
* Collaborate with experienced architects, consultants, and technology leaders.
* Gain exposure to complex integrations, platform modernization, and next\-generation ServiceNow capabilities.
* Enjoy continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and career growth in a collaborative environment.
* Make a significant impact by delivering business\-critical solutions that drive operational excellence.



  





**We would like you to bring along** 



* 10\+ years of overall IT experience with strong expertise in ServiceNow solution architecture.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow FSM, ITSM, and CMDB implementations.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, and best practices.
* Experience with UI Builder, Service Portal, and user experience design.
* Expertise in designing and implementing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and IntegrationHub.
* Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and architectural discussions.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow upgrades, instance management, governance, and platform optimization.
* Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Good\-to\-have skills** 



* Experience with Dell Boomi or other enterprise integration platforms.
* Exposure to ServiceNow Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Automation Engine.
* Knowledge of CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA (Certified System Administrator), CAD (Certified Application Developer), and CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist).

bcc0133a.title: Technical Program Manager
bcc0133a.description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role Summary:
   

  

 The Risk and Security team (RAS) is a key component of the Value\-Added Services (VAS) PD division within Visa. VAS\-RAS has a suite of high visibility, high\-volume, revenue earning applications that provide solutions related to Risk Management, Identity and Authentication. Our capabilities are used extensively by key players in the payment eco\-space across the globe.
   

  

 Our Technical Program Managers are highly visible leaders, building bridges across Visa to ensure projects are effectively developed, integrated and deployed with quality and on time delivery into our production systems.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager for our RAS team, you will drive quality and velocity of our technology. You should be comfortable with owning issues and managing the outcome. You enjoy driving, resolving, facilitating and follow up. You understand the risks and the trade\-offs and are both technical and process focused.
   

  

 A strong candidate will have a solid experience with technology/product program management, agentic development, release management, x\-functional team leadership, as well as superb skills in communications, business analysis, problem\-solving, cross\-team coordination, communications, processes, and change management. The ideal candidate is not just a facilitator or project plan tracker but is self motivated and ensures things get done. The ideal candidate must have a drive to get things done and a “make it happen” attitude.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Key resource to lead/support end\-to\-end planning and execution of one or more projects and/or Agile/Kanban teams that are part of a larger program. Contribute to and facilitate negotiations on scope, schedule, budget, risks, releases and communications.
* Coach multiple teams through the software development life cycle using Agentic Development, Kanban, Agile, Scrum, and Lean practices and work cross\-functionally throughout the company to ensure projects are developed and deployed with quality and timely delivery into our production systems.
* Ask thoughtful questions to help our customers, product owners, and product managers to maximize ROI and meet company objectives. Understand product strategy and benefits of key deliverables in area of responsibility.
* Work with product owners to promote and contribute to the improvement of the product backlog
* Drive planning, dependency and risk management, architecture completion, backlog grooming, reviews/demos, retrospectives, and other key ceremonies related to both Kanban and Scrum in an agentic environment
* Facilitate discussion and conflict resolution
* Coach team in estimation techniques
* Shield the team from outside distractions and interferences
* Track and remove impediments for the team
* Develop metrics and reports using JA/Jira/GIT/Claude to help the team understand its health and progress and to set goals
* Lead team in its Agentic Development adoption
* Lead Agentic Development release planning
* Ensure clear communication and collaboration among the Product Owner and members of the Development team
* Ensure the program and projects are in compliance with Visa's Project Management Methodology and Key Controls and that accurate and timely information is reported regularly on program progress and financial status.
* Provide timely and accurate reporting to all stakeholders; hold regular cross organizational management briefings.
* Lead boldly and utilize hard and soft skills to influence participants of all levels towards the common goal.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks and issues.
* Identify and manage dependencies and impacts
* Drive improvement in overall efficiency and reliability of our release and deployment processes.
* Facilitate solutions for identified security vulnerabilities and track to timely remediation
* Exercise independent judgment with minimal direction from supervisor.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or other technical discipline, or equivalent work experience required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (BS) in Computer Science or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree is a plus.
* 7\+ years of experience, as an Analyst, Technical Project/Program Manager or Developer, working with technical teams developing Enterprise class software applications.
* Ability to work with global teams and ability to lead and influence across all time zones
* Hands on experience with Claude/GIT/Jira/JA
* Excellent analytical skills and enthusiastic problem solver
* Strong leadership qualities and organizational skills as well as the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, assignments, and roles.
* Strong knowledge of Project Management, ADLC, SDLC principles and practices and agile frameworks.

 Role:
 



 The Life Sciences Presales Consultant will support Birlasoft’s Life Sciences \& Healthcare growth agenda by shaping industry\-led solutions, driving high\-quality RFP responses, enabling CXO conversations and converting account opportunities into qualified pursuits. The role requires a blend of life sciences domain understanding, technology services solutioning, consultative selling, proposal development and executive storytelling.
 



 The consultant will work across Pharma, MedTech, Diagnostics, Digital Health, Healthcare Providers and Public Health segments, helping position Birlasoft as a trusted transformation partner across R\&D, regulatory, pharmacovigilance, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial operations, PLM, patient experience, data/AI and digital transformation.

 6\-8 Years

**B. Industry Solutioning** 



* Develop industry\-specific solution points of view across Pharma, MedTech, Diagnostics, Digital Health and Healthcare segments.

**C. Sales Enablement \& Account Support** 



* Support account teams with account research, white\-space identification, buying\-center mapping and pursuit qualification.

* 6–8 years of experience across presales, consulting, domain advisory, business analysis, solutioning or delivery in IT services / consulting / Life Sciences technology environments.

13c4b9e9.title: Senior Solutions Specialist - Presales
13c4b9e9.description:
**Role Purpose\-**
 To support business development efforts by guiding and overseeing the demonstration and delivery of Nucleus’ platforms \& solutions as a part of client sales pitches and provide support in client management at the demo stage.
   

  

**Areas of Responsibility\-**
**Product Demonstration\-**
* Participate in sales strategy meetings and offer inputs based on market/competitor information and internal analysis.
* Ensure that support is provided to sales teams during pitches through product demonstrations and presentations that best highlight the product’s features, utility and competitive advantage to potential clients.
* Engage, question, and participate in deep\-dive discussions/ value workshops with customers and/or Sales team for thorough understanding of customers' existing scenarios, business drivers, pain\-points, gaps, competition, core objectives; seek clarity on and understand customers' evaluation processes \& key evaluation criteria.
* Lead and conduct clients demos or workshops for large account pitches and offer inputs based on client requirements and product features.
* Act as a product evangelist and highlight benefits of product features to clients as well as internal teams.
* Conduct GA Sanity Testing after GA release deployed in Pre\-Sales servers.


**RFPs\-**
* Thoroughly review the RFP document to understand the client's requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission guidelines.
* Identify key stakeholders and subject matter experts needed for the response.
* Collaborate with technical experts to design a solution that meets the client's needs.
* Ensure the proposed solution aligns with the company's capabilities and strategic goals.
* Draft responses for each section of the RFP, including functional aspects and Executive Summary.
* Use existing content libraries and past proposals to streamline the writing process.
* Ensure that all responses comply with the RFP requirements and guidelines.
* Verify that all mandatory information and documents are included.
* Conduct internal reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
* Edit the content to improve readability and impact.
* Identify potential risks associated with the proposed solution and develop mitigation strategies.
* Document any assumptions and dependencies.
* Perform a final review of the entire RFP response to ensure completeness and quality.
* Prepare for potential presentations, demos or discussions with the client post\-submission.


**Relationship Building\-**
* Liaise with client stakeholders and ensure all requirements are gathered in order to structure the product demos and other supporting collaterals
* Engage with prospective clients and industry leaders to understand business challenges and incorporate changes in internal procedures


**Process Improvement\-**
* Stay up to date with industry leading best practices and latest trends and offer insights to sales teams as well as product development teams.
* Implement new processes and tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of product demonstrations.


**People Management\-**
* Review MIS reports created by Pre\-sales Executives; analyze and provide insights to senior stakeholders as required.
* Manage, mentor and inspire a team and team members including managing performance, goals and development potential, and evaluate potential new talent.
* Provide support to resolve conflict between multiple work streams / groups; provide inputs on goal setting and performance appraisals of team members; identify training needs for associates based on the client requirements.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices across the team; provide support to team members to achieve their knowledge goals and build expertise.


**Requirements**
* Detailed Knowledge of Products and Solutions.
* Good understanding of the target domain/industry.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a customer\-centric approach.
* Proven networking and relationship\-building skills to establish and maintain strong connections with customers, partners, and internal teams


**Benefits**
 Nucleus is well known for identifying, nurturing, and promoting the talent and having long mutually rewarding associations with its performing associates. Our focus programs help our associates to continuously grow based on their capability, performance, and career aspirations.

46de3bb6.description:
**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is a cloud\-based HR Technology platform which caters to an organization’s HR needs across the employee lifecycle including Recruitment, Onboarding, Core transactions (Leaves, Attendance, Directory), Payroll, Travel and Expenses, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, Rewards \& Recognition and People Analytics. The modern and innovative platform combines highly configurable workflows, intelligent insights and smart interfaces to help enterprises unleash the true potential of their workforce. Darwinbox is trusted by 650\+ global enterprises with more than 1\.5 million employees spread across 90\+ countries including Asia’s largest conglomerates and fast\-growing unicorns like Adani, Mahindra, Kotak, TVS, Arvind, JSW, NSE, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Bharti AXA, Nivea, T\-Systems, Swiggy, BigBasket, Delhivery and more. It is backed by leading investors like TCV, Salesforce Ventures, Sequoia, Lightspeed, Endiya Partners, 3One4Capital, SCB 10X and JGDEV.
   

  

 More at www.darwinbox.com
   

  

**About the team:** 
 As a member of our diverse and skilled global solutioning team you will have the opportunity to don multiple hats and be challenged daily. This team is focused on enabling end\-to\-end HR digital transformation for our customers and is dedicated to working with customers to align their digital vision with their business strategy and supporting the plan to get there. On a typical day, you will be working as part of an agile team responsible for conducting discovery calls and product solutioning to help prospective clients transform and streamline their business to their fullest potential, using market data and strategic judgment to stay in front of our competitors. The HCM Solution Manager are responsible for partnering with the sales teams and deliver the Darwinbox value proposition to business users including the offices of the CHRO, CIO, and CFO. They play a critical role in the success of every sales pursuit we make. By leveraging deep HR functional expertise and comprehensive product knowledge the Solutions Consultant provides expert solutions through presentations, workshops, and product demonstrations to the customer throughout the sales cycle.
   

  

**What’s Expected of You:**
* Participate in discovery workshops with users to formulate and document business requirements, including business processes, procedures, and work practices.
* Assist in the development of winning and differentiating value propositions and themes/messaging to customers, in collaboration with the sales team.
* Develop and champion Darwinbox value\-based solutions to client problems, communicate them with the customer, implementation partners and internal stakeholders. This may involve various formats/viewpoints, such as process flows, context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions and recordings and functional demonstrations.
* Lead RFP (Request for Proposal) responses and develop solution overviews that map customer’s business initiatives to the Darwinbox HCM solution.
* Prepare for and conduct winning demonstrations of the Darwinbox HCM solution to create impact in customer evaluation processes, while demonstrating the value proposition and customer expectations.
* Build expertise in specific industries and presenting the value of Darwinbox HCM solution to customers in those industries.
* Build trusted\-advisor relationship with key customer stakeholders who are influencers and decision\-makers in an evaluation process.
* Research and highlight the advantages of Darwinbox HCM and capability over legacy ERP and other SaaS systems.
* Continuously upgrade your skillsets and knowledge through the learning opportunities provided by Darwinbox.


**Who Should Apply?**
* 8yrs of experience in HCM Consulting / HRBP role.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or relevant work experience
* Value\-based selling in an HCM Consulting environment
* Proven ability to work and effectively communicate with C\-level executives and line of business representatives.
* Proven ability to understand client pain points and proposing solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

This team is focused on enabling end\-to\-end HR digital transformation for our customers and is dedicated to working with customers to align their digital vision with their business strategy and supporting the plan to get there. On a typical day, you will be working as part of an agile team responsible for conducting discovery calls and product solutioning to help prospective clients transform and streamline their business to their fullest potential, using market data and strategic judgment to stay in front of our competitors. The HCM Solution Manager are responsible for partnering with the sales teams and deliver the Darwinbox value proposition to business users including the offices of the CHRO, CIO, and CFO. They play a critical role in the success of every sales pursuit we make. By leveraging deep HR functional expertise and comprehensive product knowledge the Solutions Consultant provides expert solutions through presentations, workshops, and product demonstrations to the customer throughout the sales cycle.
   

  

**What’s Expected of You:**
* Participate in discovery workshops with users to formulate and document business requirements, including business processes, procedures, and work practices.
* Assist in the development of winning and differentiating value propositions and themes/messaging to customers, in collaboration with the sales team.
* Develop and champion Darwinbox value\-based solutions to client problems, communicate them with the customer, implementation partners and internal stakeholders. This may involve various formats/viewpoints, such as process flows, context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions and recordings and functional demonstrations.
* Lead RFP (Request for Proposal) responses and develop solution overviews that map customer’s business initiatives to the Darwinbox HCM solution.
* Prepare for and conduct winning demonstrations of the Darwinbox HCM solution to create impact in customer evaluation processes, while demonstrating the value proposition and customer expectations.
* Build expertise in specific industries and presenting the value of Darwinbox HCM solution to customers in those industries.
* Build trusted\-advisor relationship with key customer stakeholders who are influencers and decision\-makers in an evaluation process.
* Research and highlight the advantages of Darwinbox HCM and capability over legacy ERP and other SaaS systems.
* Continuously upgrade your skillsets and knowledge through the learning opportunities provided by Darwinbox.


**Who Should Apply?**
* 8yrs of experience in HCM Consulting / HRBP role.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or relevant work experience
* Value\-based selling in an HCM Consulting environment
* Proven ability to work and effectively communicate with C\-level executives and line of business representatives.
* Proven ability to understand client pain points and proposing solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

a40f51c8.title: Solution Consultant
a40f51c8.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 Solution Consultant
   

  

 Mumbai
   

  

 You will support sales at main customer pursuits by providing specific solution expertise in a defined geographical area. The Solution Consultant is the solution expert for the sales organisation by assisting with delivering outcome\-based messaging to customers at executive and management levels. The Solution Consultant has a broad understanding of all related products and delivery offerings from RA, partners and competitors in the designated solution area.
   

  

 You will report to the Consultant Leader and work onsite in Mumbai, India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**

* Translate competitive solutions into a RA solution that meets customer's expectations.
* Seek out and participate in training opportunities to develop technical skills.
* Provide product gap and development feedback for the solution to appropriate organisations.
* Share insights with peers.
* Focus on opportunities that support Rockwell Automation's strategy.
* Understand business models, organisation, and go\-to\-market strategy.
* Knowledge of industry strategies, familiarity with outcome\-based selling.
* Share industry knowledge of customers based on their important causes at the appropriate role level with all customers

**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering/technical related field or equivalent experience.
* Value of larger Rockwell Automation application value, without the need to demonstrate individual products with hands\-on demonstrations

* Fluency in native language and command of English (written and spoken).
* Work with and gain confidence of senior level personnel (internal and external) in a collaborative, matrixed organisation.

* Set, be accountable for and achieve challenging targets.
* empower, coach and motivate others.

**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
* Proficiency in hands\-on engineering

* Practical knowledge of process unit operations and typical automation requirements of such process units

**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
