37c740b5.title: AI/ML Solution Architect
37c740b5.description:
Education \& Assessment Platforms
   

  

**About Pratham International**
 Pratham International is a US 501(c)(3\) established to support learning innovations for children and youth in contexts across the globe. We enable the adaptation and spread of proven and scalable education solutions pioneered in India by Pratham Education Foundation to contexts across the global south through programming and technical assistance tailored to local realities. Today, Pratham innovations reach millions of children annually through partnerships across \~30 countries.
   

  

 Through the Pratham Shah PraDigi Innovation Centre (PraDigi), Pratham International also seeks to create technology innovations for low\-resource communities, and support models aimed at learning for school, work, and life for children and youth. We work on several cutting\-edge projects in the domain of Generative AI, Automatic Speech Recognition, and Natural Language Processing.
   

  

 The team's innovative technology products include the PadhAI: Reading Assessment App, which uses advanced speech recognition to evaluate children's reading fluency in 8 Indian languages and 6 global languages; Anytime Testing Machine (ATM), an AI\-enabled question generation and grading system that allows learners to be assessed on any topic, anytime; and a suite of AI\-powered chatbots designed for diverse learning contexts: from early childhood care, to youth employment readiness, and OCR\-based analysis tools that digitize and assess student work at scale.
   

  

 At Pratham International, we build for the long term. Whether it's ensuring products are truly accessible across rural India and the global south through languages, building datasets to ensure context and accuracy for products, or gathering feedback from the field. Backed by partners like Google.org, Anthropic, and the Gates Foundation, we are committed to building digital public goods that ensure every child is in school and learning well.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**About the work**
 We design and deliver AI systems that governments and large education programmes can actually run: curriculum\-aligned item generation, paper assembly, handwriting OCR, rubric grading, and teacher\-in\-the\-loop review. The work is already live as practice assessment in India and is being built as a national exam platform in Rwanda, with further country programmes behind it.
   

  

 We are hiring a Solution Architect who sits between discovery and delivery. You will turn messy workshop notes and ministry requirements into architecture a team can build, secure, cost, and operate — RAG and multi\-agent systems, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, and the cloud/LLMOps layer underneath.
   

  

**You will**
* Own solution design from first workshop to a delivery\-ready blueprint (services, data stores, trust boundaries, cost, ops).
* Architect LLM pipelines: generation, retrieval over curriculum knowledge graphs, standards/duplication/quality judges, constraint\-based paper assembly.
* Design human \+ AI workflows with audit, segregation of duties, cycle\-pinned config, and no student PII in model calls.
* Choose and govern models, prompts, eval gates, and fallbacks (including OCR: Azure primary, secondary fallback).
* Shape the Azure/AWS platform: identity, networking, LLMOps/MLOps, observability, and sovereign\-hosting constraints.
* Run client workshops, write POVs and architecture packs, and stay accountable until the system is in production.


**About the work**
 Pratham International programmes sit at the intersection of pedagogy, public systems, and production AI. The pattern is consistent across countries; the constraints change.
   

  

* **Anytime Testing Machine (ATM) — India, practice and feedback** 
 End\-to\-end assessment for real classroom conditions: generate curriculum\-aligned items, digitise handwritten answers (often photographed on a phone), grade against rubrics, and return feedback a teacher reviews before it reaches the learner. Built for high pupil–teacher ratios, mixed language (e.g. Hindi \+ English), and uneven connectivity. Pilots have already reached thousands of learners, including Second Chance (women returning for Grade 10\). Model quality is measured against expert golden sets, not vendor slides.
* **National assessment automation** 
 A government\-grade exam platform. Phase 1 is item authoring and print\-ready paper composition before the exam window. Phase 2 is script intake, OCR at national volume, AI\-assisted grading with human confirmation on the pilot, results export, and monitoring/evaluation reporting. Subjects span core and elective streams across the curriculum. Design rules that do not exist in a typical SaaS product: cycle\-pinned configuration, embargoed papers, hash\-chained audit trails, and integration with national student information and assessment management systems.
* **Curriculum knowledge graphs** 
 Structured retrieval corpora (concepts \+ worked examples) that ground generation and judging. This is the standing public\-knowledge exception in an otherwise closed exam system, and the seed of a broader education DPI conversation.
* **AI in TaRL and teacher support** 
 AI tools that help teachers group and teach by learning level, with an RCT\-shaped evidence bar. Same product family: human agency stays in the loop; the model is a capacity multiplier.
* **Country programmes and the three\-year direction** 
 Adapt the same engine to new ministries, languages, and exam rules (Kenya and other Global South programmes are in scope). The longer bet is a learning and credentialing engine that recognises competence beyond a single syllabus.


 This is not a chatbot brief. It is constrained generation, retrieval, judging, document AI, workflow, and public\-sector operations.
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 Most enterprise AI dies between the workshop and production. We need one person who owns that gap: someone who can sit with NESA, C4IR, Pratham pedagogy, and engineering in the same week, and leave behind a blueprint the delivery team can execute without inventing policy.
   

  

 The target profile is a practising AI/ML Solution Architect — not a pre\-sales slide owner, and not an infra\-only platform engineer. The person should have done all three of these:
   

  

* Designed GenAI / NLP solutions, PoCs, and client workshops, and can talk to research\-grade issues (eval, agent safety, prompt\-injection, model\-specific behaviour).
* Owned the AI platform: LLMOps, MLOps, DevSecOps, SRE habits, cloud migration, and FinOps.
* Taken messy discovery and turned it into Azure\-centred RAG and multi\-agent designs that a security team will accept.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Discovery → architecture**
* Lead solution workshops with programme, ministry, and engineering stakeholders.
* Convert half\-formed requirements into service cuts, data stores, sequence diagrams, decision gates, and open\-question lists with owners.
* Write architecture decision records. When the docs disagree (they will), force a decision instead of coding both.


**AI system design**
* Design LLM jobs as contracts: inputs, JSON schema, temperature, persist prompt hash / model / tokens / latency.
* Architect generation grounded in structured curriculum blueprints and knowledge\-graph retrieval, not "ask the model for a maths paper."
* Design LLM\-as\-judge banks (cognitive\-level, relevance, difficulty, language, fairness, standards, duplication, blueprint compliance) with thresholds, one\-repair rules, and golden\-dataset release gates.
* Design hybrid assembly: constraint solver first, model only on ties and layout exceptions.
* Design document AI: primary OCR provider, secondary fallback provider, confidence routing, de\-identification before any grading call.
* Specify eval: inter\-rater agreement, rubric\-band exact match, first\-pass item acceptance, cost per paper cycle.


**Platform, trust, cost**
* Own the reference architecture on the chosen cloud platform(s): identity, RBAC \+ segregation of duties, private networking, key management, object storage for scans, vector index, data warehouse for monitoring/evaluation reporting.
* Draw trust boundaries. Student PII never crosses the model gateway. Prompts are curriculum \+ knowledge\-graph \+ blueprint content only.
* Put FinOps on the design: token budgets, OCR cost caps, degradation behaviour when a cap is hit, model routing.
* Specify LLMOps/MLOps: prompt/version registry, eval regression as a release gate, observability, rollback.
* Design for sovereign hosting and exam\-cycle operations (embargo, watermarking, append\-only audit, cycle\-pinned configuration).
* Delivery and thought leadership
* Stay with the build through the first production cycle. Architecture that cannot be implemented is unfinished work.
* Produce POVs, sequence packs, and workshop artefacts that can be reused in the next country.
* Mentor tech leads on where the model should stop and the workflow should start.


**Success in the first two quarters**
**First 30 days — Orient**
* Complete architecture walkthroughs of every live/in\-flight system with the current engineering leads; document current state (services, data stores, trust boundaries) as\-is, not as\-designed
* Meet every active stakeholder group once: engineering, programme/domain leads, and any external partner or government\-side counterpart
* Inventory all open technical decisions and disagreements in existing specs; log each with current owner (if any) and status
* Identify the single highest\-risk unresolved design question and flag it upward


**Day 60 — Diagnose**
* Produce a current\-state architecture diagram covering every major pipeline: data flow, model/LLM touchpoints, storage, and identity/access boundaries
* Assign an owner and target resolution date to every open contradiction identified in month 1
* Draft a v1 reference architecture for one representative end\-to\-end workflow: service breakdown, data stores, identity/access model, model gateway placement, and a first\-pass cost estimate


**Day 90 — Commit**
* v1 reference architecture is reviewed and accepted by engineering and relevant stakeholders (not just self\-signed)
* Can walk any core pipeline end\-to\-end from memory and name every data store, every quality/eval gate, and every trust boundary in it
* At least one architecture decision record is published for a previously\-contested design question, with the decision forced rather than left open
* A first cost model exists for the reference architecture, with at least one identified lever for reducing spend if usage scales


**Day 120 — Harden**
* Core pipeline components (generation, retrieval, judging/eval, or equivalent stages for this domain) have documented contracts: defined inputs/outputs, schema, and logged metadata (model, version, cost, latency)
* An evaluation harness exists for at least one component, with a defined pass/fail threshold
* A release gate exists that can block a bad prompt, model, or config change from reaching production


**Day 150 — Extend**
* The next major system phase or capability is specified to the same rigor as the first: trust boundaries, failure modes, fallback behavior, and cost caps documented before build starts
* FinOps guardrails are in place for at least one production workload: budget ceilings, degradation behavior when a cap is hit, and a routing or fallback strategy Day 180 — Generalize
* A reusable design pattern or adaptation pack exists, separating what is fixed in the architecture from what varies by deployment context (e.g. language, hosting environment, external\-system integration, content/domain rules)
* At least one engineering or technical lead has been mentored on where model\-based logic should stop and deterministic/workflow logic should take over
* A second production\-readiness review (security, cost, or operations) has been passed on a system this person designed or substantially redesigned


**Qualifications and Experience**
**Must have**
* 8\+ years building software or data/AI systems, with recent experience as a Solution Architect, AI/ML Architect, or Principal/Staff Engineer with end\-to\-end architecture ownership.
* Shipped at least one production AI/ML system — RAG, multi\-agent, LLM\-as\-judge, or a comparable classical ML/NLP pipeline at scale — that passed a real security, cost, and operations review, not just a pilot or a slide deck.
* Can produce a delivery\-ready architecture blueprint: services, data stores, IAM, failure modes, evaluation strategy, and cost model — detailed enough that engineering isn't guessing at intent.
* Deep cloud experience on Azure and/or AWS: comfortable defending a landing\-zone design, private\-endpoint architecture, and a real monthly compute/inference/OCR spend.
* Fluent in Python, with hands\-on experience in both classical ML (model training, evaluation, feature pipelines) and how LLM APIs, embeddings, and vector search actually behave under production load.
* Comfortable running a room with non\-engineers — domain specialists, IT stakeholders, monitoring/evaluation teams — and translating fluently in both directions.
* Strong written English; this role's output is documentation that functions as a binding technical contract.


**Strongly preferred**
* Azure AI (AI Foundry / OpenAI / Document Intelligence), plus one of AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker) or GCP (Vertex, BigQuery).
* LLMOps / MLOps: prompt \+ model versioning, MLflow or equivalent, eval harnesses, CI that can block a bad prompt.
* Document AI / OCR at volume; handwriting and low\-quality scans, not only clean PDFs.
* RAG over structured knowledge (graphs, ToS, textbooks) and hybrid search, not only naive chunking.
* Education, assessment, public sector, or other high\-audit domains (health, finance, identity).
* Certifications: Azure Data Scientist / Azure Solutions Architect; AWS SAA, ML Specialty, or Data Analytics Specialty.
* Experience with agent security: tool\-use limits, DLP on egress, prompt\-injection evaluation that is model\-specific.
* FinOps discipline. You have killed a design because it would not survive the token bill.


**Nice to have**
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool integration for agentic workflows.
* Constraint solvers or exam\-blueprint / item\-bank systems for automated test assembly.
* Multilingual generation and feedback, including code\-mixed language pairs (e.g. Hindi–English, Spanish–English, or similar).
* Experience standing up golden/eval datasets with subject\-matter experts.
* Prior work with government data systems, data\-sharing agreements, or in\-country/sovereign hosting requirements.


**What this role is not**
* Not a research\-only post. Publications help; shipping is the job.
* Not a pure platform/SRE hire. Infra is part of the design, not the whole design.
* Not a prompt engineer who hands off "the architecture" to someone else.
* Not a people manager of a large team on day one — you influence through artefacts and reviews.


**How we will assess you**
 We value transparency and respect your time. Our hiring process is designed to evaluate both hands\-on technical depth and architectural judgment through practical, real\-world tasks.
   

  

**Stage 1: Application \& Knockout Screening**
* Submit your CV alongside key screening responses
* Artefact — send two of: architecture note, eval design, runbook, ADR. Slides without decisions do not count.


**Stage 2: Initial Conversation (30 mins)**
* An introductory screen covering your background, project context and baseline alignment.
* An opportunity for you to ask questions about our technical roadmap, partner ecosystem, and vision.


**Stage 3: Practical Take\-Home Written Assessment (2–3 hours)**
* Design exercise on a constrained generation \+ judge \+ human\-review pipeline (we will use a sanitised exam\-authoring brief). We want trust boundaries, eval, and cost, not a model\-name dump.


**Stage 4: Deep\-Dive Technical \& System Architecture Walkthrough**
* Walkthrough of a system you shipped: what failed in review, what you changed, what it costs to run.


**Stage 5: Final Stakeholder \& Vision Alignment**
* Final conversation with key technical leadership and program stakeholders.


**Employment Details**
* Function: Solutions / Architecture
* Reports to: Head of Technology / CTO
* Expected Start Date: Immediate
* Location: India (remote\-first; travel to client workshops as needed)
* Experience: 8–13 years (strong 6–8 considered if you have shipped production GenAI)
* Engagement: Full\-time
* Remuneration: Based on candidate's experience and skillset
* Flexibility to work across timezones: Our team spans Latin America to Southeast Asia. Early mornings or late evenings can be a regular part of the rhythm


**Why join us?**
**Impact at Scale:** 
 Your work will directly support the learning journeys of millions of children. With programs active in 31 countries, you will help build Digital Public Goods that bridge the gap for the millions of children across the Global South who still struggle with foundational literacy
   

  

**Innovation at the intersection of Education and Technology:** 
 Lead the charge in redefining learning and learning processes through technology. You will contribute to the design and development of cutting\-edge learning tools and AI\-driven initiatives, ensuring EdTech isn't just a buzzword, but a scalable solution for global equity.
   

  

**A Culture of Growth and Evidence:** 
 At Pratham, we value rigorous testing and continuous learning. You will have the autonomy to experiment with the latest SOTA models, supported by a 5\-year strategic roadmap and funding from partners like the Gates Foundation and Anthropic.
   

  

**High\-Calibre, Mission\-Driven Team:** 
 You will work alongside a global team of experts from institutions like MIT, Harvard, and INSEAD. Our alumni have gone on to lead successful startups and international policy shifts, all while remaining dedicated to the goal of "Every Child in School and Learning Well."
   

  

**Inclusive and Collaborative Environment:** 
 Join a diverse team that spans Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We value innovative thinking and local expertise, ensuring that the technology we build is deeply rooted in the realities of the communities we serve.
   

  

*Pratham International is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all qualified people from diverse backgrounds to apply for positions within our organisation, regardless of race, gender, disability or any other status.*

872cdd40.title: Delivery Head – Oracle Cloud
872cdd40.description:
* **Location:** Gurugram
* **Openings:** 1


  
**Role Overview**


At Kovaion, the Delivery Head is a key pillar of project delivery, customer success, and long\-term account growth. The role is responsible for ensuring successful execution of Oracle Cloud engagements while building strong, trusted relationships with customers and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership.


This is a strategic, customer\-facing leadership role that combines delivery management, stakeholder management, project governance, team leadership, and account growth. The Delivery Head will work closely with customers and internal teams to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope and quality expectations, while continuously identifying opportunities to enhance customer value.


The role involves approximately 80% delivery leadership and 20% business development/account growth.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Delivery \& Project Leadership**


* Provide overall leadership and governance for multiple Oracle Cloud projects and customer accounts.


* Take end\-to\-end ownership of project delivery, ensuring commitments related to scope, timelines, quality, and customer expectations are met.


* Work closely with project teams to plan, execute, and monitor project activities and deliverables.


* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, resource plans, and delivery roadmaps.


* Monitor project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and take timely corrective actions.


* Ensure effective allocation and utilization of project resources across engagements.


* Establish appropriate governance mechanisms, including regular project reviews, status reporting, and escalation management.


* Ensure project documentation, deliverables, action items, and governance artifacts are maintained appropriately.


* Facilitate project, steering committee, and customer meetings and ensure effective follow\-through on agreed actions.


* Proactively identify delivery risks and challenges and drive them to resolution.


* Ensure consistent adherence to organizational delivery processes, quality standards, and project management practices.


**Customer \& Stakeholder Management**


* Act as a trusted advisor and strategic point of contact for customers throughout the engagement lifecycle.


* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and decision\-makers.


* Understand customer business objectives, priorities, challenges, and expectations and align delivery accordingly.


* Ensure customers derive maximum value from Oracle Cloud solutions and services.


* Proactively identify customer concerns, delivery challenges, and potential risks to customer satisfaction.


* Establish regular customer connects to assess engagement health and address concerns before they escalate.


* Manage escalations effectively and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.


* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, achievements, and key decisions clearly to customer stakeholders.


* Build long\-term relationships that strengthen customer confidence and retention.


**Team \& Resource Management**


* Lead and mentor project managers, functional consultants, technical consultants, and delivery teams.


* Ensure the right skills and resources are available at the right time across projects.


* Drive accountability for project deliverables and individual responsibilities.


* Identify resource constraints and proactively plan for current and future requirements.


* Foster collaboration between functional, technical, delivery, and support teams.


* Support capability development and continuous improvement within delivery teams.


**Account Growth \& Business Development**


* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within existing Oracle Cloud accounts.


* Understand evolving customer requirements and identify opportunities for additional services and solutions.


* Partner with sales and solution teams to develop proposals, RFP responses, estimates, and solution approaches.


* Support account planning and contribute to expanding the customer relationship.


* Identify opportunities to transition project relationships into long\-term strategic partnerships.


* Maintain a strong understanding of the customer’s technology landscape and future roadmap to identify relevant service opportunities.


**Delivery Governance \& Continuous Improvement**


* Track key delivery and customer\-health indicators and provide management reporting.


* Conduct periodic project and account reviews to identify improvement areas.


* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, project governance, resource utilization, and customer experience.


* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery performance, customer satisfaction, project profitability, and account growth.


* Proactively address potential delivery and customer\-retention risks.


* Promote best practices across projects and customer engagements.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**


* 8–12 years of experience working in the Oracle Cloud ecosystem.


* Proven experience managing multiple Oracle Cloud projects and/or customer accounts.


* Strong experience in project/program delivery and customer stakeholder management.


* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders.


* Strong understanding of project management methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.


* Experience in resource planning, project governance, risk management, and delivery management.


* Experience working directly with senior customer stakeholders.


* Strong understanding of Oracle Cloud implementation, enhancement, support, and/or managed services engagements.


* Experience in handling customer escalations and driving issues to closure.


* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand customer objectives and translate them into delivery priorities.


* Experience supporting RFPs, proposals, solution discussions, and account expansion will be an advantage.


**Key Competencies**


* Exceptional communication and stakeholder\-management skills.


* Strong relationship\-building and influencing capabilities.


* Customer\-centric approach with a strong sense of ownership.


* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.


* Strong leadership and decision\-making capabilities.


* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.


* Proactive and structured approach to risk and issue management.


* Strong commercial and business understanding.


* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced and changing environment.


* Strong track record of delivering projects against agreed objectives.


* Ability to adapt to changing customer priorities, business requirements, and delivery timelines.


* High level of accountability, ownership, and execution focus.

11599442.title: Principal Consultant - Client Services (Oracle Cloud Financials)
11599442.description:
**Job Description**
**Oracle Cloud Financial Modules:**
* Accounting Hub
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Cash Management
* Expense Management
* Fixed Assets
* General Ledger
* Oracle Fusion Tax


 Related capabilities may include Intercompany Accounting, Subledger Accounting, Financial Reporting, Enterprise Structures, security, approval workflows, integrations, and period\-close processes.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 Argano is seeking a Principal Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Consultant to join our Managed Services practice. This client\-facing role provides ongoing functional support and advisory services across the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials suite. The consultant will own incidents, service requests, minor enhancements, quarterly update readiness, functional configuration, testing, and process optimization while working within agreed service levels and client priorities. The ideal candidate combines deep Oracle Fusion Financials expertise with strong knowledge of finance business processes and a proactive commitment to client success, system stability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 The Argano Managed Services division is unlike other managed services groups. We specialize in helping our clients transform their processes and enhance the end\-user experience. Creativity, teamwork, and loyalty are core principles that guide our daily actions. We have a unique corporate culture unlike any other firm in our business\-\-one that promotes healthy balance, respect, focus, friendship, and ongoing education. There are few firms in this industry that have a near zero employee turnover rate. We do. And it is something from which our clients benefit, and our employees celebrate. If you want to be part of an elite team where excellence is a way of life, join Argano.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Using in\-depth knowledge of the Oracle Cloud Financial Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consult with clients to provide cost\-effective solutions to solve business issues.
* Provide high\-quality client support by triaging and owning incidents and service requests through resolution, gathering complete business and system information, communicating status and risks, and meeting agreed service\-level targets.
* Troubleshoot client issues through functional analysis, configuration review, data validation, log and process review, replication, root\-cause analysis, and regression testing. When vendor assistance is required, open and manage Oracle Service Requests, provide actionable evidence, and drive issues to resolution.
* Manage Oracle service requests through resolution, including diagnostics, follow\-ups, validation, and status updates.
* Lead Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update readiness activities, including reviewing new and deprecated features, assessing client impact, recommending opt\-in functionality, coordinating configuration changes, preparing test scenarios, supporting regression and user acceptance testing, documenting outcomes, and delivering end\-user enablement.
* Proactively contribute to the overall support process by suggesting \& executing new process efficiencies, documenting common support issues and workarounds, to minimize the number of future support requests.
* Refine client requirements in detail, document and present to the client for approval.
* Identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving system issues.
* Participate in team training activities to keep current with Oracle Cloud functionality.


**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD (technical accounting, management system, Business Admin, etc.) expected.


**Required Skills**
* Minimum 8–10 years of Oracle Financials functional consulting experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation or production support experience. Experience supporting multiple clients or complex environments in a managed services model is strongly preferred.
* Preferred to be a CPA/CA equivalent with an in\-depth understanding of finance business processes.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze Oracle Fusion Financials configurations, accounting rules, workflows, security roles, scheduled processes, reports, data loads, and integration touchpoints sufficiently to diagnose issues and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to independently research, reproduce, test, configure, and resolve client issues within agreed priorities and service levels while documenting root cause, resolution steps, testing evidence, and client communication.
* Ability to open, track, and manage Oracle Service Requests, including selecting appropriate severity, providing reproducible evidence, coordinating client actions, escalating when necessary, and validating Oracle\-provided solutions before closure.
* Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements and solving day\-to\-day issues.
* Ability to lead a team, work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Prior experience leading or managing projects.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external clients.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

3bbe7c0e.title: Lead Consultant - Client Services (Oracle Cloud EPM Planning)
3bbe7c0e.description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Argano is seeking a EPM Planning Consultant for our Client Services practice. A consultant in Argano Managed Services is an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM professional responsible for sustaining, optimizing, and continuously improving clients’ production environments after go\-live. The consultant manages a portfolio of client priorities, provides functional and technical leadership, and guides incident resolution, service requests, enhancements, and process improvements. Working collaboratively with client stakeholders, the Consultant helps protect operational stability, increase adoption, and deliver measurable business value. The role also mentors other consultants, contributes to reusable practices, and supports strong client satisfaction and long\-term account success.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Argano Managed Services helps clients sustain, optimize, and continuously improve their Oracle Cloud environments after go\-live. Our consultants combine functional expertise, collaborative problem\-solving, and proactive client service to improve business processes and the end\-user experience. We value creativity, teamwork, accountability, continuous learning, and a healthy, respectful workplace.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Oracle Cloud EPM Planning
* Manage multiple client workstreams and service priorities concurrently, balancing incidents, service requests, enhancements, recurring activities, and planned initiatives against agreed priorities and service commitments.
* Act as a functional expert as part of a team and/or independently with no supervision.
* Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders. Keep all parties informed about progress, challenges, and changes.

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience, including significant experience supporting and enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud environments after go\-live, with prior full\-lifecycle implementation experience preferred to demonstrate a strong understanding of application design and downstream impacts.
* Expert knowledge of the Oracle Planning Cloud tools required.
* Hands\-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, configuring, or enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud modules such as Workforce, Capital, Projects, Profitability and Cost Management, or Strategic Modeling.
* Strong Essbase calculation script writing skills preferred
* Experience with Groovy Scripts preferred
* Experience with Oracle EPM Data Exchange or Data Management, including troubleshooting data and metadata loads, mappings, integrations, validation failures, and recurring load processes.
* Experience with EDM a plus
* Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud a plus
* Candidate should be teachable with a strong desire to learn and expand current knowledge base
* Professional services experience in an Oracle Cloud EPM Managed Services, application support, or production\-operations role is strongly preferred; experience advising client stakeholders at a strategic level is also beneficial.
* In\-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems.


 SKILL REQUIREMENTS
   

  

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Service Delivery Management: Prioritize and coordinate concurrent client needs across incidents, requests, recurring operations, and enhancements while maintaining clear ownership, realistic commitments, accurate status, and alignment with service levels.
* Continuous Improvement: Translate recurring issues, service trends, Oracle Cloud updates, and industry practices into practical recommendations that improve stability, efficiency, controls, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Strong commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Strong degree of initiative, accuracy, efficiency, and attention to detail.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

21f24a0f.title: IT Technology Services Sr Specialist- SAP Basis, S/4 HANA, Private/ Public Cloud
21f24a0f.description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of managed services for SAP Private Cloud customers, ensuring service commitments, operational targets, and customer expectations are consistently achieved. Why it matters: reliable delivery helps customers accelerate their cloud transformation journey.
* Act as the primary technical contact for customers, guiding technology discussions, innovation roadmaps, and service adoption plans. Why it matters: strategic guidance enables customers to maximize the value of their SAP investments.
* Drive SLA and KPI reviews, coordinate incident and change management processes, and proactively address operational risks. Why it matters: strong governance improves system stability, performance, and business continuity.
* Orchestrate collaboration across SAP ECS, technical operations, and customer stakeholders to deliver unified outcomes. Why it matters: effective coordination creates a seamless and consistent customer experience. Identify improvement opportunities, execute technical action plans, and support performance optimization across customer environments. Why it matters: continuous improvement helps customers achieve measurable business and operational benefits.


**What You Bring**
* 7\+ years of experience in SAP system operations, including SAP Basis, databases, operating systems, and infrastructure management across complex enterprise landscapes.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA architecture, migration approaches, conversion methodologies, and SAP technology solutions.
* Experience delivering technical services, managing customer engagements, and coordinating multiple priorities across cross\-functional teams.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and hyperscaler environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux environments and enterprise database technologies including SAP HANA and Sybase.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and relationship\-building skills, with fluency in English and Arabic.
* Proven ability to manage escalations, mitigate risks, solve complex technical challenges, and maintain customer confidence in high\-pressure situations.
* SAP certifications in SAP Basis, SAP Technology, SAP S/4HANA, or related SAP domains are preferred. Certifications in AWS, Azure, or GCP are an advantage.


**Where you belong**
* Collaborating with highly skilled professionals across SAP's global network.
* Be part of a customer\-focused organization that values innovation, partnership, and continuous learning.
* Engage with diverse international teams and customers, contributing to a true global delivery model
* Grow your expertise through exposure to cutting\-edge SAP cloud technologies, enterprise\-scale landscapes, and strategic transformation programs.


 If you are passionate about SAP technologies, customer success, and cloud transformation, and you thrive in a collaborative global environment, apply now and help shape the future of enterprise cloud services at SA
   

  

**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
   

  

 SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
   

  

 For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
   

  

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.
   

  

 Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

f319710b.title: Client Experience Program Manager
f319710b.description:
**Description**
 Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.
   

  

 We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance.
   

  

 Together, we unlock potential.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Client Specialist team is responsible for managing a portfolio of North America CRB Property \& Casualty (P\&C) clients within a specific industry vertical, ensuring exceptional service delivery and a high\-touch client experience. The team partners closely with Client Advocacy, Broking teams \& functional team to deliver seamless, proactive service to the clients
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Project Manager \- Client Experience \& Digital Engagement will lead and manage strategic Client Experience, Voice of Customer, Digital Engagement, Analytics, and AI\-enabled transformation initiatives across North America. The role will work across Client Experience, Client Advocacy, Digital Engagement, Technology, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, and Business Leadership teams to convert client feedback and engagement data into actionable insights and measurable business improvement.
   

  

 This role is intended for an experienced program lead who can manage senior stakeholders, shape initiative roadmaps, establish governance, interpret data, drive cross\-functional execution, and support long\-term client experience and digital engagement priorities.
   

  

**Principal Duties / Responsibilities**
**Strategic program leadership**
* Planning and execution of Client Experience and Digital Engagement initiatives across North America.
* Define scope, goals, deliverables, governance, risks, dependencies, and implementation roadmaps.
* Manage concurrent strategic workstreams across client feedback, digital engagement, analytics, AI, and operational improvement.
* Prepare and present program updates, executive summaries, decision papers, and progress reports for leadership.


**Voice Of Customer And Client Experience**
* Coordination and management of Voice of Customer and client listening programs.
* Support client satisfaction survey design, NPS management, interview frameworks, and client feedback governance.
* Identify trends, emerging risks, improvement opportunities, and actionable themes from client feedback. Partner with Client Experience leader and other business leaders to translate client insights into operational improvements and measurable outcomes.


**Data analytics and insights**
* Use Power BI and other reporting platforms to extract, validate, interpret, and analyse client and engagement data.
* Cross\-reference multiple reporting sources to generate deeper business insights.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, account health summaries, and recurring reporting frameworks.
* Translate complex data into clear recommendations that support account planning, growth, retention, and strategic reviews.


**Digital engagement and AI enablement**
* Support digital engagement strategy, client\-facing technology initiatives, and portal experience enhancements.
* Coordinate AI pilots, automation initiatives, adoption activities, user feedback, and business readiness efforts.
* Partner with engineering, design, analytics, technology, and business teams to support solution delivery.
* Support contract review automation, E365 enhancements, dashboard initiatives, and other digital transformation activities.


**Stakeholder and change management**
* Influence and align senior stakeholders across business, operations, technology, analytics, and client advocacy teams.
* Drive communications, change management, adoption tracking, training coordination, and stakeholder engagement.
* Challenge assumptions, escalate risks, and drive accountability for decisions, actions, and outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Analytics, Technology, Marketing, Project Management, Customer Experience, or related field.
* Project management certification such as PMP, Prince2, Agile, Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent is preferred.


**Experience**
* Minimum 7 years of experience in project/program management, client experience, digital engagement, analytics, strategy, consulting, business operations, or related fields.
* Experience managing cross\-functional initiatives from planning through execution and benefits tracking.
* Experience preparing executive reporting and communicating with senior stakeholders.
* Experience with client feedback, Voice of Customer, NPS, customer journey mapping, or customer experience programs is preferred.
* Professional services, consulting, brokerage, insurance, or financial services experience is preferred.


**Skills**
* Strong ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and drive outcomes across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical capability, including comfort with Power BI, dashboards, reporting and data interpretation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to convert data and feedback into actionable recommendations and continuous improvement plans.
* Awareness of AI, automation, digital transformation, and technology\-enabled client engagement solutions.


**Application Process**
* Application review
* Virtual or in person interviews
* Technical assessment / interview
* Offer \& onboarding


 WTW is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status or status as an individual with disability. All qualified applicants will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

1c8673f9.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
1c8673f9.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Job Description: Senior Specialist, Product Development, Digital Transformation \& Optimization
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is a global technology company. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making payment and data transactions safe, simple, smart, and successful. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 The Digital Transformation and Optimization team is part of Core Solutions. We are responsible for optimizing eCommerce solutions and for driving transaction authorization improvement for digital transactions globally. We do this by being a consumer centric for our products and services and being relevant in all consumer money flows.
   

  

**The Role**
* Have good understanding of hybrid application integrations, analytical tools to measure and track customer experience, like Mixtiles, and Project management frameworks/ tools like GIT, copilot and Jira
* Responsible for identifying, analyzing, developing, and bringing solutions to market that meet customer needs through supporting stories, feature management and project planning, helping to make solid product decisions and deliver value
* Drive product evolution with a focus on data science, engineering and business impact by helping to maintain the product backlog, and prioritize requirements
* Provide Operational support of new products where authorization recommendations are delivered from an AI engine to an Mastercard global application
* Act as a Program Admin to support Mastercard product governance tools and services (Studio, Architecture Reviews, AI governance, Compliance and Data Security, etc.)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, data science, operations, and design to deliver scalable solutions that enhance product connectivity, data flow, and performance insight
* Continuously innovate and explore new approaches, tools, techniques, and technologies to solve business problems
* Stay updated on emerging trends in integration technologies (e.g., AI ML model \& and data analytics platforms (e.g., Thoughtspot, Power BI)


 Candidates based in India only
   

  

**All About You**
 The candidate should demonstrate:
   

  

* Must have a minimum of 5 years of experience in technical product management and project management
* Passion for all things digital and intrinsic curiosity to understand new technology like Artificial Intelligence, Cloud solutions
* Entrepreneurial spirit and global mindset with a passion for learning and using data to solve large scale business problems
* Experience using project management tools like Git, Jira, Aha, etc is preferable
* Excellent communication \& influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders; ability to articulate problem statements, opportunity areas and complex data models
* Excellent project management and execution skills, with strong problem solving, highly analytical, quantitative communication and organizational skills
* Create and maintain material in support of product development and management: business cases, product roadmaps, success metrics, etc.
* Good to have experience with Enterprise Business Intelligence Platform/Data platforms
* Ability to articulate the business value of products and actively participate in sales enablement efforts
* Proven success in interacting with stakeholders to understand technical needs and ensure analyses and solutions effectively meet their requirements


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

10cc5e95.title: Senior Technical Program Manager- Data Center Infrastructure Delivery
10cc5e95.description:
**Job Description**
 This high\-impact role puts you at the center of multi\-million dollar construction initiatives, managing cutting\-edge infrastructure delivery from concept to completion. You'll work with executive\-level stakeholders, lead top\-tier vendor relationships, and drive strategic projects that directly fuel Oracle's explosive growth\-all with exceptional autonomy and visibility. If you're ready to shape the backbone of tomorrow's cloud technology while accelerating your career at one of tech's most influential companies, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact the development and implementation process of a specific company product.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 The Data Center Infrastructure Delivery team at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a dynamic group of professionals dedicated to delivering state\-of\-the\-art data center facilities at scale and at pace. This team comprises experienced project managers who work collaboratively with vendors and internal teams to ensure the successful execution of complex data center construction and network projects. They bring a wealth of expertise in project management, technical design, and on\-site construction, ensuring that our data centers meet the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and sustainability. This team plays a crucial role in supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's data needs and driving our growth and success.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Strategically, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive plans that optimize efficiency, cost\-effectiveness, and operational excellence in delivery. You will engage with key stakeholders, manage high\-stakes vendor relationships, and navigate the complexities of regulatory compliance. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks to datacenter delivery will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. This is a high\- impact role that will lead, drive, and ensure the successful management and delivery of critical initiatives on our strategic roadmap.
   

  

 The role comes with a high degree of personal accountability and autonomy and will require effective engagement across Design, Engineering and Operations. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to own end\-to\-end delivery of network and data center capacity across concurrent builds.
   

  

 This role will oversee data center focused projects and initiatives. Managing these construction projects well is key to the overall success of customer deliveries. You will engage directly with our Colo and LV partners' leadership and project management teams, driving accountability and improvements to meet our customers' needs. You will also engage with internal teams to make sure we deliver the proper design and process documentation to the Colo, execute on our ISP circuit contracts, and update all internal tracking tools for handover to our operations teams at the end of the project.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities Include:**
* Being the end\-to\-end TPM leader in charge of the program across multiple sites up to 1GW of capacity, coordinating with multiple principal TPM from shaping the approach, prioritizing the resources and achieving the desired outcomes through delivery.
* Project Planning: Develop and implement long\-term strategies for data center construction and network build projects to align with organizational goals.
* Partner with the design team to ensure design and construction are fully coordinated in advance of contracting.
* Partner with Construction team to ensure collaboration and seem less handoff
* Project Management: Oversee all phases of complex data center construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Tenant Fit Out and LV Integration: Work closely throughout design, construction, commissioning and LV fit out to fully coordinate and integrate the separate scopes of tenant fit out projects with the overall project scope.
* Vendor Management: Select, negotiate, and manage external vendors, contractors, and suppliers to ensure project success.
* Budget Oversight: Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost\-effective use of resources and adherence to financial constraints.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
* Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and addressing any concerns.
* Quality Assurance: Implement and oversee quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of construction and operational efficiency.
* Regular project visits to ensure schedule, coordination, and quality will be required throughout the life of the project on an as needed basis.


**Required Skills**
* Project management experience in delivery mission critical Data Centre Construction, Cabling, Compute, Networking, AI infrastructure project.
* At least 5 years of Program/Portfolio management experience.
* PMP/ITIL v3 or equivalent certification
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to address complex challenges in a fast\-paced construction environment.
* Strategic Planning: Expertise in developing and implementing long\-term strategies and establishing program\-level requirements for construction projects.
* Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of data center design, construction, and operational requirements, with a focus on cutting\-edge technologies and sustainability.
* Project Management: Proven expertise in managing large\-scale data center construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and within\-budget delivery including advanced project scheduling and tracking.
* Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of project managers, engineers, and construction professionals.
* Budget Management: Proficiency in creating, managing, and optimizing project budgets to ensure cost\-effective use of resources.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify potential risks and develop effective mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
* Vendor Management: Extensive experience in selecting, negotiating, and managing contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

6913a52e.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center Infrastructure
6913a52e.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Jabil is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) focused on Datacenter Infrastructure Engineering and Manufacturing. This position will directly contribute to the transformative growth within the Intelligent Infrastructure Division.
   

  

 The TPM role is responsible for coordinating deliverables and reporting on large complex Data Center Infrastructure Programs, including contingency planning and issue resolution. The TPM contributes to and demonstrates a solid understanding of program vision and roadmap, while maintaining awareness of cross\-product/program synergies and actively communicates opportunities to simplify or better align work across teams.
   

  

**LOCATION**
 Austin, TX
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* In depth knowledge of datacenter power distribution, cooling and related systems and sub\-systems
* Provides regular updates to senior leadership, external partners, and internal teams on the status of infrastructure programs, including risks, blockers, and dependencies
* Support scale through shared learnings and mechanisms
* Acting as technical advisor, working closely with engineering teams to understand challenges, propose solutions, and ensure technical feasibility
* Act as the voice of the client within the organization, ensuring that their needs and concerns are addressed promptly and effectively
* Coordinate multiple projects and reconcile interdependencies among them;
* Drive decisions with appropriate stakeholders, eliminating roadblocks to resolve customer issues
* Define KPI's and establish SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses
* Adept at managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating schedules
* Oversee activities associated with the NPI projects to ensure the program achieves its goals on time
* Collaborate with factory\-based PMs to provide support from RFP through NPI completion of FWT
* Manage RFP timelines, milestones, meetings, document repository, RFIs / ECNs and team up in packaging all RFP deliverables
* Aid and provide strategic guidance to the company’s project managers
* Work in partnership with the site\-based PMs to develop and implement program strategy
* Works with your manager to propose potential R\&D project ideas to enhance competency areas
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned


**Knowledge Requirements**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 5\+ years of analytical, quantitative, communication, and presentations experience
* Proven track record of taking ownership and delivering results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Proficiency in Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall methodologies
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Creative, self\-motivated, accountable, and team\-oriented
* Able to work independently with minimal oversight
* Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries
* Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices
* Comfortable working as part of a global team
* Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones
* Familiar with stage\-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLCM)
* Able to mentor junior project managers


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline or a related field. PMP a plus
* 5\+ years of datacenter and/or industrial technical program management of design/engineering/manufacturing/test experience
* Alternatively, a suitable combination of education, experience, and/or training may be considered
* Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategy, and system coordination
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to Data Center Infrastructure is preferred
* Analytic and decisive decision maker
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities


 BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e\-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e\-mail with a jabil.com e\-mail address. a9147f73.title: Program Manager I, Flex Advocacy Operations
a9147f73.description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Flex program uses independent drivers—called delivery partners—to deliver to our customers. Through the Amazon Flex app, drivers sign up for the program, schedule pickup times, are guided during routes with the navigation system, and more.
   

  

 As the Amazon Flex Program Manager, you will be responsible for the strategy and initiatives aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the deliveries carried out by the program. To achieve your goals, you'll work with diverse areas of the organization, including technology, operations, and marketing. A successful program manager will work to enhance the experience of hundreds of drivers, both within operations and when carrying out delivery routes, through data analysis, identifying obstacles and problem spots, and implementing effective and well\-defined standards. These improvements must be balanced with business needs and take into account key operational metrics. Effective stakeholder management skills are essential to balance these competing priorities and delivering effective solutions for our customers and drivers.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Support long\-term strategic planning to improve quality and efficiency.
   

  

* Work closely with the areas of finance, marketing, capacity management, operations, engineering, and program management on process improvement and launch initiatives.
* Develop, implement, and oversee reports, ensuring clear visibility of project milestones and performance.
* Effectively influence stakeholders through collaboration and effective prioritization.
* Be responsible for key performance indicators and work closely with stakeholders to understand everyday opportunities and challenges in order to implement short and long\-term solutions.
* Monitor the execution of projects and ensure that the delivery is at the appropriate quality level and in compliance with the expected deadline.
* Navigate and resolve ambiguities by applying creative problem solving skills.
* Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from becoming larger problems.


**About The Team**
 Amazon Flex’s Advocacy Operations (AO) team is seeking highly skilled and motivated operations manager to assist in the tactical operations management and execution of Amazon Flex related projects and deliverables worldwide. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an operations Manager, you will be responsible for defining and executing the operations roadmap and requirements for the operations function in Advocacy Operations. Throughout this process the operations manager will drive continuous innovation and improvements to deliver fast, easy, and rich functionality, and help deliver on the best\-in\-class customer experience. The successful candidate will manage operations across worldwide Flex\-enabled marketplaces (US, CA, UK, IN, JP, AU, SG, MX, BR), leading high\-performing managers to execute various tasks including DP account management, bulk communications, compliance workflows, and programmatic support. You will play a pivotal role in implementing strategic automation initiatives while identifying opportunities to build long\-term solutions that eliminate manual work without negatively impacting the DP experience.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Knowledge of SQL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
